いられない。
lines.english: A thought suddenly struck Youko. The idea was far too cool to keep from Shinobu.

lines.japanese: 「ポニー・ドリル」
lines.english: “A Pony Drill.”

lines.japanese: 「似合うと思うよ」
lines.english: “I think it would suit you.”

lines.japanese: 「なんか新しいっぽいし」
lines.english: “It sounds sort of new, too.”

lines.japanese: 「やろうかな……？」
lines.english: “Maybe I will…”

lines.japanese: 後ろ髪に指先を通し、弄びながら葉子は呟く。
lines.english: Youko murmured as she ran her fingers through the hair at the back of her head.

lines.japanese: 「……あ、ここ新しくできたおしゃれ空間ですよ」
lines.english: “…Oh, here's that stylish new space.”

lines.japanese: 「洋服屋さんとお言いなさい」
lines.english: “Call it a clothing store.”

lines.japanese: 「しかしながらただの洋服屋さんではないのです」
lines.english: “And yet this is no ordinary clothing store.”

lines.japanese: 忍はしげしげと店先を眺めた。
lines.english: Shinobu studied the storefront.

lines.japanese: 「……なんだここ」
lines.english: “…What is this place?”

lines.japanese:
異様なオーラが出ていた。

lines.english: “A casual boutique.”

lines.japanese: 「嘘だ嘘だ」
lines.english: “Lies. All lies.”

lines.japanese:
カジュアルという言葉にともなう爽やかさなど、

lines.japanese: しかも。
lines.english: What's more—

lines.english: “A maid outfit.”

lines.japanese: 「馬鹿な！」
lines.english: “Impossible!”

lines.japanese: 「欲しいんですよね。でも高い」
lines.english: “I want it. But it's expensive.”

lines.japanese: 値札を見て眩暈がした。
lines.english: The price tag made him dizzy.

lines.japanese: 「８万円もする……」
lines.english: “Eighty thousand yen…”

lines.japanese: 「上等な素材で本格的に仕上げてあるのですよ」
lines.english: “It's the real thing, properly made from fine materials.”

lines.japanese: 「にしても高いな……ブランド服と変わらない……」
lines.english: “Still, that's expensive… It costs as much as designer clothing…”

lines.japanese:
「ジーンズに１０万円出す人もいるじゃないですか。

lines.english: “Some people pay a hundred thousand yen for jeans. This is modest by comparison.”

lines.japanese: じっとメイド服を見つめる。
lines.english: She stared fixedly at the maid outfit.

lines.japanese:
ショーウインドゥ内のトランペットに魅了される
少年のようなまなざしで。
lines.english: With the eyes of a boy captivated by a trumpet in a shop window.

lines.japanese: 「めんこい」
lines.english: “Adorable.”

lines.japanese: 「……本当に欲しいの？」
lines.english: “…Do you really want it?”

lines.japanese: 「欲しいです」
lines.english: “I do.”

lines.japanese: ガラスに張りついたまま、葉子は言う。
lines.english: Youko answered without peeling herself away from the glass.

lines.japanese: （やっぱ葉子ってヘンだなぁ……）
lines.english: (Youko really is strange…)

lines.english: “I'm saving my allowance, but it's taking forever.”

lines.japanese: 「仮に買ったとして、どこで着るのよ」

lines.japanese: 「まだ堅苦しい？」
lines.english: “Is it still so stuffy?”

lines.japanese:

lines.english: “There are no particular problems.”

lines.english: “Yes. They don’t get angry anymore when I do something unnecessary.”

lines.japanese: 「……快適ですよ？」
lines.english: “…It's comfortable.”

lines.japanese:
言葉にかかる陰はなく。

lines.english: “Then that's all right.”

lines.japanese:

「あ、うちの学校の机、一クラス分捨てるみたいよ？
　もらっちゃおうか？」
lines.english: “Oh, I think my school is throwing out a whole classroom's worth of desks. Should we take one?”

lines.japanese: 皆の表情が、なんともいえないものになった。
lines.english: An indescribable expression settled over every face.

lines.japanese:
「プライベートで学校の机に向かうのって、嫌じゃ
　ない？」
lines.english: “Wouldn't you hate sitting at a school desk in your free time?”

lines.japanese: 「そうかな……？」
lines.english: “You think…?”

lines.japanese: 「解放感がイマイチ……」
lines.english: “Not much of a sense of freedom…”

lines.japanese: 「う～ん」
lines.english: “Hmmm.”

lines.japanese: 「いいブツが見つかったら確保だな」
lines.english: “If we find a good one, we'll claim it.”

lines.japanese: 「だね」
lines.english: “Right.”

lines.japanese:
それからはいつもの雑談へと流れていった。
　緋色の時間が過ぎていく。
lines.english: From there, they drifted into their usual chatter. The scarlet hours slipped by.

lines.japanese:
一人帰り、二人帰り……気がつくと、忍とあずさ、
塚本兄妹だけになっていた。
lines.english: One person left, then another… Before he knew it, only Shinobu, Azusa, and the Tsukamoto siblings remained.

lines.japanese: 「あちしトイレ」
lines.english: “I gotta go potty.”

lines.japanese:
あずさは羞恥も見せずに告げ、立ち上がる。
　少年のように堂々と歩いていく。
　忍が優しげな視線で見送る。
lines.english: Azusa announced it without the faintest embarrassment and stood. She strode away as boldly as any boy. Shinobu watched her go fondly.

lines.japanese: 「……今日も騒いだなぁ……んん」
lines.english: “…We made a racket again today… Mm.”

lines.japanese: 伸びをした。
lines.english: He stretched.

lines.japanese: 「紅茶、おかわりどうします？」
lines.english: “More tea?”

lines.japanese: 「んー……どうしようかな」
lines.english: “Hmm… I don't know.”

lines.japanese: 「私は最後に一杯だけもらいます」
lines.english: “I'll have just one last cup.”

lines.japanese: 「なら僕も」
lines.english: “Then I'll have one too.”

lines.japanese:
カップを渡す。
　さりげなく、しかし確実に、指が絡められる。
lines.english: He passed her his cup. Casually but unmistakably, her fingers twined through his.

lines.japanese: 数十秒。
lines.english: A few dozen seconds passed.

lines.japanese: 忍は何も言わず、穏やかに葉子を見ている。
lines.english: Shinobu said nothing. He simply watched Youko in gentle silence.

lines.japanese: 「……いってきます」
lines.english: “…I'll be right back.”

lines.japanese: 「うん」
lines.english: “All right.”

lines.japanese: 離れる。
lines.english: They parted.

lines.japanese:
塚本兄と二人っきりになる。
　五秒。十秒だろうか。
　無言が両者の間に置かれる。
lines.english: He was left alone with Youko's older brother. Five seconds. Perhaps ten. Silence settled between them.

lines.japanese: 「……今日は」
lines.english: “…Today—”

lines.japanese: ぽつ、といった感じで。
lines.english: The words fell from him, a solitary drop.

lines.japanese: 「問題もなく過ごせた？」
lines.english: “Did you get through it without any trouble?”

lines.japanese: 斎は小さく頷いた。
lines.english: Itsuki gave a small nod.

lines.japanese: 「まったくなあ……」
lines.english: “Man…”

lines.japanese: 「気楽に生きたいもんだね」
lines.english: “It'd be nice to live without a care.”

lines.japanese:
苦笑いを見せると、斎もまた口の端を緩めた。
　ただそれだけのやりとり。
　挨拶のように見える行為だ。
lines.english: When Shinobu gave a rueful smile, the corner of Itsuki's mouth relaxed in answer. That was the whole exchange. A gesture that might have passed for a greeting.

lines.japanese:
会話を要さない了解事が、川底を這う冷水のよう
に流れている。
lines.english: A tacit understanding ran between them, like cold water creeping along a riverbed.

lines.japanese:
昔からこんな関係だったわけではない。
　最初は斎も、よく話していたように思う。
lines.english: Their relationship had not always been like this. At first, if Shinobu remembered right, Itsuki had talked a great deal.

lines.japanese:
無口になった。
　寡黙になったのだ。
lines.english: He had grown quiet. He had become taciturn.

lines.japanese:
成長とともに芽生えた自意識が原因だろうか？
　そうではない。
lines.english: Was it the self-consciousness that had emerged as he matured? No.

lines.japanese:
決して譲れない、当人なりの一線だったのかも知
れない。
lines.english: Perhaps it was a boundary of his own that he refused to cross.

lines.japanese: そして皆に対する気遣いだったのかも知れない。
lines.english: And perhaps it was his way of showing consideration for everyone.

lines.japanese: 「どうぞ」
lines.english: “Here you are.”

lines.japanese: 「ありがとう」
lines.english: “Thank you.”

lines.japanese: 「兄さんも」
lines.english: “One for you too, big brother.”

lines.japanese:
そういえば、と忍は考える。
　斎、葉子、忍。
lines.english: It struck Shinobu then: Itsuki, Youko, and himself.

lines.japanese:
遠い昔、似たような状況になったことがある。
　今よりもずっと子供だった頃。
　たわむれに思い出してみる。
lines.english: Long ago, they had found themselves in much the same situation. Back when they were far younger than they were now. Idly, he let his thoughts drift back.

lines.japanese: 斎がまだ味方ではなかった頃―――
lines.english: Back when Itsuki was not yet an ally—

lines.japanese: 平和な時代に警戒する者はいない。
lines.english: No one keeps their guard up in times of peace.

lines.japanese: 喉元過ぎれば熱さを忘れる。
lines.english: Once it’s down your throat, you forget how hot it was.

lines.japanese: きか
lines.english: calamity

lines.japanese:
奇禍に備え気を張って暮らす意識が、長く保持さ
れることはない。
lines.english: No one can remain constantly on guard against some freak calamity for long.

lines.japanese:
ゆえに集団下校は推奨されてはいたが、義務化さ
れてはいなかった。
lines.english: Thus, although children were encouraged to walk home in groups, it was not mandatory.

lines.japanese:
幼い貴宮忍は、相変わらず一人でいることが多か
った。
lines.english: Young Shinobu Atemiya still spent most of his time alone.

lines.japanese:
クラスに親しい友人ができたわけでもない。
　自宅に、遊びに誘う電話がかかってくるわけでも
ない。
lines.english: He had not made any close friends in his class. Nor did anyone ever call his house to invite him out to play.

lines.japanese:
放課後の短さを気にするでもない。
　だが。
lines.english: Nor did he mind how little time there was after school. And yet.

lines.japanese: 必ずしも、完全な孤独だったわけではない。
lines.english: That did not mean he was entirely alone.

lines.japanese: いくぶん不本意ではあったが―――
lines.english: Though not entirely by choice—

lines.japanese: 「何、してんの？」
lines.english: “What're you doing?”
“…Huh?”

lines.japanese:
声をかけてきたのは、小柄な少女―――
紅緒あずさだ。
lines.english: The voice belonged to a slight girl— Azusa Benio.

lines.japanese: 「何、と言われてもな……」
lines.english: “What do you mean, what am I doing…?”

lines.japanese: 「さっきからずーっとそこで立ってる」
lines.english: “You've been standing there this whooole time.”

lines.japanese:
よほど無防備なのか、忍が自分の空間と感じる位
置まで寄ってきて話す。
lines.english: Perhaps she had no sense of caution at all. She came close enough to speak from inside what Shinobu considered his personal space.

lines.japanese: 距離感覚の違い。
lines.english: They measured distance very differently.

lines.japanese:
顔が異様に寄ってきて、ぎょっとさせられる。
　半径３０センチ。
lines.english: Her face loomed disconcertingly close. A radius of thirty centimeters.

lines.japanese:
忍にとっての制空権だ。
　少女はその内に踏み込みかけている。
　無神経さが、少し気に障る。
lines.english: That was Shinobu's airspace. The girl was on the verge of breaching it. Her thoughtlessness annoyed him a little.

lines.japanese:
馴れ馴れしいという感じはしない。
　ただ他者と自己の間を、正しく認識していないよ
うな。
lines.english: She didn't strike him as overfamiliar, exactly. It was more as though she didn't properly understand the boundary between herself and another person.

lines.japanese: そんな未熟さと傲慢さが鼻につく。
lines.english: That immaturity, that arrogance, grated on him.

lines.japanese: 「ひまなら、遊ぶ？」
lines.english: “If you're not busy, wanna play?”

lines.japanese: 「……暇じゃない」
lines.english: “…I am busy.”

lines.japanese: 咄嗟に、そう返答した。
lines.english: He answered without thinking.

lines.japanese: 「む、なにもしてないじゃん」
lines.english: “Hmph. You're not doing anything.”

lines.japanese: 少しムッとしてあずさ。
lines.english: Azusa bristled a little.

lines.japanese: 「人を待ってる」
lines.english: “I'm waiting for someone.”

lines.japanese: 「だれ？」
lines.english: “Who?”

lines.japanese: 「キミの知らない人」
lines.english: “Someone you don't know.”

lines.japanese:
少女の表情が険しくなる。
　拒絶に対して、まだ怒りでしか返せない。
lines.english: The girl’s face hardened. For now, anger was her only answer to rejection.

lines.japanese:
「……なんだよ、
　つっ立ってたから誘ってやったのに」
lines.english: “…What gives? I only asked 'cause you were standing around doing nothing.”

lines.japanese: 「いいよ、一人で遊ぶから！」
lines.english: “Whatever! I'll play by myself!”

lines.japanese:
後ろ手に持っていたボールを頭に乗せて、校庭の
隅に歩み去った。
lines.english: She balanced the ball she'd been holding behind her back on her head and stalked off to a corner of the schoolyard.

lines.japanese:
忍のいる場所から、１０メートルも離れていない。
　これ見よがし、という印象。
lines.english: She did not go even ten meters from where Shinobu stood. It seemed deliberate, as though she wanted him to notice.

lines.japanese: （なぜそんな近くで……）
lines.english: (Why so close…?)

lines.japanese:
ドリブルやリフティングをはじめる。
　行為に統一性はなく、適当に遊んでいる様子だ。
lines.english: She began dribbling the ball, then juggling it with her feet. There was no particular pattern to it. She was just playing around.

lines.japanese:
煙たさを理由に遠ざけたのではない。
　用事があったことは事実だ。
　多少気にはなったが、放置しておくことにした。
lines.english: He hadn’t turned her away because he found her a nuisance. He really did have something to do. He was a little concerned, but decided to leave her be.

lines.japanese:
いつでも帰れるよう、鞄は持ってきている。
　この時間、校庭で遊んでいる生徒は皆そうだろう。
lines.english: He had his schoolbag with him so he could leave at any moment. Every student playing in the yard at this hour had probably done the same.

lines.japanese:
誰もがグループで遊んでいる。
　仲良し同士集まって、ドッジボールをしたり玩具
で競ったりしている。
lines.english: Everyone was playing in groups. Friends had gathered for dodgeball or to pit their toys against one another.

lines.japanese:
あずさのように、一人遊びにふけっている者など
どこにもいなかった。
lines.english: There was no one else anywhere in the yard absorbed in solitary play as Azusa was.

lines.japanese:
気付いたからといって、行動に直結されるわけで
もない。
lines.english: Noticing did not immediately translate into action.

lines.japanese:
どんな顔で、どんな言葉で、少女に接近するべき
なのか。
　最適の方法を忍が知るはずもなく。
lines.english: What expression should he wear? What words should he use to approach the girl? Shinobu couldn't possibly know the best way to go about it.

lines.japanese: （……かわいそうだけど……）
lines.english: (…I feel sorry for her, but…)

lines.japanese:
忍とあずさ。
　二人は互いに慣れていない。
lines.english: Shinobu and Azusa. They weren't used to each other yet.

lines.japanese:
大切な誰かであるかと問われれば、お互いに言葉
に詰まるのはわかりきっている。
lines.english: If asked whether the other was someone important to them, both would plainly be at a loss for words.

lines.japanese:
友人という枠だけを引いた。
　ルールはまだない。
　これから積み上げていかねばならないのだった。
lines.english: They had done no more than draw the outline of friendship. There were no rules inside it yet. Those would have to be built, one by one, from here.

lines.japanese: そんな関係である。
lines.english: That was where they stood.

lines.japanese:
数分ほど待っていると、お目当ての人間が姿を見
せた。
lines.english: After several minutes, the people he had been waiting for appeared.

lines.japanese:
塚本斎と葉子―――
　案の定、二人一緒だ。
lines.english: Itsuki and Youko Tsukamoto— together, just as he had expected.

lines.japanese:
兄の単独はあっても、妹が一人で学校に来ること
はない。
lines.english: The brother sometimes came alone, but the sister never came to school by herself.

lines.japanese: 来るとしたら、二人セットになる。
lines.english: If she came at all, they came as a pair.

lines.japanese:
塚本葉子。
　病弱のため、ということになっている。
lines.english: Youko Tsukamoto. Officially, her poor health was the reason.

lines.japanese: （だけどその実、カゴの中の鳥だ……）
lines.english: (But really, she's a bird in a cage…)

lines.japanese: 二人が帰路につく。
lines.english: The two set off for home.

lines.japanese:
そう、彼ら二人にも友人などはいない。
　放課後遊びに誘う者はいない。
lines.english: They, too, had no friends. No one invited them to play after school.

lines.japanese: 忍は正門に移動する。
lines.english: Shinobu moved toward the front gate.

lines.japanese:
（……声をかけよう。
　そうしないと……何もはじまらない……）
lines.english: (…I'll talk to them. If I don't… nothing will ever start…)

lines.japanese:
あずさに対する罪悪感が、心中をかすめた。
　無視して、早足に歩んだ。
lines.english: He felt a pang of guilt over Azusa. Ignoring it, he quickened his pace.

lines.japanese: ボールを落とし、あずさはその動きを目で追った。
lines.english: Azusa dropped the ball and followed him with her eyes.

lines.japanese: 「キミたち」
lines.english: “You two.”

lines.japanese:
呼び止めた。
　斎がまず振り向く。葉子は一拍も遅れた。
lines.english: He called after them. Itsuki turned first. Youko followed a beat later.

lines.japanese: 「……おまえか」
lines.english: “…You again.”

lines.japanese: 「帰りだね」
lines.english: “Going home?”

lines.japanese: 「ああ……何か用か」
lines.english: “Yes… What do you want?”
“Ah…”

lines.japanese: 兄の背後、忍を認めた葉子が小さく声を出した。
lines.english: Behind her brother, Youko caught sight of Shinobu and let out a faint sound.
“Ah… ah…”

lines.japanese:
何か声を出そうとしている。
　しかし、ままならない。
　そんな様子だ。
lines.english: She was trying to make another sound. But she couldn't quite manage it. Or so it seemed.
(This girl…?)

lines.japanese: 「落ち着け葉子」
lines.english: “Calm down, Youko.”

lines.japanese: 妹の肩を押し、少し忍との距離を取る。
lines.english: He pressed a hand to his sister's shoulder and put a little distance between her and Shinobu.

lines.japanese: 少しだけ、葉子はいやがるそぶりを見せた。
lines.english: Youko seemed slightly reluctant.

lines.japanese: 「妹は情緒不安定だ。情緒不安定、知ってるか？」
lines.english: “My sister is emotionally unstable. Emotionally unstable—do you know what that means?”

lines.japanese: 「わかる……そうなのか？」
lines.english: “I know what it means… Is she?”

lines.japanese:
「だから学校にもそんな来させることはできないん
　だ」
lines.english: “That's why she can't be allowed to come to school very often.”

lines.japanese:
「俺が面倒を見ることで、やっと通わせてもらって
　いる」
lines.english: “They only let her attend at all because I take care of her.”

lines.japanese: 忍が切りだす前に、斎は話しはじめた。
lines.english: Itsuki began before Shinobu could say what he had come to say.

lines.japanese: 「どうしてそんなことしてると思う？」
lines.english: “Why do you think I'm doing all this?”

lines.japanese: 「俺も葉子も、くらやみの中にいるからだ」
lines.english: “Because Youko and I are both in the dark.”

lines.japanese:
大人びた口調で、斎は話す。
　門倉の日々がそうさせたのか。
　稚気というものがまるでない。
lines.english: Itsuki spoke with the gravity of an adult. Had life with the Kadokuras made him this way? There was nothing childlike about him.

lines.japanese:
「いつか……
　このつまらない毎日が終わるかも知れない」
lines.english: “One day… these dreary days may finally end.”

lines.japanese:
「そのときまで、せめて普通にと思って、こうして
　る」
lines.english: “Until then, I want us to live as normally as we can. That's why I'm doing this.”

lines.japanese: 「俺たちは犬なんだ。飼われているだけだ」
lines.english: “We're dogs. We're only being kept.”

lines.japanese: 「だから……そっとしておいてくれ」
lines.english: “So… please leave us alone.”

lines.japanese: 妹の肩を抱き、立ち去ろうとする。
lines.english: He put an arm around his sister's shoulders and started to leave.

lines.japanese: 「……普通に、というのは？」
lines.english: “…What do you mean by ordinary?”

lines.japanese:
二人が止まる。
　斎だけが忍の方に振り返った。
lines.english: They stopped. Only Itsuki turned back toward Shinobu.

lines.japanese: 「こうやって、学校に来ることとか」
lines.english: “Coming to school like this, for one.”

lines.japanese: 「とか？」
lines.english: “Like what else?”

lines.japanese: 「……それだけだ。それだけでせいいっぱいだ」
lines.english: “…That's all. That's all we can manage.”

lines.japanese:
あとはもう、会話をする雰囲気ではなかった。
　宙に視線を漂わせる妹の手を引いて、塚本斎は歩
いていった。
lines.english: The mood left no room for further conversation. Itsuki took his sister by the hand, her gaze adrift in empty space, and walked away.

lines.japanese:
忍は息をついた。
　今までにない種類の緊張。
　疲労を感じていた。
lines.english: Shinobu exhaled. The strain was unlike anything he'd felt before. It left him exhausted.

lines.japanese: （……大変だな……こういうのも……）
lines.english: (…This is hard… This sort of thing, too…)

lines.japanese:
友人になりたい誰か。
　接近して……話しかける。
　拒絶されたら、どうすべき？
lines.english: Someone he wanted to make friends with. Get close… talk to them. And if they rejected him, then what?

lines.japanese:
忍にはわからなかった。
　踏み込めばより敵意をかき立てる。
　退けば目的は達成されない。
lines.english: Shinobu did not know. Pressing closer would only provoke greater hostility. Backing away would leave his purpose unfulfilled.

lines.japanese:
どちらであっても、忍にとってはマイナスだ。
　思考が迷宮化してしまう。
lines.english: Either choice left Shinobu worse off. His thoughts wound themselves into a maze.

lines.japanese: （もっと別の手があるのか……？）
lines.english: (Is there some other way…?)

lines.japanese:
塚本葉子。
　そして斎。
lines.english: Youko Tsukamoto. And Itsuki.

lines.japanese:
接近しなければならない。
　そんな焦燥感に駆られていた。
lines.english: He had to get close to them. That sense of urgency drove him on.

lines.japanese:
鞄を取りに引き返すと、あずさがじっとこちらを
見ていた。
lines.english: When he went back for his schoolbag, he found Azusa staring straight at him.

lines.japanese:
胸元に抱えられたボール。
　何も訴えかけない、底の抜けたような虚ろな瞳。
lines.english: The ball clutched to her chest. Hollow, bottomless eyes that asked nothing of him.

lines.japanese:
落胆。あるいは失望。
　暗い感情に、忍は吸い込まれそうになる。
lines.english: Dejection. Or disappointment. Those dark feelings threatened to draw Shinobu in.

lines.japanese: （……寂しい……のかな。やっぱり）
lines.english: (…Maybe she really is… lonely.)

lines.japanese:
忍は鞄を手に取る。
　あずさのことを、忍は―――
lines.english: Shinobu picked up his schoolbag. As for Azusa, Shinobu—

lines.japanese: （わからない……この子は……自分にとって……）
lines.english: (I don't know… What is this girl… to me…?)

lines.japanese:
難癖ばかりついた関係。
　忍自身にためらいがあった。
　それでも。
lines.english: Their relationship had been nothing but friction. Shinobu still had his reservations. Even so.

lines.japanese: 鞄を置いた。元あった場所に。
lines.english: He set the bag down. Right where it had been.
“…Want to play?”
“…Wha?”

lines.japanese: 「だから」
lines.english: “I mean—”

lines.japanese: 喉がからんだ。
lines.english: His voice caught in his throat.

lines.japanese:
「サッカーだか、バスケだかわからないけど……
　そのボールで」
lines.english: “I can't tell if you're playing soccer or basketball, but… with that ball.”
“Huh…?”

lines.japanese: 少しだけ戸惑いを見せた。
lines.english: She looked a little uncertain.

lines.japanese: 「あ、うん……やろうか……」
lines.english: “Oh. Yeah… Let's play…”

lines.japanese:
困惑したまま、頷いた。
　そして何の断りもなく、唐突に、まったく空気の
読めていないタイミングで。
lines.english: Still perplexed, she nodded. Then, without warning, at a moment when she could not possibly have read the room any worse—

lines.japanese: ボールが飛んできた―――
lines.english: The ball came flying at him—

lines.japanese: 紅緒あずさの内部には、葛藤が渦巻いていた。
lines.english: Conflicting emotions churned inside Azusa Benio.

lines.japanese:
胸に手を置く。
　ドキドキしていた。
lines.english: She pressed a hand to her chest. Her heart was pounding.

lines.japanese:
しかしドキドキしている内にチャンスを逃すかも
知れない。
lines.english: But while her heart went on pounding, her chance might slip away.

lines.japanese:
わだかまりを解消できなくなるかも知れない。
　あずさにとって、かような感情は初体験。
lines.english: She might lose her chance to settle things. For Azusa, feelings like these were entirely new.

lines.japanese:
諦念に支配された人生で、はじめて、自らの全て
で働きかけねばならない出来事が発生していた。
lines.english: Her life had always been ruled by resignation. Now, for the first time, something had happened that demanded she put everything she had into it.

lines.japanese: 正直、何がなにやらわからない。
lines.english: Honestly, she had no idea what was happening.

lines.japanese:
「あたしは誰だ。紅緒あずさだ。
　上から下まで紅緒あずさだ―――」
lines.english: “Who am I? I'm Azusa Benio. Azusa Benio from head to toe—”

lines.japanese: そんなことを呟く。
lines.english: She muttered the words to herself.

lines.japanese: 「よし！」
lines.english: “All right!”

lines.japanese: それだけわかれば充分だ。
lines.english: That was all she needed to know.

lines.japanese: ―――充分なわけがないのである。
lines.english: —Not that it was anywhere near enough.

lines.japanese:
二度目の実戦は、彼女の闘志を危険なほどに高め
ていた。
lines.english: Her second real battle had raised her fighting spirit to dangerous heights.

lines.japanese:
兵隊が死ぬのは初陣ではない。
　むしろ二度目なのである。
lines.english: Soldiers aren't killed in their first battle. It's the second that gets them.

lines.japanese:
銃が人を殺すのではない。
　無謀が人を殺すのだ。
lines.english: Guns don't kill people. Recklessness does.

lines.japanese:
あずさはその事実を知らない。
　つかつかと歩む。
　背筋がぴんと伸びて、さながら紅顔の美少年。
lines.english: Azusa did not know this. She strode onward. Her back ramrod-straight, she looked for all the world like a handsome, rosy-cheeked boy.

lines.japanese:
上から下までまごうことなき紅緒あずさの、女と
しての色気はまだ１％も発現していない。
lines.english: She was unmistakably Azusa Benio from head to toe, and not even one percent of her womanly allure had emerged yet.

lines.japanese:
よくよく見れば、細く締まった足首にかろうじて
それらしきものが垣間見える程度。
lines.english: Look very closely, and you might just glimpse a hint of it in her slim, trim ankles.

lines.japanese:
変態性欲の対象としても狭すぎた。
　当面は安全なあずさだ。
　その足首が、ぴたりと地面に縫いつけられた。
lines.english: She was too niche even for perverts. For the time being, Azusa was safe. That ankle froze in place, as though pinned to the ground.

lines.japanese: 「あの」
lines.english: “Um.”

lines.japanese:
目の前に、少女がいる。
　少女といってもあずさより年上。
lines.english: A girl stood before her. Still a girl, but older than Azusa.

lines.japanese:
話したこともなければ、名前も知らない。
　どんな人間かも不明。
lines.english: Azusa had never spoken to her and did not know her name. She had no idea what sort of person she was.

lines.japanese:
目的をもって知らない人間に話しかける機会を、
子供はそう多く持たない。
lines.english: Children do not often have occasion to approach a stranger with a particular purpose in mind.

lines.japanese: 有り体にいえば、あずさはしゃちほこばっていた。
lines.english: Put plainly, Azusa was stiff with nerves.

lines.japanese: 「あのさ」
lines.english: “Hey.”

lines.japanese: 少女が振り向く。
lines.english: The girl turned around.

lines.japanese: 水道の音。
lines.english: The sound of running water.

lines.japanese:
少女―――塚本葉子はハンカチをちみっとくわえ
ている。
lines.english: The girl—Youko Tsukamoto—had the tiniest corner of her handkerchief caught between her teeth.
“…What?”

lines.japanese:
ハンカチが落ちた。
　便所の汚くないわけがない床に。
lines.english: The handkerchief fell. Onto a restroom floor that could not possibly have been clean.

lines.japanese: 二人の視線が、じっとハンカチに注がれること十秒。
lines.english: For ten solid seconds, both girls stared at the handkerchief.
“…What?”

lines.japanese: 衣服で手を拭いて、葉子は言う。
lines.english: Youko wiped her hands on her clothes and spoke.

lines.japanese: 「あ、あのさ―――」
lines.english: “H-hey—”

lines.japanese:
装填していた言葉を、ぶっ放す時が来た。
　憎いあんちきしょうに、一発因縁ふっかけねば気
が済まない。
lines.english: The time had come to fire the words she had chambered. She would not be satisfied until she had picked a proper fight with that contemptible scoundrel.

lines.japanese:
そんな精神状態。
　しかも二戦目。
　勇気ではない無謀。
lines.english: That was her state of mind. And this was her second battle. Recklessness, not courage.

lines.japanese:
渾然一体となって、得体の知れない妄念へと煮詰
まっていく。
lines.english: It all boiled together into one strange and unfathomable delusion.

lines.japanese: 「た、たのもー！」
lines.english: “I-I challenge you!”

lines.japanese: もう何もかも、駄目なのである。
lines.english: Everything had gone hopelessly wrong.

lines.japanese:
貴宮忍はまたも同じ場所から、ターゲットの帰宅
を待っていた。
lines.english: Once again, Shinobu Atemiya waited in the same place for his target to head home.

lines.japanese:
塚本兄妹はあまり学校に来ない。
　好機は少ない。
lines.english: The Tsukamoto siblings seldom came to school. Opportunities were scarce.

lines.japanese:
自宅は塀で覆われている。
　遊びにも行かない。
lines.english: Their home was enclosed by walls. They never went out to play.

lines.japanese:
広い庭に忍び込むのも、釘を刺されていてはやり
にくい。
lines.english: After that warning, he could hardly bring himself to sneak into the sprawling garden.

lines.japanese:
学校でキャッチするしかない。
　逃すわけにはいかない。
　もはや忍も意地になっている。
lines.english: He had no choice but to intercept them at school. He could not let this chance slip away. By now, Shinobu was simply being stubborn.

lines.japanese: （なんとか……友達に……）
lines.english: (Somehow… I have to make friends with them…)

lines.japanese: 友情は戦いだ。
lines.english: Friendship was war.
“Hm—”

lines.japanese:
出てきた。
　正門前から、ターゲットの下校を確認した。
lines.english: There she was. From his post by the front gate, he confirmed that his target was on her way home.

lines.japanese:
塚本斎の姿がない。
　忍の胸はいよいよ高鳴る。
lines.english: Itsuki Tsukamoto was nowhere in sight. Shinobu’s heart beat faster still.

lines.japanese: （邪魔者ナシ）
lines.english: (No one in my way.)

lines.japanese:
物陰を出て、ずいずいと進む。
　葉子の隣に誰かいた。
　少女だ。
lines.english: He emerged from hiding and marched forward. Someone was beside Youko. A girl.

lines.japanese:
手を繋いでいる。
　前後にぷらぷら振って、いかにも仲が良さそうだ
った。
lines.english: They were holding hands. They swung their joined hands back and forth and looked very close.

lines.japanese:
（？？？……友達いるんじゃないか……
　塚本葉子―――）
lines.english: (???… You already have a friend… Youko Tsukamoto—)

lines.japanese:
出鼻を挫かれ、高まった意気だけが未練たらしく
忍を前に押し出した。
lines.english: Wrong-footed at the outset, Shinobu was pushed onward only by the lingering force of his resolve.

lines.japanese:
人がいては、切り出しにくい話だ。
　こうなれば、せめて相手くらいは確認しておこう
と考えた。
lines.english: It was a difficult subject to raise with someone else present. At the very least, he decided, he would find out who the other person was.

lines.japanese: 「みんなで食べようチョココルネー♪」
lines.english: “Chocolate cornets for everyone—♪”

lines.japanese: 「コルネー」
lines.english: “Cornets!”

lines.japanese: あずさ＆葉子だった。
lines.english: It was Azusa and Youko.

lines.japanese:
忍は脱力しつつ、余勢でつかつか通り過ぎた。
　校舎に入ってしまう。
lines.english: Shinobu sagged, but his momentum carried him straight past them. He ended up inside the school building.
“…Wh-why…?”

lines.japanese:
こういう外し方はたまらない。
　おそるおそる、頭だけ突き出して二人を観察した。
lines.english: He couldn't stand being wrong-footed like this. He timidly poked his head out and watched the two girls.

lines.japanese: （すっかり打ち解けている……）
lines.english: (They're completely at ease together…)

lines.japanese:
小さな女の子二人。
　まるで幼なじみのように睦まじく見える。
lines.english: Two little girls. They looked as close as if they'd grown up together.

lines.japanese: （あずさが……友達になってる……？）
lines.english: (Azusa… made a friend…?)

lines.japanese: （うわあ）
lines.english: (Whoa.)

lines.japanese:
今の忍には、処理しきれない情報だった。
　呆然としていると斎が駆けてきた。
　二人分の鞄を背負っている。
lines.english: It was more than Shinobu could process just then. As he stood there dazed, Itsuki came running up. He had two schoolbags slung over his shoulders.

lines.japanese: 忍を認め、少し眉根を寄せて、
lines.english: He recognized Shinobu and frowned slightly.

lines.japanese: 「……い、妹を見なかったか？　まさか？」
lines.english: “…H-have you seen my sister? Don't tell me—”

lines.japanese:
忍は首を振った。
　二人の去った方向を指さす。
lines.english: Shinobu shook his head. He pointed in the direction the two girls had gone.

lines.japanese:
「いさましそうな小さな女の子と一緒に、手を繋い
　で帰っていった」
lines.english: “She went home holding hands with a little girl who looked rather gallant.”

lines.japanese: 「む……なんだと？」
lines.english: “Hm… What did you say?”

lines.japanese: 礼も言わず、斎は追いかけていった。
lines.english: Without so much as a thank-you, Itsuki ran after them.

lines.japanese: （あの様子からするに、イレギュラーだったわけだ）
lines.english: (Judging by that reaction, this was unexpected.)

lines.japanese:
忍はもはや空気を抜かれた風船のようで、追跡す
る気力もなかった。
lines.english: By now Shinobu felt like a deflated balloon, without even the energy to follow them.

lines.japanese:
一つ言えること。それは。
　忍の気になっていた女の子は、あずさに取られて
しまったということだ―――
lines.english: One thing, at least, was clear. The girl Shinobu had been thinking about had been stolen away by Azusa—

lines.japanese:
他の二人も、同様の思いに浸っていたのか。
　かけられる言葉はなかった。
lines.english: Were the other two lost in the same thoughts? No one said anything.

lines.japanese:
斎はもともとにしても、葉子も静かに座って、上
空を薄目で見ている。
lines.english: Itsuki's silence was nothing new, but even Youko sat quietly, gazing upward through narrowed eyes.

lines.japanese:
兄の静かなる様はいつも大差ないのだが、僅かな
口元の歪み―――それを笑みと認識するのは素人に
は困難だ―――が今日は確認できる。
lines.english: Itsuki's stillness was much the same as ever. Today, though, he wore the faintest twist at the corner of his mouth—too slight to be recognized as a smile by an untrained eye.

lines.japanese:
上機嫌なのだろう。
　良い放課後。
　騒いで、落ち着いて、紅茶もうまい。
lines.english: He must have been in a good mood. A good afternoon. A little uproar, a little peace, and good tea.

lines.japanese:
粗大ゴミの話は楽しい。
　なんといってもタダで、若者の財政事情を圧迫し
ないということもあるが。
lines.english: Bulky trash was fun to talk about. Not least because it was free and placed no strain on a young person's budget.

lines.japanese:
宝探しをしている気分にさせてくれる。
　そうやって秘密基地は増築されてきたし、これか
らも当分はされねばならない。
lines.english: It made them feel like treasure hunters. That was how the secret base had grown, and how, for some time yet, it would have to keep growing.

lines.japanese: 忍は唐突に、千金にも値する価値を実感した。
lines.english: All at once, Shinobu felt the worth of something beyond price.

lines.japanese: 今という瞬間。
lines.english: The present moment.

lines.japanese:
胸が優しく搾られる。
　甘えにも似た感情。
　涙が出そうななほど貴い。
lines.english: His heart tightened gently. A feeling almost like the urge to lean on someone. So precious it nearly brought tears to his eyes.

lines.japanese:
肺腑からもぎとられた一房の吐息。
　音もなく大地に吸い取られた。
lines.english: A single wisp of breath, torn from the depths of his lungs, vanished soundlessly into the earth.

lines.japanese:
その様子に、斎が気付く。
　さすがに照れくさいのか、忍は神経伝達速度を加
速して身体各部のコンディションを平常域に戻す。
lines.english: Itsuki noticed. Perhaps embarrassed at being seen, Shinobu boosted the speed of his neural signals and returned every part of his body to normal operating parameters.

lines.japanese:
と書くと物々しいが、単に慌てて取り繕っただけ
のこと。
lines.english: Put that way, it sounded dramatic. All he had done was hurriedly compose himself.

lines.japanese:
末端神経『全員』で一斉に恥じ入るだけのことで
ある。
lines.english: Every one of his peripheral nerves blushed in unison.

lines.japanese:
忍は傍目には、平常心を失わないタイプに見える。
　実際は、わずかなことで動揺してしまう人間である。
lines.english: To an observer, Shinobu looked like the sort who never lost his composure. In truth, the smallest thing could unsettle him.

lines.japanese: それがなかなか表に出ない。
lines.english: It simply rarely showed.

lines.japanese:
出ないが、しかし斎は彼なりの怪訝そうな顔を忍
に向けた。
lines.english: It didn't show—but Itsuki still turned to Shinobu with what passed, for him, as a puzzled look.

lines.japanese: あずさが戻る。
lines.english: Azusa returned.

lines.japanese: 「ヤー、あたしそろそろ帰るね。門限やばい」
lines.english: “Well, I should get home. It's almost curfew.”

lines.japanese: 忍らもちょうど紅茶を飲み干したところだった。
lines.english: Shinobu and the others had just finished their tea.

lines.japanese:
三者のアイコンタクト。
　言葉なくまとまる。
lines.english: The three exchanged glances. Without a word, they reached agreement.

lines.japanese: 三人はいっせいに立ち上がる。
lines.english: All three stood at once.

lines.japanese: 「僕らも一緒に帰るよ」
lines.english: “We'll walk home with you.”

lines.japanese: 「うん！」
lines.english: “Okay!”

lines.japanese:
満ち足りた笑顔。
　四人は帰り支度をはじめた。
lines.english: A perfectly contented smile. The four began getting ready to leave.

lines.japanese: 「目いたい」
lines.english: “My eyes hurt.”

lines.japanese:
一行の向こう先、落日の断片が強く煌めく。
　熱のない火で街が燃えているよう。
　あずさが苦痛を訴えた原因もその強い光だ。
lines.english: Ahead of them, a shard of the setting sun blazed fiercely. The city seemed ablaze in a fire without heat. That harsh glare had made Azusa's eyes hurt.

lines.japanese: 「直視しない。視力落ちる」
lines.english: “Don’t look straight at it. It’ll hurt your eyesight.”
“Right…”

lines.japanese: しぶしぶした目を、手の甲でこするあずさ。
lines.english: Azusa rubbed her smarting eyes with the back of her hand.

lines.japanese: 「あ。あずさんあずさん」
lines.english: “Oh. Azzy, Azzy.”

lines.japanese: 「うい、なになに？」
lines.english: “Yeah? What is it?”

lines.japanese: 「すごいの手に入れてしまった模様」
lines.english: “It would appear I've gotten my hands on something remarkable.”

lines.japanese: 鞄の中身をちらりと見せる。
lines.english: She let Azusa peek inside the bag.

lines.japanese: 「あ！　売り切れてたやつ！」
lines.english: “Oh! The one that was sold out!”

lines.japanese: 「二つ買えたから、一つあげる」
lines.english: “I managed to buy two, so one is yours.”

lines.japanese: 何かを手渡す。
lines.english: Youko handed something over.

lines.japanese:
「うわー、いいの？　ありやとー！
　だからヨコさん好きー！」
lines.english: “Wow, really? Thank yooou! This is why I love you, Youko!”
“Blush.”

lines.japanese: 「……何もらったの？」
lines.english: “…What did you get?”

lines.japanese:
あずさはさっと背後に隠した。
　背中はあずさの、一時隠し場所である。
　子供の頃からそうだ。
lines.english: Azusa whisked it behind her back. Her back was her makeshift hiding place. It had been ever since she was little.

lines.japanese: 「ヒミツ」
lines.english: “Secret.”

lines.japanese: 「えちぃな響き……」
lines.english: “That sounds dirty…”
“…What?”

lines.japanese: 忍にはわからないことだ。
lines.english: Shinobu didn’t understand that.

lines.japanese: 「とにかくないしょ」
lines.english: “Anyway, it's a secret.”

lines.japanese: 「ん、いいけど……ははは」
lines.english: “Mm. All right… Ha ha ha.”

lines.japanese: （あずさに内緒にされた……）
lines.english: (Azusa kept a secret from me…)

lines.japanese: ちょっぴりショック。
lines.english: A little shock.
“…What is it?”

lines.japanese: こっそり葉子に問いかける。
lines.english: He whispered the question to Youko.

lines.japanese: 「だめです。言えないです」
lines.english: “No. I cannot tell you.”

lines.japanese: 「あー、こっそりきいたらだめだってばぁ！」
lines.english: “Hey, no fair asking her in secret!”

lines.japanese: 「でも気になるよ。ねぇ？」
lines.english: “But I'm curious. Aren't you?”
“……” (affirmative)

lines.japanese: 「乙女の恥ずかしい秘密ですから」
lines.english: “It's a maiden's embarrassing secret.”
“Right.”

lines.japanese: すでにブツは鞄に収納されてしまっていた。
lines.english: The item was already tucked away in her bag.

lines.japanese: 「……気になる」
lines.english: “…I'm curious.”

lines.japanese:
「男の子が買っても仕方ないものだよー。とにかく
　気にしない！　気にしなーい！」
lines.english: “It'd be no use to a boy anyway. So forget about it! Forget it!”

lines.japanese: 「わかったよう」
lines.english: “Okaaay.”

lines.japanese:
何か協定があるようで。
　忍の威光も通じない。
　わきあいあい、四人は帰路につく。
lines.english: There seemed to be some sort of pact between them. Even Shinobu's authority counted for nothing against it. The four set off for home in cheerful accord.

lines.japanese: 偏りのある『わきあいあい』ではある。
lines.english: Admittedly, the accord was somewhat lopsided.

lines.japanese:
それでも何てことのない日常の、他愛もない一幕
を―――忍は愛しく思う。
lines.english: Even so, Shinobu cherished this trivial little scene from an ordinary day.

lines.japanese: 貴宮忍は、空が嫌いだ。
lines.english: Shinobu Atemiya hates the sky.

lines.japanese: 嫌悪感にもいろいろな種類がある。
lines.english: Disgust comes in many forms.

lines.japanese:
対人関係における嫌い。
　苛立ちを感じるレベルの嫌い。
　味覚に根ざした食物の好き嫌い。
lines.english: Dislike of another person. Dislike intense enough to become irritation. Likes and dislikes rooted in taste: food preferences.

lines.japanese:
忍が空に懐くそれは、生理的な嫌悪である。
　鱗翅目の幼虫が蝟集している様を見た、少女のそ
れに近い。
lines.english: What Shinobu feels toward the sky is visceral revulsion. It resembles the revulsion a girl might feel at the sight of lepidopteran larvae clustered together.

lines.japanese:
しかし最初から嫌っていたわけではない。
　昔は憧れを持たないまでも、見上げているだけで
戦慄を味わうことはなかった。
lines.english: But he did not always hate it. He may never have yearned for it, but there was a time when merely looking up did not send a shudder through him.

lines.japanese: ある時から、忍の認識は一変してしまったのだ。
lines.english: At some point, Shinobu's entire perception of it had changed.
“…Ugh.”

lines.japanese: 「どしたの、忍くん？」
lines.english: “What's up, Shinobu?”

lines.japanese:
家を出てくるなり、ＵＦＯでも見つけたかのよう

　オレだって食うんだ！」
lines.english: “Pick either the ham or the bacon! I need something to eat too!”

lines.japanese: 「ベーコンはトマトに巻いて等身大にして」
lines.english: “Wrap the bacon around the tomato and make it life-size.”

lines.japanese: 「トマトは一口大に切ってくれる？」
lines.english: “Would you cut the tomato into bite-size pieces?”

lines.japanese: 「だああっ！」
lines.english: “Gaaah!”

lines.japanese: 三人は食料を奪い合った。
lines.english: The three of them fought over the food.

lines.japanese: 「ごちそうさま」
lines.english: “Thanks for the meal.”

lines.japanese: 「ごちそうさま」
lines.english: “Thank you for the meal.”

lines.japanese: 「くそ……安上がりになるはずが……」
lines.english: “Damn it… This was supposed to save me money…”

lines.japanese: 「くんくん、いい匂いがするぞ？」
lines.english: “Sniff, sniff! I smell something good!”

lines.japanese: 童話のような口調であずさがやってきた。
lines.english: Azusa arrived speaking like a character in a fairy tale.

lines.japanese: 「あんたたち、ずいぶん早いのね？」
lines.english: “You three got here awfully early.”

lines.japanese: 「おつかれ」
lines.english: “Welcome back.”

lines.japanese: 「なるほど。三人でこっそり食べたわけだ」
lines.english: “I see. So the three of you had a secret little feast.”

lines.japanese:
「どこの名産品？
　まさか明太子級じゃないわよね？」
lines.english: “What region was the delicacy from? It wasn’t anything on a par with mentaiko, was it?”

lines.japanese: 「安物のハムとかだよ」
lines.english: “Just cheap ham and stuff.”

lines.japanese: 「待て貴様」
lines.english: “Hold it, you bastard.”

lines.japanese: 「……そうとわかっていれば、まっすぐに来た……」
lines.english: “…If I'd known that, I would have come straight here…”

lines.japanese:
線目となって脱力している笛子の隣、大人同士の
会話に興味なさげなあずさが、猫のやり方で顔を拭
いていた。
lines.english: Fueko had gone limp, her eyes narrowed to weary slits. Beside her, Azusa—apparently uninterested in the adults' conversation— washed her face like a cat.

lines.japanese: どこをどう見ても、食後のあずさだ。
lines.english: By every conceivable measure, this was a post-meal Azusa.

lines.japanese: 「笛子さん……餌付けなさいましたね？」
lines.english: “Fueko… You’ve been taming her with food, haven’t you?”

lines.japanese:
「だって家に帰っても食べるものないって言うんだ
　もん。このまま行くって言うんだもん。
　私一人だけで食べられないわよ！」
lines.english: “She said there was nothing to eat when she got home! And she said she was coming straight here! I couldn't sit there and eat all by myself!”

lines.japanese: 「あずさ、なに食べたの？」
lines.english: “Azusa, what did you have?”

lines.japanese: 「スパゲテー」
lines.english: “Spaghetties.”

lines.japanese: 勲章を自慢するように胸を張った。
lines.english: She puffed out her chest as if displaying a medal.

lines.japanese: 「どんなの？」
lines.english: “What kind?”

lines.japanese: 「ケチャップのじゃないやつ」
lines.english: “The kind without ketchup.”

lines.japanese: 「ほら、白いの？」
lines.english: “You know, the white kind?”

lines.japanese: と小首をかしげる。
lines.english: She cocked her head.

lines.japanese: 「うむ。わかった」
lines.english: “Mm. Got it.”

lines.japanese: 笛子に耳打ちする。
lines.english: He whispered in Fueko's ear.

lines.japanese: 「……土偶のランチセット？」
lines.english: “…The Dogu Lunch Set?”
“Yep.”

lines.japanese: 「お金、出そうか？」
lines.english: “Want me to pay for it?”

lines.japanese: 笛子は忍の背中を叩いた。
lines.english: Fueko thumped Shinobu on the back.

lines.japanese: 「けほっ」
lines.english: “Koff.”

lines.japanese: 「気遣い無用」
lines.english: “No need to worry about it.”

lines.japanese: 「……あんがと」
lines.english: “…Thanks.”

lines.japanese: 一転して、大声で笛子は言う。
lines.english: Then, in a sudden reversal, Fueko raised her voice.

lines.japanese: 「だって、あずさはみんなの共有物でしょ？」
lines.english: “After all, Azusa belongs to all of us, doesn't she?”

lines.japanese: 「そうだね」
lines.english: “That's true.”

lines.japanese: 「ぬぇッ！？」
lines.english: “Nweh!?”

lines.japanese: 「おいっす」
lines.english: “Yo.”
“…” (raises hand)

lines.japanese:
最後は塚本兄妹だった。
　これで、全員。
lines.english: Last to arrive were the Tsukamoto siblings. And now everyone was there.

lines.japanese:
「……語学部のカリキュラムからも、中国語科が
　大幅に外されるみたいね。
　本当にやるとは思わなかったけれど」
lines.english: “…It seems they are also making drastic cuts to Chinese in the language department's curriculum. I never thought they would truly go through with it.”

lines.japanese:
「いや、別に教師が家族だからってどうにかなるっ
　てわけじゃ……仮に試験が事前にわかったとして
　も、他の教科までわかるわけじゃないしさ」
lines.english: “No, having a teacher in the family doesn't mean I can do anything about it… Even if I somehow knew what was on one exam in advance, that wouldn't tell me what was on the others.”

lines.japanese:
「学校も無理矢理受験させようって空気作ってて、
　息が詰まるというか……」
lines.english: “The school keeps building this atmosphere where we're all forced to take entrance exams. It's suffocating…”

lines.japanese:
「なんか、ちょっといるけどね。クラスでも。
　ほとんどオトナのオンナ化してる人。
　あれどうやってんだろうね？」
lines.english: “There are a few in my class, though. Girls who've practically turned into Grown Women already. How do they even do that?”

lines.japanese: 「……ま、それで楽になるなら結構なんだがな」
lines.english: “…Well, if it makes things easier for them, good for them.”

lines.japanese: 会話それ自体は、特に意味のあるものでもない。
lines.english: The conversation itself was of no particular consequence.

lines.japanese: 反して会話という行為自体には、大きな意味がある。
lines.english: The fact that they were talking, on the other hand, mattered a great deal.

lines.japanese: 彼ら七人の関係は、そう理解するのがいいだろう。
lines.english: That was the best way to understand the bond among the seven of them.

lines.japanese:
成績。
　服装。
　食事。
lines.english: Grades. Clothes. Food.

lines.japanese:
娯楽。
　話題は転々と移ろう。
　そして七人も常に輪になっているわけでもない。
lines.english: Entertainment. The conversation wandered ceaselessly from subject to subject. Nor were the seven of them always gathered in a circle.

lines.japanese:
飲み物を作りに席を立つ者がいて、本棚の前で本
をめくる者がいて……。
lines.english: One person rose to make a drink, while another stood at the bookshelf leafing through a book…

lines.japanese:
相互の関係に強制感は見られない。
　それぞれは勝手に行動している。
lines.english: There was nothing forced about the way they related to one another. Each simply did as they pleased.

lines.japanese:
あずさの行動などは特に動物的だ。
　さしあたって今は、沙也加の髪を三つ編みにして
いる。
lines.english: Azusa's behavior was particularly animal-like. Just then, she happened to be braiding Sayaka's hair.

lines.japanese: 「沙也ちんの髪、やわっこいなー」
lines.english: “Your hair's so soft, Saya.”

lines.japanese:
「そうだけど、ユーラシア衛生支援機関の誕生には
　国家間の感情的な動きがあったのは確かよ」
lines.english: “That is true, but there is no question that emotion between nations played a role in creating the Eurasian Health Support Agency.”

lines.japanese: その沙也加は笛子と討論している。
lines.english: Sayaka, meanwhile, was locked in debate with Fueko.

lines.japanese:
「そうなんだけどね。いや、あなたの言うこともわ
　かるけど」
lines.english: “I know. No, I understand what you're saying, too.”

lines.japanese:
「でもやっぱり、アメリカ主導の保健政策を国連が
　鵜呑みにしたってのが、実際多くの国を刺激した
　わけだし」
lines.english: “But the UN swallowing an American-led public-health policy whole was still what provoked so many countries in the first place.”

lines.japanese:
「そうね。一連の流れの中で、適切で公明正大な
　プロセスなんてどこにもないものね」
lines.english: “Yes. There was no proper, transparent process anywhere in that entire chain of events.”

lines.japanese:
「善悪は置いておくにしてもね。結局隠そうとして
　バレちゃったわけで。そういう弱みを見たら、
　誰しも突きたくなるわ」
lines.english: “Leaving right and wrong aside, they tried to cover it up and got caught. Anyone who spots a weakness like that wants to exploit it.”

lines.japanese: 「何の話してんの？」
lines.english: “What are you talking about?”

lines.japanese: 「大人げないケンカの話」
lines.english: “A childish fight between grown-ups.”

lines.japanese:
「そこにるみ子って女がつらら片手に飛び出してき
　て、冷やしてやると叫びながらネックレスを引き
　ちぎってだな―――」
lines.english: “Then this woman named Rumiko comes charging out with an icicle in one hand, yells that she'll cool him off, and rips the necklace away—”

lines.japanese:
「でも、そのるみ子ってそんな悪い事したのかな？
　心情的には理解できる部分も多いように思うけど
　……」
lines.english: “But did this Rumiko really do anything so terrible? I think I can understand a lot of how she felt, though …”

lines.japanese:
「甘い、このケースではそういう甘さがまさにるみ
　子をつけ上がらせたんだ。非情になれ、シノ。
　機械になるんだ」
lines.english: “Too soft. In a case like this, that softness is exactly what emboldened Rumiko. Be merciless, Shino. Turn yourself into a machine.”

lines.japanese:
「斎も、起こるかも知れない事を警戒しすぎて被害
　者側に責任を発生させるのではなく、もっと根本
　的な対処が必要だって言ってる」
lines.english: “Itsuki says we shouldn't shift responsibility onto the victim by obsessing over everything that might happen. We need to address the problem at its root.”

lines.japanese:
「……そんなのは理想だぜ。いいか、るみ子事件の
　焦点で見逃せないのが、現場に配置されたクーラ
　ーボックスとポットだ」
lines.english: “…That's idealism. Listen: the critical detail in the Rumiko case is the cooler and thermos placed at the scene.”

lines.japanese: 「これはるみ子の私物であることがわかっている」
lines.english: “We know both belonged to Rumiko.”

lines.japanese:
「クーラーでつららを保管、使用後、これをポット
　に入れて証拠隠滅をはかるつもりだったことも後
　に判明している。計画的だったわけだ」
lines.english: “It was later established that she meant to keep the icicle in the cooler, then put it in the thermos after use to destroy the evidence. This was premeditated.”

lines.japanese:
男性陣は得体の知れない話をしている。
　統一性のない会話と、ゆるめられた空間の温度が、
不思議と調和していた。
lines.english: The boys, meanwhile, were discussing something altogether inscrutable. The disjointed conversations and the easy warmth of the room harmonized in a curious way.
“Hm.”

lines.japanese:
葉子は目をすがめる。
　六人が雑多に話し込んでいる様子を、観察するよ
うに。
lines.english: Youko narrowed her eyes. She seemed to be studying the other six as they chatted away about this and that.

lines.japanese: 両手の指で四角を作り、覗き込んで一言。
lines.english: She made a frame with the fingers of both hands, peered through it, and said one word:

lines.japanese: 「激写」
lines.english: “Snapshot.”

lines.japanese: 目を閉じて、網膜に焼きつけた。
lines.english: She closed her eyes and burned the image onto her retinas.

lines.japanese: 「どしたの？」
lines.english: “What are you doing?”

lines.japanese: 「大変なことが」
lines.english: “Something terrible.”

lines.japanese: 「なに？」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 「平和すぎます」
lines.english: “It is far too peaceful.”
“…Oh. Right.”

lines.japanese:
忍は脱力した。
　しかし言われてみれば、確かに、そうなのだ。
lines.english: Shinobu sagged. Yet now that she mentioned it, she was certainly right.

lines.japanese: 「と、仕事だ。行ってくる。じゃあなおまえら」
lines.english: “Oh, work. I'm off. Later, you lot.”

lines.japanese: 「さて、そろそろ戻るわ。じゃあね」
lines.english: “Well, I should be getting back too. See you.”

lines.japanese: 「お先に」
lines.english: “I will head out, then.”

lines.japanese:
時間とともに、一人去り、二人去り。
　夕方を待たずして、四人だけになった。
lines.english: As time passed, one left, then another. Before evening fell, only four remained.

lines.japanese:
特に口数の多い二人が帰ったため、不意に空間は
静寂に満ちる。
lines.english: With the two most talkative members gone, silence abruptly filled the room.

lines.japanese:
斎と忍は、既存のゲームに独自の解釈とルールを
加え複雑化したハイブリッドな遊戯、チェ棋に耽っ
ている。
lines.english: Itsuki and Shinobu were engrossed in Chessogi, a hybrid game they had created by complicating existing games with their own interpretations and rules.

lines.japanese:
今、盤面という戦場では互いの技術点に２Ｄ－５
の地形補整を受けた『歩』と『ポーン』が、ビショ
ップや金銀などのアデプトユニットによる、
lines.english: On the board's battlefield, a shogi pawn and a chess pawn—each under a 2D−5 terrain modifier to its skill score—faced one another without magical support from adept units such as bishops, gold generals, or silver generals.

lines.japanese:
魔術支援を受けない状態での極めてタイトな斬激戦
を繰り広げている。
lines.english: They were locked in an extraordinarily close exchange of slashing attacks.

lines.japanese:
相互に間断なくクリティカルを出しているが、互
いの領土（三段目）外での戦闘であり、回避率は高
く決め手に欠ける。
lines.english: Both sides kept rolling criticals, but the battle lay outside either player's territory—the third rank—so evasion was high, and neither could land the decisive blow.

lines.japanese:
しかし相互に桂馬やルークなどをサクリファイス
してまで狙っている土地であり、退くという選択肢
はあり得ない。
lines.english: Yet both were after this ground even at the cost of sacrificing knights, rooks, and more. Retreat was unthinkable.

lines.japanese:
ダイスを転がす乾いた音が、延々と繰り返されて
いる。
lines.english: The dry clatter of rolling dice went on without end.

lines.japanese:
ミドルゲームの終局であり、この戦闘次第では速
やかに寄せに入っていくことになるだろう。
lines.english: The middlegame was nearing its end. Depending on this battle, the game might proceed swiftly into a mating attack.

lines.japanese:
戦局を決定づける前線兵士の一騎打ちを、しかし
あずさはこれっぽっちも理解していない。
lines.english: Azusa understood absolutely nothing of the foot soldiers' duel that would decide the course of the war.

lines.japanese: 「ふわら」
lines.english: “Fwuaaah.”

lines.japanese: 欠伸なども出る。
lines.english: She even yawned.

lines.japanese:
以前は、盤面と見ればダイブしてダイナシにして
いたあずさだ。
lines.english: There had been a time when, at the sight of any game board, Azusa would dive onto it and ruin everything.

lines.japanese:
一度、忍が本気でふてくされてから、ビビッてや
ることはなくなった。
lines.english: Then one day Shinobu genuinely sulked over it, and that frightened her out of doing it again.

lines.japanese:
別に嫌がらせでやっていたわけではない。
　細密に配置され、動く駒を見ていると、体がムズ
ムズしてくるのだった。
lines.english: She had never meant to be a nuisance. The sight of all those pieces, intricately arranged and moving about, made her itch all over.

lines.japanese:
メチャクチャにしてやりたい。
　そんなどす黒い欲望が生まれるのだ。
　少年的な気質かも知れない。
lines.english: She wanted to wreck the whole arrangement. A pitch-black urge would well up inside her. Perhaps it was her boyish side.

lines.japanese:
ついていたらまずかったかも知れない。
　とにかく今も見ていると、劣情がこらえられなく
なる。
lines.english: It might have been trouble if she'd had the equipment to match. In any case, even now the sight of it made the base urge almost impossible to suppress.

lines.japanese:
だからあまり見ない。
　ゆえに暇であった。
lines.english: So she tried not to look. Consequently, she was bored.

lines.japanese: 気を紛らわす方法を考えて、おやつでもと思ったが。
lines.english: She tried to think of a distraction. Maybe a snack. But—

lines.japanese:
衣服の下に両手を入れて腹部の肉をつまんでみる。
　つまもうとしてみる。
lines.english: She slipped both hands beneath her clothes and pinched at the flesh of her stomach. Or tried to pinch it.

lines.japanese: ない。
lines.english: There was nothing there.

lines.japanese:
つまむほどの脂肪は乗ってない。
　むりやり掴めば皮膚をつねるように痛む。
　大丈夫、のはずである。
lines.english: There was not enough fat to get a grip on. Forcing it only hurt where she pinched the skin. She was safe. Probably.

lines.japanese:
しかし本当に大丈夫なのだろうか？
　周囲にいる少女たちの、ダイエットにかける情熱
の影響を、あずさはきっちり受けている。
lines.english: But was she truly safe? The zeal with which the girls around her pursued their diets had thoroughly rubbed off on Azusa.

lines.japanese: 肥満してしまったら―――
lines.english: But if she got fat—

lines.japanese: ドッドッドッドッっと心臓が早鐘を打ち出した。
lines.english: Her heart began hammering: thud-thud-thud-thud.

lines.japanese:
臆病なあずさは、いつか太ってしまった時のこと
を考えて身を竦ませる。
lines.english: Timid by nature, Azusa shrank at the thought that one day she might put on weight.

lines.japanese:
忍に嫌われる瞬間を妄想して怯える。
　立ちくらみがした。
　恋は凄い力を秘めている。
lines.english: She imagined the moment Shinobu would come to hate her and trembled. Her head spun. Love held tremendous power.

lines.japanese: 時として本能を殺すほど。
lines.english: Sometimes enough to kill instinct itself.

lines.japanese: 「いす寝り……」
lines.english: “Chair nap…”

lines.japanese:
ふらふらとソファに向かった。
　間食をしない方を選んだ。
lines.english: She tottered toward the sofa. She chose not to have a snack.

lines.japanese:
ところで二王態勢を選択した斎はキングと王の二つ
を持つが、その分、飛車・角・ルーク・ビショップ
などの上級ユニットが減らされており攻守に劣る。
lines.english: Itsuki, incidentally, had chosen the Two Kings formation and therefore possessed both a chess king and a shogi king. In exchange, he had fewer advanced units—rooks, bishops, and the like—weakening both offense and defense.

lines.japanese:
斎は質駒の忍側クイーンを奪取するべきかどうか
悩んでいる。
lines.english: Itsuki was debating whether to capture Shinobu's queen, which sat en prise.

lines.japanese:
対して忍は擁した王将のキャスリングするタイミ
ングを狙っている。
lines.english: Shinobu, meanwhile, was watching for the moment to castle with his shogi king.

lines.japanese: ダイスを転がす。
lines.english: The dice rolled.

lines.japanese:
多面ダイス（１～１０）の転がる、乾いた音が重
なった。
lines.english: The dry clatter of polyhedral dice—numbered one through ten—rang out in chorus.
Ten, ten, ten. Minus five.

lines.japanese:
一見して最高数値だが、ルール上これはジョーカー
にも勝る１となる。
lines.english: At first glance, it was the highest possible roll. Under the rules, however, it became a one that outranked even a joker.

lines.japanese:
それはまさに、斎の、キングが、処刑されること
を定める、決定的な、ファンブルと、
lines.english: A decisive fumble—one that ordained the execution of Itsuki's king—and then—

lines.japanese: 忍の手が電光石火で動く。
lines.english: Shinobu's hand moved like lightning.

lines.japanese: 斎がその手首を掴もうとする。ルール違反だ。
lines.english: Itsuki lunged to seize his wrist. That was against the rules.

lines.japanese: あずさの尻が落ちてくる。
lines.english: Azusa's backside descended.

lines.japanese:
盤面に幾重にも塗りこめられた無秩序的な秩序が、
無情極まりないカオスと化した。
　忍ののどを、掠れ気味の悲鳴が通り抜けた。
lines.english: The disorderly order built up across the board, layer by layer, dissolved into the cruelest chaos imaginable. A ragged scream tore through Shinobu's throat.

lines.japanese: 「いたたたたたたたたっ！？」
lines.english: “Ow-ow-ow-ow-ow-ow!?”

lines.japanese:
斎は一瞬だけ、１ミリにも満たないほどの顔面筋
肉の動きで、ニヤリとした。
lines.english: For a single instant, Itsuki moved less than a millimeter's worth of facial muscle. He grinned.

lines.japanese:
「うわあっ、ごめんなさいごめんなさいっ！
　いたたたっ！
　ごめんなさーーーーいっ！！」
lines.english: “Aaah! I'm sorry, I'm sorry! Ow-ow-ow! I'm sooooo sorry!”

lines.japanese: 忍は倒れそうだった。
lines.english: Shinobu nearly collapsed.

lines.japanese:
あずさが本気で泣いていたので、なんとか踏みと
どまった。
lines.english: Azusa was genuinely crying, so he somehow held himself together.

lines.japanese: 「……ダぃＪＯうヴかぃ？」
lines.english: “…A-are y-you o-kay?”
