忍は穏やかに頷いて、葉子を見つめた。
　三十秒我慢して、葉子はしゃっくりをした。
lines.english: Shinobu nodded gently, gazing at Youko. Youko lasted thirty seconds before she hiccupped.

lines.japanese: 「……ゲーム、どうでした？」
lines.english: “…How was the game?”

lines.japanese: 「ええとね……」
lines.english: “Well, you see…”

lines.japanese: ゆっくりと顔をしかめる。
lines.english: He slowly grimaced.

lines.japanese: 「……後味の悪い戦だったよ」
lines.english: “…That war left a bad taste in my mouth.”

lines.japanese:
「生き残ったビショップがＳＡＮ値チェックに失敗
　してさ、圧政を敷く民を殺す妖術にふける……
　もうメチャクチャになったよ」
lines.english: “The surviving bishop failed its SAN check, became a tyrant, and lost itself in sorcery that slaughtered its own people… The whole thing went completely off the rails.”

lines.japanese:
「結局疲弊しちゃって恩恵点も入らなくなって、ア
　デプトも使えなくなるし。まさかあの局面で、斎
　が革命を成功させるとは思わなかったし」
lines.english: “By the end, things were so depleted that the boon points stopped coming, and I couldn't field any more adept units. I never imagined Itsuki would pull off a revolution from that position.”

lines.japanese:
「混迷の時代中に神話崩壊を起こして産業時代は
　はじまるし……技術点４Ｄ補整のポーンはほとんど
　戦車だしもうさんざんさ」
lines.english: “Then the myths collapsed in the middle of the Age of Turmoil, kicking off the Industrial Age… With a 4D modifier to their skill scores, the pawns were practically tanks. The whole thing was awful.”

lines.japanese:
忍の話を、葉子が楽しそうに聞いている。
　この無闇に複雑なゲームは、作った張本人である
忍と斎しか遊べない。
lines.english: Youko listened to Shinobu's account with evident delight. Only its creators, Shinobu and Itsuki, could actually play this absurdly complicated game.

lines.japanese: 「兄は楽しそうでしたか？」
lines.english: “Did my brother seem to be enjoying himself?”

lines.japanese: 「どうだろう。苦しい立場に追い込み続けたから」
lines.english: “Hard to say. I kept forcing him into difficult positions.”

lines.japanese:
「斎は厳しいけどまっすぐだから、ずるい手にすぐ
　引っかかっちゃってね。
　悔しがってるかも知れない」
lines.english: “Itsuki’s tough, but he’s so straightforward that he falls for dirty tricks so easily. He might be frustrated.”

lines.japanese:
「一騎打ち挑むと何の疑問もなく受けるのが斎なん
　だけど、その駒を角でへろっと取ると、よく唖然
　としてるしね」
lines.english: “Challenge him to single combat and he'll accept without a second thought. Then I casually take the piece with a bishop, and he just stares.”

lines.japanese:
「さっきの対局でも―――ええと……
　どうだったかな」
lines.english: “In the match just now—let me see… How did that go again?”

lines.japanese: 細部を説明しようとするが、うまく言葉にできない。
lines.english: He tried to explain the finer points, but could not quite find the words.

lines.japanese: やがてはっとして、
lines.english: Then it struck him.

lines.japanese: 「……あ、退屈じゃない？　こんな話？」
lines.english: “…Oh. Is this stuff boring you?”

lines.japanese: 葉子はカップを両手で強く握りしめた。
lines.english: Youko gripped the cup tightly in both hands.

lines.japanese:
「あの時から、退屈だって思ったことは一度もない
　です」
lines.english: “I haven't been bored once since that day.”
“…That day?”

lines.japanese: 「塀の中から、連れだしてくれた日」
lines.english: “The day you brought me out from behind the walls.”

lines.japanese: 「塀……？　ああ、あれか……」
lines.english: “The walls…? Oh, that…”

lines.japanese: 「……そんなこともあったねぇ」
lines.english: “…Oh, right. That happened.”

lines.japanese: 「かなりありました」
lines.english: “It very much did.”

lines.japanese:
「お屋敷から解放してくれた忍さんに対して、私の
　中の気持ちはすごいことになってます」
lines.english: “My feelings for you, after you freed me from that estate, have grown quite extraordinary.”

lines.japanese:
「た、確かに、葉子に会いに塀の中に忍び込んだこ
　とはあるけどね……」
lines.english: “I-I mean, yes, there was that time I slipped inside the walls to see you…”

lines.japanese: 「そちらの方ではなく、連れだしてくれた方です」
lines.english: “Not that time. I mean the time you took me out.”

lines.japanese: 「……ああ、あれか」
lines.english: “…Oh. That.”

lines.japanese: 手を打つ。
lines.english: He clapped his hands together.

lines.japanese:
「なんか、葉子の家でお家騒動があって、お屋敷か
　ら一気に人がいなくなったんだっけ……」
lines.english: “There was some kind of family upheaval at your house, and all at once the estate emptied out…”

lines.japanese: 「そうです。その日のことです」
lines.english: “Yes. That is the day.”

lines.japanese:
「たまたま遊びに行ったんだよね。そしたらうるさ
　方がいなくなってたから……こりゃ誘おうと」
lines.english: “I happened to come over to play. Everyone who might have objected was gone, so… I thought I'd invite you out.”

lines.japanese: 「……いや、あったね、そんなことも。忘れてた」
lines.english: “…Right. That happened too. I'd forgotten.”

lines.japanese:
「あ、ひどい。忘れてたんですか。
　大幅に傷つきます」
lines.english: “How cruel. You forgot? I am wounded beyond measure.”

lines.japanese: 「ごめんごめん」
lines.english: “Sorry, sorry.”

lines.japanese:
「忍さんとは、そんなお地蔵様のようなお人なので
　す」
lines.english: “That is the sort of person you are, Shinobu. Like a kindly Jizo.”

lines.japanese: 葉子は手と手のしわとしわをあわせた。
lines.english: Youko brought hand to hand, wrinkle to wrinkle.

lines.japanese: （なぜ地蔵―――っ）
lines.english: (Why a Jizo—?)

lines.japanese: 「兄妹ともに感謝しております」
lines.english: “My brother and I are both grateful.”

lines.japanese: 「……まいったな」
lines.english: “…I don't know what to say.”

lines.japanese: 「たまたまだよ、たまたま」
lines.english: “It was just chance. Pure chance.”

lines.japanese:
「たまたま遊びに行ったとき、家のガードがゆるく
　なったんだ」
lines.english: “I happened to visit just when security around your house was lax.”

lines.japanese: 「斎も……理解してくれたしね」
lines.english: “Itsuki… understood too.”

lines.japanese:
「それにあずさだって。あずさがいなかったら、何
　も起こってなかったかも知れない」
lines.english: “Azusa too. If Azusa hadn't been there, maybe none of it would have happened.”

lines.japanese:
「……そうだよ、何も起こらなかったかも知れない
　のに」
lines.english: “…Right. Maybe nothing would have happened at all.”

lines.japanese:
「そうかもしれないです。いろいろな偶然の結果な
　のかも。何も起こらなかったのかも知れない」
lines.english: “Perhaps so. It may all have been the result of many separate coincidences. Perhaps nothing would have happened.”

lines.japanese: 「でもね忍さん」
lines.english: “But you see, Shinobu.”

lines.japanese:
じっと。
　瞳と瞳が、接続される。
　何かが曖昧になる。
lines.english: Stillness. Their eyes connected. Something blurred.

lines.japanese: 「ぼんやりしてる私でも、わかることがあるんです」
lines.english: “Even someone as hazy as I am can understand certain things.”
“Youko…?”

lines.japanese:
「がんじがらめだった私たち兄妹を、忍さんがすく
　いあげてくれたから」
lines.english: “Because when my brother and I were bound hand and foot, you scooped us up.”

lines.japanese:
軽い頭痛が走った。
　不快というほどでもない。
　ただ、忘却した罪を告げるような痛みだ。
lines.english: A mild pain flashed through his head. Not quite unpleasant. Only a pain that seemed to speak of a forgotten sin.

lines.japanese:
「そう簡単ではないはずの因習と執念を、断ち切っ
　て」
lines.english: “You cut through old customs and obsessions that should not have been so easy to break.”

lines.japanese:
「確かに……手は差し伸べたけど、でも……
　そこまでのことは……」
lines.english: “I did… reach out a hand, but still… It wasn't anything so grand…”

lines.japanese:
「それで……君たちが完全にあの家から解放された
　わけじゃない。今だって……」
lines.english: “And that… didn't completely free either of you from that house. Even now…”

lines.japanese: 「今だって……」
lines.english: “Even now…”

lines.japanese: 「……全部が、解決したわけじゃ、ないわけで……」
lines.english: “…It's not as if everything's been resolved…”

lines.japanese:
「きっと…………これから……もしかすると、
　ひどいことが起こるかも知れないのに……」
lines.english: “I'm sure…… from here on… something terrible might still happen…”

lines.japanese: 頭を抱え込む。
lines.english: He clutched his head.

lines.japanese: そんな忍の髪に、葉子は指をかき混ぜた。
lines.english: Youko ran her fingers through Shinobu's hair.

lines.japanese:
「確かに、今はそうでしょうね。
　でも、忍さんは未来を知らない」
lines.english: “That may well be true for now. But you do not know the future.”
“…The future?”

lines.japanese: 「私は未来を知る女」
lines.english: “I am a woman who knows the future.”

lines.japanese:
聞き間違いかと思った。
　あるいは、いつもの冗談かと。
lines.english: He wondered whether he had misheard. Or whether this was one of her usual jokes.

lines.japanese:
しかし葉子の顔は真剣そのもので、圧倒されるほ
どに蒼く月光を弾いていた。
lines.english: But Youko’s face was utterly serious, reflecting the moonlight in blue so intense it overwhelmed him.

lines.japanese:
やがて葉子は、言葉を吟味するようにゆっくり話
し出す。
lines.english: At length, Youko began to speak slowly, as though weighing each word.

lines.japanese: 「実は……私は未来から来た存在なんです」
lines.english: “The truth is… I am a being from the future.”

lines.japanese: 「だから先に起こる出来事がよくわかる」
lines.english: “That is why I know so well what is going to happen.”

lines.japanese: 「私たちは、忍さんに救われるのです」
lines.english: “You will save us.”

lines.japanese: 「あの古くて大きな家から」
lines.english: “From that old and enormous house.”

lines.japanese:
荒唐無稽すぎて忍も判断がつかない。
　言葉も出ない。
lines.english: The claim was too outlandish for Shinobu to know what to make of it. He had no words.

lines.japanese:
「これは決定事項なのです。どうあっても私たちは
　忍さんに救われるつもりです」
lines.english: “It has already been decided. No matter what happens, we fully intend to have you save us.”

lines.japanese: 「そ、そうなんだ……凄いね……」
lines.english: “I-is that right…? That's amazing…”

lines.japanese:
「イカしてますよね。ですから、そのときは頑張っ
　てください。期待してます」
lines.english: “Pretty cool, isn't it? So when the time comes, do your best. I'm counting on you.”

lines.japanese: 「は、はい……がんばるます」
lines.english: “Y-yes… I'll do my very bestest.”

lines.japanese: 「ただ」
lines.english: “But—”

lines.japanese: 表情が引き締められる。
lines.english: Her expression tightened.

lines.japanese:
「この先、忍さんはどんな選択をしてもいいと思っ
　てます」
lines.english: “From here on, I believe you may make whatever choice you wish.”

lines.japanese:
「ただ……その中の一つには、私たちをもう一度て
　のひらにすくいあげる道筋があるということだけ、
　知っていてください」
lines.english: “Just know… that among those choices is a path that will let you scoop us up into the palm of your hand once more.”

lines.japanese: 「……本当に未来から……？」
lines.english: “…You truly came from the future…?”

lines.japanese:
「はい。意識だけ入れ替わっているのです。
　失笑ものですよね」
lines.english: “Yes. Only my consciousness has traded places. Quite laughable, isn't it?”

lines.japanese: 「え、いや、なにがなんだか……」
lines.english: “Uh, no, I don't understand any of this…”

lines.japanese:
「秘密道具とかはありませんが……
　秘蜜道具なら……」
lines.english: “I possess no secret gadgets… Though I do have intimate ones…”

lines.japanese: 「はい？」
lines.english: “Excuse me?”

lines.japanese: 「なんでもありません」
lines.english: “Nothing.”

lines.japanese:
「と、とにかく頑張ってみる……たぶん、頑張れる
　とは思う」
lines.english: “A-anyway, I'll try my best… I think I can probably manage that.”

lines.japanese: 「ええ、知ってます」
lines.english: “Yes. I know.”

lines.japanese:
笑う。
　これ以上はないほどの、最上限の幸福をたたえて。
lines.english: She smiled. Her smile brimmed with the greatest happiness imaginable.

lines.japanese: 「では私は未来人なので未来に帰ります」
lines.english: “As I am a person from the future, I shall now return to the future.”

lines.japanese:
「明日からの私は、ちゃんと現在を生きる私、未完
　成な私です」
lines.english: “Starting tomorrow, I will be the me who lives properly in the present—the unfinished me.”

lines.japanese:
「たまたま、ここで出会ってしまった……本来は出
　会うことのない二人でした」
lines.english: “We met here by chance… Two people who would never normally meet.”

lines.japanese: 「あのさ、それって……予知とかじゃなくて？」
lines.english: “Wait, couldn't that just be… precognition?”

lines.japanese: 「まあ、それでもいいんですが」
lines.english: “Well, that explanation will do as well.”

lines.japanese: 苦笑するしかない。
lines.english: All he could do was smile wryly.

lines.japanese:
「葉子の言うことは、すごく難しいね。
　おもしろいけど」
lines.english: “The things you say are really complicated. Interesting, though.”

lines.japanese:
「忍さんは二度、私たちを助けました。
　一度目は幼い日々に、そしてもう一度はこれから
　すぐ先に」
lines.english: “You have saved us twice. Once in our childhood, and once again in the days immediately ahead.”

lines.japanese: 「すぐ、先？」
lines.english: “Just ahead?”

lines.japanese: 「失敗は、万に一つもありませんのでご安心」
lines.english: “There is not even a one-in-ten-thousand chance of failure. Rest easy.”

lines.japanese: 「……うーん」
lines.english: “…Hmm.”

lines.japanese: まったく理解できなかった。
lines.english: He understood none of it.

lines.japanese: 「……ふふふ」
lines.english: “…Heh heh.”

lines.japanese:
できなかったが、葉子が楽しそうだったので、
どうでもよくなった。
lines.english: He still did not understand. But Youko seemed to be enjoying herself, so it no longer mattered.

lines.japanese: 「それなら安心だ」
lines.english: “That's a relief, then.”

lines.japanese: 突然、瞼が重くなった。
lines.english: All at once, his eyelids grew heavy.
“…Mm… Sleepy…”

lines.japanese: 「もうこんな時間ですね」
lines.english: “It's gotten quite late.”

lines.japanese: 「ここで寝ますか？」
lines.english: “Are you going to sleep here?”

lines.japanese: 悪戯っぽく問いかけてくる。
lines.english: There was mischief in the way she asked.

lines.japanese: 「まさか。帰るよ」
lines.english: “Of course not. I'm going home.”

lines.japanese: 「送ります」
lines.english: “I'll walk you home.”

lines.japanese:
それは逆だな、と思いつつ、急激に薄れていく意
識を、忍は繋ぎ止めることはできなかった。
lines.english: That seemed backward to him, but Shinobu could not hold on to his rapidly fading consciousness.

lines.japanese:
この方法で訪れるのは、二度目だった。
　塀から飛び降り、中庭に立つ。
lines.english: This was the second time he had come this way. He jumped down from the wall and stood in the courtyard.

lines.japanese: 以前に比べて、変わったところがあるわけではない。
lines.english: Nothing seemed particularly different from before.

lines.japanese:
だが子細に観察すると、庭の荒れ具合はすぐに目
についた。
lines.english: But the moment he looked closely, the garden's disrepair was impossible to miss.

lines.japanese:
波を引かれていた砂利は乱れ、植物の枝はほうぼ
うに伸び突出し、池の半分ほどを落ち葉が埋めて水
を腐らせようとしていた。
lines.english: The gravel once raked into waves lay in disorder. Branches thrust out in every direction. Fallen leaves covered half the pond and threatened to turn its water foul.

lines.japanese:
汚れは外の壁にも見て取れ、見ていないところで
まめに掃除がされていたのだとわかる。
lines.english: Even the outer wall was stained; he realized how diligently the place had been cleaned without his noticing.

lines.japanese:
没落とはこういうものなのだと、忍は冷たく理解
した。
lines.english: So this was what a family's decline looked like. Shinobu understood that much with cold detachment.

lines.japanese: そう、今の彼にとって門倉の盛衰などどうでも良い。
lines.english: Yes. By now, the rise or fall of the Kadokuras meant nothing to him.

lines.japanese: 人気もないようなので、堂々と中庭を歩き回った。
lines.english: The place seemed deserted, so he walked openly through the courtyard.

lines.japanese:
建物の中には誰かいるのだろうか。
　気配はほとんど感じない。
lines.english: Was anyone inside the house? There was almost no sign of anyone.

lines.japanese:
斎と葉子が住む以上、無人というわけもないのだ
ろうが。
lines.english: Though with Itsuki and Youko living here, it could not truly be empty.

lines.japanese:
ボールの弾む音が聞こえた。
　忍はそちらに足を向ける。
lines.english: He heard a ball bouncing. Shinobu headed toward the sound.

lines.japanese: いた―――
lines.english: There she was—

lines.japanese:
足下に転がってきたボールを拾い、投げた。
　受け取って……不思議そうな視線を忍に返した。
lines.english: He picked up the ball as it rolled to his feet and tossed it back. She caught it… and gave Shinobu a puzzled look.

lines.japanese:
迷うように、眉が震えた。
　ためらいが唇を無為に開閉させていた。
lines.english: Her brows twitched with uncertainty. Her lips opened and closed in hesitation, producing no words.

lines.japanese:
監禁されて、ろくに感情も発達していない少女相
手に、
lines.english: Faced with a girl who had been kept prisoner and whose emotions had barely developed,

lines.japanese: 忍は緊張していた。
lines.english: Shinobu was nervous.

lines.japanese: 「もう」
lines.english: “Not anymore.”

lines.japanese: 「一人で遊ぶことはないんだ」
lines.english: “You don't have to play alone anymore.”
“…What?”

lines.japanese: 「塀の外に出よう。そこで、何かをしよう」
lines.english: “Let's go outside the walls. We can do something out there.”

lines.japanese: 語るうちに、何を言うべきかわかってきた。
lines.english: As he spoke, he began to understand what he needed to say.

lines.japanese: 「みんなと」
lines.english: “With everyone.”

lines.japanese: 「みんな？」
lines.english: “Everyone?”

lines.japanese: 「紅緒あずさと、キミのお兄さんと、僕だよ」
lines.english: “Azusa Benio, your brother, and me.”

lines.japanese: 「兄さんが、いるの？」
lines.english: “My brother will be there?”

lines.japanese: 「そうだよ」
lines.english: “That's right.”

lines.japanese: 「出るなって言われています」
lines.english: “I was told not to go outside.”

lines.japanese: 「言った人は、今もいるの？」
lines.english: “Is the person who told you that still here?”

lines.japanese: 葉子は首を振る。
lines.english: Youko shook her head.

lines.japanese: 「ならいいじゃないか」
lines.english: “Then it's all right.”

lines.japanese: 「キミのしたいことをすればいいんだ」
lines.english: “You should do whatever you want to do.”

lines.japanese: 「……よく、わからないです」
lines.english: “…I don't really understand.”

lines.japanese: 「高い所に、のぼってみよう」
lines.english: “Let's climb somewhere high.”

lines.japanese: 「高いところ？」
lines.english: “Somewhere high?”

lines.japanese: 「そうしたら、いろいろな形がわかるよ」
lines.english: “Then you'll be able to see all sorts of shapes.”
“Come on—”

lines.japanese: 手を差し出す。
lines.english: He held out his hand.

lines.japanese:
両者の距離は５メートル。
　葉子は硬直したように、佇んでいる。
　動く気配はない。
lines.english: Five meters lay between them. Youko stood as though frozen in place. She showed no sign of moving.

lines.japanese: 「……なにを、したいの？」
lines.english: “…What do you want to do?”

lines.japanese: 「なにをって、だから」
lines.english: “What do I want? I mean—”

lines.japanese: 口ごもる。
lines.english: He faltered.

lines.japanese: 「だから……」
lines.english: “I mean…”

lines.japanese: 何もないのだった。
lines.english: There was nothing.

lines.japanese:
ただ接近したかっただけで。
　すくいあげたかっただけで。
lines.english: He had only wanted to get closer. Only wanted to scoop her up.

lines.japanese: 具体的なプランなど、形作ってはいなかった。
lines.english: He hadn't made any concrete plans.

lines.japanese:
「したいことが、あるとかじゃなくて……
　だから……んー」
lines.english: “It's not like I have some specific thing I want to do… I mean… um.”

lines.japanese:
しきりに頭をかく困窮の様が、原因だったのかも
知れない。
lines.english: Perhaps it was the sight of him scratching his head over and over, at a loss.

lines.japanese:
「そういう難しいことじゃなくて、
　だから……だからさ」
lines.english: “It's not anything complicated. I mean… I mean, you know.”

lines.japanese: 忍は見た。
lines.english: Shinobu saw—

lines.japanese:
うつむき、口に手を当てて、肩を揺らしている少女
の姿を。
lines.english: the girl with her head bowed, one hand over her mouth, her shoulders shaking.

lines.japanese: 最初は泣いているのかと思った。
lines.english: At first he thought she was crying.

lines.japanese: 「おもしろい」
lines.english: “You're funny.”

lines.japanese: 笑っていたのだった。
lines.english: She was laughing.

lines.japanese:
笑う少女。
　困り果てる少年。
lines.english: A girl laughing. A boy utterly at a loss.

lines.japanese:
二人は呆れるほど長い時間、そんな状態を維持し
ていた。
lines.english: They remained that way for an absurdly long time.

lines.japanese:
程度も加減も知らない子供たちの、不器用な出会
いは飴色に濁っている。
lines.english: That awkward meeting of two children who knew neither measure nor restraint is clouded over in amber.

lines.japanese: おそらくは、甘ったるい記憶であるせいだ。
lines.english: Perhaps because the memory is cloyingly sweet.

lines.japanese: 目が覚める。
lines.english: He woke.

lines.japanese:
自室の殺風景さに、多幸感が希釈されていく。
　ここが現実の世界だと理解した。
lines.english: The starkness of his room diluted his euphoria. He understood: this was the real world.
“A dream…”

lines.japanese:
最近、夢ばかり見る。
　過去のことばかり思い出す。
　夢の中で忍は、仲間と出会い交友を深めていく。
lines.english: Lately, he seemed to dream constantly. His thoughts kept returning to the past. In those dreams, Shinobu met his companions and grew closer to them.

lines.japanese:
かつて実際に通過してきた道の、それは再演に過
ぎない。
lines.english: It was only a reenactment of a path he had once traveled in the waking world.

lines.japanese:
夢は混沌とするものだ。
　が、忍の夢に支離滅裂なものはほとんどない。
　体質によるものだろう。
lines.english: Dreams were chaotic by nature. Yet Shinobu's were almost never incoherent. Perhaps it was a quirk of his constitution.

lines.japanese:
事象をなぞるよう、記憶を再生してくれる。
　それらの夢は、気恥ずかしいものではあるが、ま
ず幸福を感じさせる。
lines.english: The dreams replayed his memories, tracing events as they had happened. Embarrassing though they were, more than anything they made him happy.

lines.japanese:
良い朝だった。
　勇気を出して、声をかけた友。
　連鎖して繋がる人間関係。
lines.english: It had been a good morning. A friend he had found the courage to call out to. Human bonds, linking one to another in a chain.

lines.japanese:
そうして構築された今がある。
　通常の人間関係との異なりを、忍は感じてやまない。
lines.english: That was how the present had been built. Shinobu could never shake the feeling that theirs was no ordinary human relationship.

lines.japanese:
近代化は個人の拡大だ。
　しかしわかちあう物的権利には限りがある。
　だから自己の聖域化が促進されてしまう。
lines.english: Modernization expands the individual. Yet the material rights we can share are finite. And so the self is increasingly made into a sanctuary.

lines.japanese: 自我聖域。
lines.english: An ego sanctuary.

lines.japanese:
それは容易に他者を拒絶する。
　空間を共有するということ。
　それは心の淵を重ねる行為にも似ている。
lines.english: It readily shuts others out. To share a space is almost like letting the depths of two hearts overlap.

lines.japanese:
忍と六人の関係は、貧民街を生き抜く親なき子ら
の兄妹意識に近くもある。
lines.english: The bond between Shinobu and the other six resembled the sibling bond of children surviving the slums without parents.

lines.japanese:
現代では得難い関係だ。
　自分を抱きしめる。
　幸せが過ぎると、怖くなることもある。
lines.english: Such bonds are rare in the modern age. He wrapped his arms around himself. At times, too much happiness can become frightening.

lines.japanese: とうと
lines.english: precious

lines.japanese:
あまりにも貴すぎるものには、喪失という魔が
宿る。
lines.english: Anything too precious is haunted by the specter of loss.

lines.japanese: 情が移りすぎたものは、自我の一部となるからだ。
lines.english: Whatever we grow too attached to becomes a part of the self.

lines.japanese:
しかし自我ほど強固に護ることもできない。
　不安になる。
lines.english: Yet we cannot protect it as securely as we protect the self. The thought made him anxious.

lines.japanese:
登校の準備を整える。
　終わる頃には、不安も日常に霞む。
lines.english: He got ready for school. By the time he finished, routine had blurred the anxiety away.

lines.japanese: 扉をあけて、階下におりた。
lines.english: He opened the door and went downstairs.

lines.japanese:
昼休み。
　廊下で葉子と出会う。
lines.english: Lunch break. He ran into Youko in the hall.

lines.japanese: 「やあ」
lines.english: “Hey.”

lines.japanese: 「お一人ですか？」
lines.english: “By yourself?”

lines.japanese: 「そうだよ」
lines.english: “I am.”

lines.japanese: 「おなかすきました」
lines.english: “I am hungry.”

lines.japanese: 「めちゃすきましたか」
lines.english: “Mega hungry?”

lines.japanese: 「めちゃんこ」
lines.english: “Mega.”

lines.japanese: 葉子の腹が鳴った。
lines.english: Youko's stomach rumbled.
“…Blush.”

lines.japanese: 「緊急事態だね」
lines.english: “Then this is an emergency.”

lines.japanese: 「ヨーコ、グレープフルーツ食べたい」
lines.english: “Youko wants a grapefruit.”

lines.japanese: 葉子はブリッコした。
lines.english: Youko put on a cutesy act.

lines.japanese:
「売っていないよ、それはさすがに学食の限界を超
　えてるよ」
lines.english: “They don't sell those. That's beyond even the cafeteria's powers.”

lines.japanese: 「で、なぜグレープフルーツ？」
lines.english: “And why grapefruit?”

lines.japanese: 「筋肉が柔らかくなるんですよ」
lines.english: “It makes your muscles more flexible.”

lines.japanese: 「へえ」
lines.english: “Huh.”

lines.japanese: 「柔軟でない筋肉に意味はありません」
lines.english: “Inflexible muscles are pointless.”

lines.japanese: 「なるほど……それっぽいね」
lines.english: “I see… That sounds plausible enough.”

lines.japanese: 「つまり、柔軟でない葉子にも意味はありません」
lines.english: “Therefore, an inflexible Youko is also pointless.”

lines.japanese: 「そ、そうかな」
lines.english: “I-is that so?”

lines.japanese: 「三段論法で証明できます」
lines.english: “I can prove it with a syllogism.”

lines.japanese:
「まあ柔軟性については頑張ってもらうとして、他
　には何が食べたい？」
lines.english: “I'll leave you to work on your flexibility. What else would you like to eat?”

lines.japanese: 「そうですね、ええと」
lines.english: “Let me see…”

lines.japanese: 悩む。
lines.english: She considered.

lines.japanese:
「パン買ってそこらで食べるか、学食で落ち着いて
　食べるか」
lines.english: “We can buy some bread and eat around here, or sit down and eat in the cafeteria.”

lines.japanese:
「うどんとかなら、売り切れないからゆっくり食べ
　られるよ？」
lines.english: “Udon won’t sell out, so we can take our time with that.”

lines.japanese: 「うどんは好きです」
lines.english: “I like udon.”

lines.japanese: 「僕はそばが好きだな」
lines.english: “I prefer soba.”

lines.japanese: 「うどんなど卑しい下等食物です」
lines.english: “Udon is a base and inferior food.”
“What?”

lines.japanese: 「そば最高です」
lines.english: “Soba is supreme.”

lines.japanese: 両の親指を立ててそう言う。
lines.english: She said it with both thumbs raised.

lines.japanese: 「今さっきうどん好きって……？」
lines.english: “Didn't you just say you liked udon…?”

lines.japanese: そんなこと言いましたっけ、と首を傾けた。
lines.english: She tilted her head as if to ask whether she had said that.

lines.japanese: 「いいんだけどさ……」
lines.english: “Well, never mind…”

lines.japanese: 「じゃ、まあ、学食にしますか」
lines.english: “All right, cafeteria it is.”

lines.japanese: 「お供します」
lines.english: “I shall join you.”

lines.japanese: 「奢るよ」
lines.english: “My treat.”

lines.japanese: 「ワリカンでいいのに……」
lines.english: “We could split the bill…”

lines.japanese:
「普段あまりお金使わないから、こういう時に散財
　しないと税金対策が大変なんだよ。税理士も金使
　えってうるさいし、このあいだ車買っちゃったよ」
lines.english: “I hardly spend any money, so if I don't splurge at times like this, tax planning becomes a nightmare. My accountant keeps nagging me to spend, and I even bought a car the other day.”

lines.japanese: 「どこかの大プロデューサー様みたいですね」
lines.english: “You sound like some big-shot producer.”

lines.japanese: 「馳走になります」
lines.english: “Then I shall take you up on that.”

lines.japanese:
「麺類なら、そろそろ行けば時間的にちょうどいい
　ね。昼がはじまってからすぐ行くと、定食戦争が
　いろいろとアレで」
lines.english: “If we're having noodles, the timing should be just about right. Go too early in the lunch period, and the lunch-set wars get a little… you know.”

lines.japanese: 「普段、あまり学食行かないので楽しみです」
lines.english: “I rarely visit the cafeteria. I am looking forward to it.”

lines.japanese: 「女の子は入りにくいよね。特に一年生だと」
lines.english: “It's hard for girls to brave it. Especially first-years.”

lines.japanese: 「兄を有効に使わないときついです」
lines.english: “I can hardly manage unless I put my brother to good use.”

lines.japanese: 「でもあまり協力してくれない……いじめです」
lines.english: “But he doesn’t help much… He is bullying me.”

lines.japanese: 「メッしておいてください」
lines.english: “Please tell him off for me.”

lines.japanese: 「……メッするです」
lines.english: “…Told off he shall be.”

lines.japanese: そのとき葉子の腹がひときわ大きく鳴った。
lines.english: At that moment, Youko's stomach gave an especially loud growl.

lines.japanese: 「ＯＨ」
lines.english: “OH.”

lines.japanese: 珍しく赤面。
lines.english: A rare blush.

lines.japanese: 「そ、そろそろ行こうか」
lines.english: “W-we should probably go.”

lines.japanese: 「オス」
lines.english: “Yes, sir!”

lines.japanese: 「あえてうどんに挑もう」
lines.english: “We'll brave the udon, then.”

lines.japanese: きょとん、と目をしばたたく。
lines.english: She blinked at him in blank surprise.

lines.japanese: 「そういうわけで、おごりはうどんね」
lines.english: “So that's settled. I'm buying you udon.”

lines.japanese: 「……は、どうも」
lines.english: “…Uh, thank you.”

lines.japanese: 葉子は顔を伏せて、頭をかいた。
lines.english: Youko lowered her head and scratched it.

lines.japanese: 「言ってみるもので」
lines.english: “It pays to say something.”

lines.japanese: その問いかけには応じず、葉子は忍の手首を引いた。
lines.english: Rather than answer, Youko tugged on Shinobu's wrist.

lines.japanese: 「行きましょう。無明の世界に」
lines.english: “Let us go. Into the world of ignorance.”
“…Where?”
“…Well, then.”

lines.japanese: 放課後になった。
lines.english: School was over for the day.

lines.japanese:
沙也加はいない。
　章二の姿もないようだ。
lines.english: Sayaka was gone. Shouji seemed to be nowhere in sight either.

lines.japanese: 忍はしばし、放課後の過ごし方に思いをめぐらせた。
lines.english: Shinobu briefly considered what to do after school.

lines.japanese: 斎と葉子は校内にいるだろうか。
lines.english: Would Itsuki and Youko still be on campus?

lines.japanese: いないということはないだろう。
lines.english: Surely at least one of them would be.

lines.japanese:
忍は急ぎ、教室を出た。
　帰宅する前に捕まえようと思った。
lines.english: Shinobu hurried out of the classroom. He meant to catch them before they went home.

lines.japanese: 斎はいなかった。
lines.english: Itsuki was not there.

lines.japanese:
剣道部に顔を出しているそうだ。
　斎は古武道を身につけている。
　特に剣を扱うのがうまい。
lines.english: Apparently he had stopped by the kendo club. Itsuki was trained in traditional martial arts. He was particularly skilled with the sword.

lines.japanese:
基礎的な部分で、剣道と重なる部分もある。
　どのような古武道も、実戦で用いられてきたのは
過去のことである。
lines.english: At a fundamental level, his art had much in common with kendo. Whatever the tradition, the days when the old martial arts saw use in actual combat were long past.

lines.japanese: 連綿と継承されるうち、他流派と交流が進んだ。
lines.english: As the tradition passed from one generation to the next, it mingled with other schools.

lines.japanese:
剣道との接ぎ木も大いにあったのだろう。
　斎の身につけた型は、現存する剣道各流派とそう
大差ない。
lines.english: Kendo had no doubt been grafted onto it over the years. The forms Itsuki had learned differed little from those of surviving kendo schools.

lines.japanese:
腕も良い。
　剣道部から誘われていたが、固辞している。
　実際、それは半分は正解だ。
lines.english: He was exceptionally skilled. The kendo club had tried to recruit him, but he always refused. Refusing was, in fact, at least partly the right choice.

lines.japanese:
門倉の中には、おいそれと秘伝が外に漏れること
を良しとしない流れもあるという。
lines.english: Some branches of the Kadokura tradition were said to frown on letting their secrets escape so readily.

lines.japanese:
門倉家は斎と葉子にとって、遠縁に当たる。
　しかし家庭の事情からか、彼ら兄妹は門倉に引き
取られ、そこで暮らしている。
lines.english: The Kadokura family was distantly related to Itsuki and Youko. Perhaps because of circumstances at home, the siblings had been taken in by the Kadokuras and now lived with them.

lines.japanese:
本当の両親とは、幼い頃に引き離されたのだと聞
いた。
lines.english: Shinobu had heard that they had been separated from their biological parents when they were young.

lines.japanese:
詳しいことは、二人とも語らなかった。
　後に、葉子から「語るほどの情報がない」と打ち
明けられた。
lines.english: Neither of them ever spoke about the details. Youko later confided that they simply “didn't know enough to have anything to tell.”

lines.japanese: 丁稚奉公。
lines.english: A live-in apprenticeship.

lines.japanese:
そんなようなことらしい。
　あまりにも非現代的な風習ではないか。
lines.english: Apparently the arrangement was something like that. A custom absurdly out of place in the modern world.

lines.japanese:
しかし門倉の塀の内側、あの和様に彩られた世界
を見たあとでは、納得できる話である。
lines.english: Yet after seeing the world behind the Kadokura walls, steeped as it was in Japanese tradition, the story became easy to believe.

lines.japanese:
兄妹も時折、親とは会っているようだ。
　しかし人生の大半を、二人は門倉で過ごした。
　箱庭のような世界で、過ごした。
lines.english: The siblings seemed to see their parents from time to time. Yet they had spent most of their lives with the Kadokuras. A world like a miniature garden.

lines.japanese:
斎がそこで身につけたものの一つが、武術だ。
　剣道部に乞われ、上級者として指導の手伝いをす
ることも多い。
lines.english: One thing Itsuki learned there was martial arts. The kendo club often called on him to help instruct its members.

lines.japanese: 「貴宮君、だよね？」
lines.english: “You're Shinobu Atemiya, right?”
“Huh?”

lines.japanese:
斎の動向を教えてくれた女生徒が、顔をのぞきこ
んできた。
lines.english: The girl who had told him where Itsuki had gone leaned in to look at him.

lines.japanese: 「そうだけど？」
lines.english: “That's me.”

lines.japanese: 「塚本君から伝言です」
lines.english: “Tsukamoto left you a message.”

lines.japanese: 「よくわかんないんだけど……妹・お供」
lines.english: “I don't really get it, but… ‘Sister. Escort.’”

lines.japanese: 「ええと、そんだけ？」
lines.english: “Um… That's all?”

lines.japanese: 「うん」
lines.english: “Yep.”

lines.japanese: 一仕事終えた者の表情で、頷く。
lines.english: She nodded with the satisfaction of a job well done.

lines.japanese: 「わかった……」
lines.english: “Got it…”

lines.japanese: 「確かに伝えたよ」
lines.english: “Message delivered.”

lines.japanese: 忍は斎の教室を離れた。
lines.english: Shinobu left Itsuki's classroom.

lines.japanese:
「……彼女、よく聞き取れたなぁ……
　斎のサイレンストーク……」
lines.english: “…I'm impressed she caught all that… Itsuki's silent speech…”

lines.japanese: 仲が良いのかも知れない。
lines.english: Perhaps they were close.

lines.japanese:
美巨乳だった。
　斎好みの。
lines.english: She was a knockout with a spectacular rack. Just Itsuki's type.

lines.japanese: 「むう」
lines.english: “Hrm.”

lines.japanese: えもいわれぬ焦燥感に、襲われてしまった。
lines.english: An indescribable restlessness came over him.

lines.japanese:
ちなみに『妹・お供』とは、
　葉子をお供につけるので好きに遊べ、という意味
である。
lines.english: Incidentally, “Sister. Escort” meant: Youko's coming with you. Go have whatever fun you like.

lines.japanese:
そんなわけで忍は、一年生のいる階に向かう。
　葉子と二人で遊ぶのだ。
　それはきっと楽しいに違いない。
lines.english: And so Shinobu headed for the first-years' floor. He would get to hang out with Youko one-on-one. It was bound to be fun.

lines.japanese:
一年教室は最上階に並ぶ。
　何か連絡事が長引いているのか、どのクラスもま
だ解散になっていなかった。
lines.english: The first-year classrooms lined the top floor. Perhaps some announcement was running long, for none of the classes had yet been dismissed.

lines.japanese:
共通の伝達事でもあるのかも知れない。
　見た感じ、８割以上の生徒がいる。
　二年生とはえらい違いである。
lines.english: There might have been some message for the whole grade. By the look of it, over eighty percent of the students remained. A stark contrast with the second-years.

lines.japanese:
廊下の壁に背をつけて、終了を待った。
　友達を遊びに誘う。
　その待ち時間。
lines.english: He leaned against the hallway wall and waited for them to finish. Waiting to ask a friend to hang out. That stretch of waiting.

lines.japanese:
ありふれた状況。
　日本中、世界中に、何千何万とあるだろう、瞬間。
lines.english: A perfectly ordinary situation. A moment that must have been playing out thousands, tens of thousands of times across Japan and the world.

lines.japanese: 目を閉じて、胸にわきあがる甘美な痺れに酔った。
lines.english: He closed his eyes and surrendered to the sweet numbness welling in his chest.

lines.japanese:
低い鼻歌が廊下に流れた。
　じきに一年生が溢れてくる廊下。
lines.english: A low hum drifted through the hallway. Soon, it would overflow with first-years.

lines.japanese:
今は隔絶され次の瞬間には雑音に塗り替えられる
静寂が、忍の陶酔を誘っていた。
lines.english: The silence—cut off from everything now, to be painted over with noise the next instant—intoxicated him.

lines.japanese: 扉が開いた。
lines.english: A door opened.

lines.japanese:
忍は目を開ける。
　一年時には数学を教えてくれた教師が出てきて、
忍を一瞥した。
lines.english: Shinobu opened his eyes. The teacher who had taught him math as a first-year emerged and glanced at him.

lines.japanese: 会釈する。
lines.english: Shinobu inclined his head.

lines.japanese: 「ん、貴宮。不純異性交遊をしに来たのか」
lines.english: “Atemiya. Here to engage in improper relations with the opposite sex?”

lines.japanese: 「そうです」
lines.english: “Yes, sir.”

lines.japanese: 「そうかそうか」
lines.english: “Good, good.”

lines.japanese:
呵々と笑い、教師は去っていった。
　きっかり五秒遅れて、全ての教室から生徒たちが
どっと溢れてきた。
lines.english: The teacher walked off with a booming laugh. Exactly five seconds later, students poured out of every classroom at once.

lines.japanese: 無数の嵐が、忍の前を駆け抜けた。
lines.english: Countless storms raced past Shinobu.

lines.japanese: かしま
lines.english: clamor

lines.japanese:
姦しいほどに甲高い笑いさざめきが、一気呵成と
いった感じで流れていく。
lines.english: A torrent of piercing laughter swept past him in one great rush.

lines.japanese:
思わず、背後の壁に背中をぴったりとつけてしま
う忍だった。
lines.english: Shinobu instinctively flattened himself against the wall.

lines.japanese:
ものすごいパワー。
　圧倒される他ない。
lines.english: Such incredible force. All he could do was stand there, overwhelmed.

lines.japanese: 「さすが……若い」
lines.english: “They're young, all right…”

lines.japanese: おそるおそる、教室に顔を突っ込んでみる。
lines.english: He cautiously poked his head into the classroom.

lines.japanese:
数名の生徒がいるばかりだった。
　一人が週番らしく、机に張りついて日誌を書き込
んでいる。
lines.english: Only a handful of students remained. One seemed to be on class duty, planted at a desk and filling out the daily log.

lines.japanese: 三名ほどの男女が教室の後ろで、会話に興じている。
lines.english: A group of three or so students chatted at the back of the room.

lines.japanese:
机を四人の男子が囲い、何かカードゲームを広げ
ている。
lines.english: Four boys crowded around a desk, playing some kind of card game.

lines.japanese:
隣同士に座った派手な女子二人が、化粧を猛烈に
直している。駅向こうコースと思われた。章二の世
界だ。
lines.english: Two flashy girls seated side by side were furiously touching up their makeup. They seemed bound for the far side of the station—Shouji's world.

lines.japanese: 葉子は―――
lines.english: Youko—

lines.japanese: 机にぺたーと突っ伏して、平らになっていた。
lines.english: —was sprawled flat across her desk, limp as a puddle.

lines.japanese: 葉子、と呼びかけようとして、躊躇う。
lines.english: He hesitated just as he was about to call her name.

lines.japanese:
名前で馴れ馴れしく呼んだら、翌日から噂になっ
てしまわないだろうか？
lines.english: If he addressed her so familiarly by name, would rumors start circulating the very next day?

lines.japanese: と、
lines.english: Then—

lines.japanese: 「おい、ミッチー、まだかよ」
lines.english: “Hey, Mitchy, you done yet?”

lines.japanese:
黒い男が忍の脇から、ずかずか教室に入った。
　見た顔だ、二年生。クラスは違う。
lines.english: A deeply tanned boy strode past Shinobu into the classroom. Shinobu recognized him—a second-year from another class.

lines.japanese: 「あー、ヤッちゅん、ごっめーん」
lines.english: “Oh, Yacchi, soooorry.”

lines.japanese: 化粧組の一人が応じた。
lines.english: One of the girls doing her makeup answered.

lines.japanese: 「なんでまだ終わってねーんだよ」
lines.english: “Why aren't you done yet?”

lines.japanese: 「今超終わる」
lines.english: “I'm, like, almost done.”

lines.japanese: 「ンだよ、もうできてんじゃん」
lines.english: “What? You look done already.”

lines.japanese: 「まだですぅー、全然できてませんー」
lines.english: “Nooo, I'm not. Not even clooose.”

lines.japanese: 「向こう行ってから仕上げねぇ？」
lines.english: “Can't you finish up when we get there?”

lines.japanese:
「こないだ、ＤＪの瀬戸さんに現場仕上げってから
　かわれたからヤ」
lines.english: “No way. DJ Seto teased me for doing my finishing touches at the club last time.”

lines.japanese: 「出たよＤＪ瀬戸」
lines.english: “Oh, here we go. DJ Seto again.”

lines.japanese: 「あんま話すなよ」
lines.english: “Don't talk to him so much.”

lines.japanese: 「なんでえ？」
lines.english: “Why not?”

lines.japanese: 「いーじゃん。向こうに迷惑だし。話すなって」
lines.english: “Whatever. You're bothering him, so quit talking to him.”

lines.japanese: もう一人の派手女子が囁く。
lines.english: The other flashy girl whispered.

lines.japanese: 「……ヤッちゅん嫉妬？」
lines.english: “…Yacchi, are you jealous?”

lines.japanese: 「バカじゃねえ？」
lines.english: “Are you stupid?”

lines.japanese:
男子は覚悟を決めたのか、どっかりと近くの椅子
に座り込んだ。
lines.english: Apparently resigned to his fate, the boy dropped heavily into a nearby chair.

lines.japanese: あとはもう三人の輪となって、会話も聞き取れない。
lines.english: The three formed their own circle, and Shinobu could no longer make out their conversation.

lines.japanese:
ミッチーとヤッちゅん。
　全然平気だなと忍は思った。
lines.english: Mitchy and Yacchi. Apparently nicknames were perfectly fine after all.

lines.japanese: 「葉子ー」
lines.english: “Youkooo.”

lines.japanese: 全員がちらりと忍を見た。
lines.english: Everyone glanced at Shinobu.

lines.japanese: 忍は少しのけぞった。
lines.english: He recoiled slightly.

lines.japanese:
だがすぐ興味を失い、カードに戻る。
　化粧組のもう一人の女子だけが、小さく口笛を吹
いた。
lines.english: But they soon lost interest and returned to their cards. Only the other girl touching up her makeup let out a quiet whistle.

lines.japanese: （なぜに僕の時だけ……）
lines.english: (How come that only happens when I do it…?)

lines.japanese: 葉子はむくりと身を起こした。
lines.english: Youko slowly pushed herself upright.

lines.japanese:
波打つような、軟体的な起き方がヨガを思わせて
ちょっと不気味だった。
lines.english: The boneless, undulating way she rose looked almost like yoga and was faintly unnerving.

lines.japanese: 日一日と、柔らかくなっているのかも知れない。
lines.english: Perhaps she was becoming more flexible by the day.

lines.japanese: 謎が多い。
lines.english: So many mysteries.
“Ah.”

lines.japanese: 忍を見つけ、とてとて駆けてくる。
lines.english: She spotted Shinobu and pattered over.

lines.japanese: 「お誘いですか？」
lines.english: “Have you come to invite me somewhere?”

lines.japanese: 「うん、そう」
lines.english: “Yeah, I have.”

lines.japanese:
「壮絶に暇なので、ずっと兄待ちしてようかと思っ
　てました」
lines.english: “I was catastrophically bored, so I thought I might just sit here waiting for my brother.”

lines.japanese: 「斎からの伝言でさ、僕に葉子のお供しろって」
lines.english: “Itsuki sent word that I should keep you company.”

lines.japanese: 葉子は相好を崩す。
lines.english: Youko's face brightened.

lines.japanese: 「そりゃすげえ」
lines.english: “Well, I'll be damned.”

lines.japanese: 「そうでもないよ。行く？」
lines.english: “It's not that amazing. Coming?”

lines.japanese: 「うす、お供します」
lines.english: “Yessir. I shall accompany you.”

lines.japanese: 座席に戻り荷物をまとめる。
lines.english: She returned to her seat and gathered her things.

lines.japanese: 「おまちどおさまです」
lines.english: “Sorry to keep you waiting.”

lines.japanese: 「塚本ラブリーチャーンス」
lines.english: “Tsukamoto, here's your big chance for looove!”

lines.japanese: 親指を立てるクラスメイトに、
lines.english: To the classmate giving her a thumbs-up—

lines.japanese: 「ぐっ」
lines.english: “Good.”

lines.japanese: と親指を立て返した。
lines.english: —Youko returned the thumbs-up.

lines.japanese: （アレは友達だったのか……）
lines.english: (So they were friends…)

lines.japanese: 葉子にはそんなところがある。
lines.english: Youko was like that sometimes.

lines.japanese: 「とりあえず駅前に来てみた」
lines.english: “For lack of a better idea, here we are at the station.”

lines.japanese: 「バス・電車・タクシー」
lines.english: “Bus. Train. Taxi.”

lines.japanese: 「その選択肢は違う」
lines.english: “Those aren't the choices I meant.”

lines.japanese: 「お乗り物……」
lines.english: “But I want to ride something…”

lines.japanese: 名残惜しそうだ。
lines.english: She seemed reluctant to let the idea go.

lines.japanese:
「うどん屋があるよ。
　あそこの天ぷらうどん『以外』はうまいんだ」
lines.english: “There's an udon place over there. Everything ‘except’ their tempura udon is good.”

lines.japanese: 「天ぷらは……」
lines.english: “The tempura…?”

lines.japanese: 忍は首を振った。
lines.english: Shinobu shook his head.

lines.japanese:
「雑草の天ぷらなんだろうねきっと。
　そうでもなければ、あんなことにはならない
　はずだ」
lines.english: “It must be deep-fried weeds. Nothing else could possibly have turned out like that.”

lines.japanese: 「……世の中には神秘が満ちているんですね」
lines.english: “…The world truly is brimming with mystery.”

lines.japanese: 「そばもイケるよ？」
lines.english: “Their soba's good too.”

lines.japanese: 「それはお昼に食べました」
lines.english: “We had that for lunch.”

lines.japanese: 「そうだったね」
lines.english: “So we did.”

lines.japanese: 「ごちそうさまでした」
lines.english: “Thanks for lunch.”

lines.japanese: 「たくさん、お召し上がりになりましたね」
lines.english: “You certainly ate a lot.”

lines.japanese: 「ごめんよ、つい」
lines.english: “Sorry. I got carried away.”

lines.japanese: 「かけそばは一杯、１８０円でしたね」
lines.english: “A bowl of plain soba was 180 yen, wasn't it?”

lines.japanese: 葉子は遠い目をした。
lines.english: Youko stared into the middle distance.

lines.japanese: 「つい、うっかり月見そばを……」
lines.english: “Somehow I wound up ordering mine with an egg…”

lines.japanese: 「月見は２２０円ですよね」
lines.english: “And that was 220 yen, wasn't it?”

lines.japanese: 無窮の蒼空をひたと見据えて、
lines.english: Youko gazed steadily into the endless blue sky.

lines.japanese: 「ついつい箸が進む。麺類だとどうしても進む」
lines.english: “My chopsticks just kept going. Noodles do that to me.”

lines.japanese: 「五杯も」
lines.english: “Five bowls.”

lines.japanese:
葉子はがま口財布をあけた。
　残金１７２円。
lines.english: Youko opened her coin purse. Remaining balance: 172 yen.

lines.japanese: 「バスしか乗れません。しかも途中下車」
lines.english: “All I can afford is the bus, and not even all the way.”

lines.japanese: 「奢る奢る。なんでも奢る」
lines.english: “I'll pay, I'll pay. Whatever you want.”

lines.japanese: 「奢られます」
lines.english: “Then I shall accept.”
“Hmm…”

lines.japanese: 「たまには向こう口に出ようか？」
lines.english: “Want to try the other side of the station for once?”

lines.japanese: 「いいですよ」
lines.english: “Certainly.”

lines.japanese: 二人は、滅多に赴かない駅の反対側に抜けた。
lines.english: They emerged on the far side of the station, where they rarely ventured.

lines.japanese:
すぐ横手が繁華街であり、駅と直接繋がったデパ
ートを中心に、ショッピング街が広がる。
lines.english: The entertainment district began just off to one side. A department store was connected directly to the station, with a shopping district spreading out around it.

lines.japanese:
街には人が大勢いる。
　商店街などで見られる主婦や老人・子供の姿はな
くなり、カップルや若者の集団が目立つ。
lines.english: The streets teemed with people. There were none of the housewives, elderly people, or children seen on an ordinary shopping street; couples and groups of young people stood out instead.

lines.japanese:
人々はいかにも楽しげに練り歩くが、彼らの姿は
皮膜がかかったようにぼやけている。
　他人事が群れをなしているように見えるのだ。
lines.english: The people strolling by looked happy enough, yet their figures blurred as though beneath a film. They looked like a crowd made up of lives that had nothing to do with his own.

lines.japanese:
それは街の人々が、生活から切り離された姿であ
るが故だろう。
lines.english: Perhaps it was because the people here seemed cut loose from their everyday lives.

lines.japanese:
着飾り実態を隠した、没個性化した群衆。
　本来のものではない虚像が、見る者に薄皮をもた
らす。
lines.english: A faceless crowd, dressed to conceal the people underneath. The false image, divorced from the genuine self, laid a thin film over the eyes of anyone who looked.

lines.japanese:
形容として不自然といえば一言だが、人の資質に
ついて語る時、簡略化が過ぎれば本質を喪失する。
lines.english: It was easy to call the sight unnatural and leave it at that. But speak of human nature too simply and its essence is lost.

lines.japanese:
無論彼らにも、生活に面したそれぞれの個がある
はずだ。
lines.english: Of course, each of them had an individual self grounded in the demands of everyday life.

lines.japanese:
虚飾などではない人なのだ。
　しかし画一的に塗り込められた本質は、装飾を貫
き通すものではない。
lines.english: They were real people, not mere displays. But their essence, painted over into uniformity, could not break through the decoration on the surface.

lines.japanese:
彼らを映像だと言われても、戸惑うことはないよ
うな。
lines.english: Had someone told him they were only images, he would not have been surprised.

lines.japanese: そんな漠とした不安に忍は囚われる。
lines.english: That vague unease took hold of Shinobu.

lines.japanese: 樋口章二は刃物のようだった。
lines.english: Shouji Higuchi was like a blade.

lines.japanese:
かつて出会い、今にいたるまで、研ぎ澄まされて
いる。
lines.english: From the day Shinobu first met him to now, Shouji had remained razor-sharp.

lines.japanese:
だがむやみやたらな刃ではない。
　その本質があまりに鋭利であるため、彼がまとう
虚は下位に置かれてしまう。
lines.english: But he was no blade swung blindly. His true nature was so keen that any false front he wore could only be secondary.

lines.japanese:
ピースメーカーとは異名だが、そんなことをして
いる学生など他にはいない。
lines.english: Peacemaker was only a nickname, but no other student did anything like what he did.

lines.japanese:
圧倒的な個があるばかりだ。
　個あっての虚となる。
　誰にでも模倣できることではない。
lines.english: He possessed an overwhelming individuality. The individual came first; the false image followed. It was not something just anyone could imitate.

lines.japanese:
よって章二は群れの統率者だ。
　この街、この繁華街においては、まさにそうだ。
lines.english: That made Shouji the leader of the pack. In this town—in this entertainment district—that was exactly what he was.

lines.japanese:
自らを彩る者たちの頂きに立つ、街の象徴。
　この風景を見てしまう者にとって、街は決して居
心地の良い場所ではない。
lines.english: He stood at the apex of all who adorned themselves, the symbol of the streets. For anyone who saw this landscape for what it was, the town could never be a comfortable place.

lines.japanese: 章二には見えていないのだろうか？
lines.english: Did Shouji simply not see it?

lines.japanese:
忍はよくそのことを考える。
　訊ねたこともある。
　より平易な言葉で。
lines.english: Shinobu often wondered. He had even asked once. In plainer words.

lines.japanese: 返答はこうだった。
lines.english: Shouji had answered:

lines.japanese:
「……たまに遊びに来るならそれでいいさ。
　ただ、毎夜毎夜、街に行かないとどうしようも
　ない連中ってのがいてな」
lines.english: “…If someone comes here to have fun once in a while, fine. But there are people who have no choice but to come into town every single night.”

lines.japanese:
「大抵そいつらは……もう追い込まれて行き場がな
　くなってんだ」
lines.english: “Most of them… have already been driven into a corner with nowhere else to go.”

lines.japanese:
「助けてさしあげようってんじゃねぇ。
　そもそも助けることなんてできやしない。
　俺がしてるのは、助けたフリをすることだけだ」
lines.english: “It’s not like I’m trying to save them. I couldn’t save them anyway. All I do is pretend I saved them.”

lines.japanese: 「……欺瞞の手伝いとも言う」
lines.english: “…You could call it helping them keep up the lie.”

lines.japanese: 彼らを救う術はない。
lines.english: There was no way to save them.

lines.japanese: 章二はそう言っていた。
lines.english: That was what Shouji had said.

lines.japanese:
救いがあるとすれば、それは個人内部での解脱め
いた意識の変容のみだろう。
lines.english: If there was any salvation, it could only be an inner transformation— something like enlightenment.

lines.japanese: 彼らの怯えや戸惑い、閉塞は未来がないことによる。
lines.english: Their fear, confusion, sense of entrapment—all came from the absence of a future.

lines.japanese:
いや、もともと世界に未来などなかった。
　明るい未来社会。
lines.english: No—the world had never possessed a future to begin with. A bright society of tomorrow.

lines.japanese:
そんなものを、必要以上に眩く知らしめたのは高
度成長だ。
lines.english: The years of breakneck economic growth had advertised that promise in a glare far brighter than necessary.

lines.japanese:
あまりにも輝かしいビジョンは至高のものであり、
信仰と化して人の心に忍び入った。
lines.english: That dazzling vision became the highest good, turned into a faith, and stole into people's hearts.

lines.japanese: 未来はいつから途切れ、霞んでしまったのか。
lines.english: When had the future broken off and faded into haze?

lines.japanese: 忍は知らない。
lines.english: Shinobu did not know.

lines.japanese:
彼が生まれた時には、とうに未来などなくなって
いた。
lines.english: By the time he was born, the future had long since ceased to exist.

lines.japanese:
若者にとって生きるとは、永続する圧迫にさらさ
れることだ。
lines.english: For the young, to live was to remain under pressure that never let up.

lines.japanese:
時間は未来に進んでいく。
　希望とともに進んでいく、という幻想を連れて。
lines.english: Time moves toward the future, carrying with it the illusion that hope moves too.

lines.japanese: だが希望は薄れた。
lines.english: But hope had faded.

lines.japanese:
若者の目に人生は、体験する前に終わってしまっ
た行為に等しい。
lines.english: To young eyes, life was an act already over before they had the chance to experience it.

lines.japanese: 今
lines.english: Now

lines.japanese:
未来の結末がわかりきったものである時、
　では現在とは何だろうか？
lines.english: When the ending of the future is already known, what, then, is the present?

lines.japanese:
それは回想にも等しいものなのかも知れない。
　思い出にはソフトフォーカスがかかる。
　このイメージは万民に共有されるはずだ。
lines.english: Perhaps the present is something akin to recollection. Memory comes in soft focus; surely everyone shares that image of it.

lines.japanese:
忍が見ている光景で、人々の様が煙るのは、そん
な理由もあるのだろう。
　章二はこう示唆している。
lines.english: Perhaps that, too, was why the people in Shinobu's view seemed veiled in haze. Shouji's words had suggested as much.

lines.japanese: 人は一人で生きる力を持つしかない―――
lines.english: A person has no choice but to find the strength to live alone—

lines.japanese: 「わかってる」
lines.english: “I know.”

lines.japanese: わかってはいるが、対処は難しい。
lines.english: He understood. Knowing what to do about it was another matter.

lines.japanese:
不意に恐怖に包まれる。
　忍は懸命に、今という瞬間を見据えようとする。
lines.english: Fear closed around him without warning. Shinobu struggled to hold his gaze on the present moment.

lines.japanese:
だから仲間が必要だ。
　今の密度を高めるための仲間、友、思い人が。
　忍の周囲には、六人の友を超えたものがいる。
lines.english: That was why he needed others—companions, friends, someone to love— to give the present more weight. Around him were six people who had become more than friends.

lines.japanese: なぜ葉子に声をかけたのか。その理由。
lines.english: The reason he had spoken to Youko.

lines.japanese:
胸よ裂けよとばかりに、指先を食い込ませた。
　心臓を取り出し、吊し上げ、そうすれば、
lines.english: He drove his fingertips into his chest as though he meant to tear it open. If he could rip out his heart and hoist it up—if he did that—

lines.japanese: ―――そうすれば、全てが終わるのだ―――
lines.english: —If he did that, everything would end—
“…Shinobu?”
“…Huh?”

lines.japanese: 葉子が心配げに、顔を覗き込んでくる。
lines.english: Youko leaned in to look at him, concern in her eyes.

lines.japanese: 「苦しそう」
lines.english: “You look like you're in pain.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、いや、その」
lines.english: “Oh, no, I…”

lines.japanese:
塗りつぶす。
　感情を習慣で。
lines.english: He painted over the emotion with habit.

lines.japanese: 「ちょっと心臓病になって」
lines.english: “I came down with a touch of heart disease.”

lines.japanese: 「んま」
lines.english: “My.”

lines.japanese: 「さて、夕食前だろうし……喫茶店あたり？」
lines.english: “Well, it's before dinner… How about a café?”

lines.japanese: 「お任せします」
lines.english: “I'll leave it to you.”

lines.japanese: 「でも、混んでるね、どこも」
lines.english: “Everywhere's crowded, though.”

lines.japanese:
周辺の喫茶店をざっと眺めると、座席はどこも埋
まっていた。
lines.english: Every seat in every café nearby seemed to be taken.

lines.japanese: 「夕方ですしね」
lines.english: “It is evening, after all.”

lines.japanese: 「アイスとか、クレープなんかどう？」
lines.english: “How about ice cream? Or a crepe?”

lines.japanese: 「いいですね」
lines.english: “That sounds lovely.”

lines.japanese:
「ちょっと待ってて。買ってくる。
　確かにこのあたりでうまい店があるんだ」
lines.english: “Wait here. I'll go buy something. I know a good place around here.”

lines.japanese: 「一緒に行きますよ？」
lines.english: “I'll come with you.”

lines.japanese: 「ちょっと並ぶかも知れないから、待ってて」
lines.english: “There might be a line. Just wait here.”

lines.japanese: 「はい、じゃあお願いします」
lines.english: “All right. I'll leave it to you, then.”

lines.japanese: 葉子を置いて、忍は雑踏に飛び込んだ。
lines.english: Leaving Youko behind, Shinobu plunged into the crowd.

lines.japanese:
買い物を手に、葉子のもとに戻る。
　少し手間取った。
lines.english: Carrying what he had bought, he made his way back to Youko. It had taken him a little longer than expected.

lines.japanese:
待たせてしまったかも知れない。

lines.english: Perhaps he had kept her waiting. Careful not to bump into anyone, Shinobu broke into a light jog toward the place where he had left her.

lines.japanese: しかし、そこに葉子はいない。
lines.english: But Youko was not there.
“…Youko…?”

lines.japanese:
ぐるりと視線を巡らせる。

lines.english: His eyes swept the crowd. Her uniform was nowhere in sight.

lines.japanese: 「ナ、ナンパ？」
lines.english: “D-did someone hit on her?”

lines.japanese:
ついて行ってしまったのだろうか。
　考えられる話だった。
lines.english: Could she have gone off with whoever it was? It was entirely possible.

lines.japanese:
葉子はどうも境界線の曖昧な部分がある。
　忍は無作為に周囲に視線を飛ばし、葉子の姿を捜
した。
lines.english: Youko could be a little vague about boundaries. Shinobu's eyes darted at random through the crowd as he searched for her.

lines.japanese: と、
lines.english: Then—

lines.japanese:
視線を感じた。
　悪意の視線。
lines.english: He could feel someone watching him. A gaze filled with malice.

lines.japanese:
忍は槍のような視線を辿る。
　行き交う人々のただ中、静止している場面があった。
lines.english: Shinobu followed the spear-like gaze. Amid the ceaseless stream of people, one tableau stood still.

lines.japanese:
並んで立っている。
　ただそれだけのことが、悪夢のようだった。
　その二人に、焦点は固定される。
lines.english: They stood side by side. That alone was nightmarish. His focus locked on the two of them.

lines.japanese: 世界はますます霞む。
lines.english: The world dissolved further into haze.

lines.japanese: 忍と、葉子と、伊勢崎宗多の三人だけの繭ができる。
lines.english: A cocoon formed around the three of them alone: Shinobu, Youko, and Souta Isezaki.

lines.japanese:
忍は動けなかった。
　声を発することも。
lines.english: Shinobu could not move. He could not even force out a word.

lines.japanese:
宗多は笑っている。
　忍を見ている。
lines.english: Souta was smiling. Looking at Shinobu.

lines.japanese:
葉子は抵抗するという愚を犯していない。
　表情だけを引き締め、様子見をしている。
lines.english: Youko had not made the foolish mistake of resisting. She had only set her face and waited to see what happened.

lines.japanese:
正解だ、と忍は思う。
　宗多の腕が馴れ馴れしく葉子の肩に回されていた。
lines.english: That was the right choice, Shinobu thought. Souta had draped one arm with brazen familiarity around Youko's shoulders.

lines.japanese:
街を歩く若者然としている。
　若い服装。
lines.english: He looked every inch a young man out on the town. Dressed in the fashions of his generation.

lines.japanese: その多くは、周囲を攻撃するほどに外圧的なものだ。
lines.english: Much of that fashion was so outwardly aggressive it seemed to attack its surroundings.

lines.japanese:
しかし宗多が発する暴力のビジョンは、彼が身に
つけた負の空気をも凌駕している。
lines.english: Yet even the hostility of his clothes paled beside the vision of violence Souta projected.

lines.japanese:
まさしくそれも個性である。
　これほどに峻厳な憎悪は、特質と言うしかない。
lines.english: That, too, was an unmistakable expression of individuality. Hatred this severe could only be called a defining trait.

lines.japanese:
炯々たる目が、忍を嬲る。
　もし接近したら、宗多は憎しみの矛先を葉子に向
けかねない。
lines.english: His blazing eyes tormented Shinobu. If Shinobu moved any closer, Souta might turn the point of that hatred on Youko.

lines.japanese:
いや、今用意してみせた状況こそ、まさにその結
果を示唆するものだ。
lines.english: No—the situation he had arranged was itself an unmistakable warning of that outcome.

lines.japanese:
動けない。
　何もできない。
lines.english: He could not move. He could do nothing.

lines.japanese: 忍にとっては苦痛でしかない均衡。
lines.english: For Shinobu, the stalemate was pure agony.

lines.japanese:
たっぷり一分以上の時間が過ぎ去り、忍の額に冷
や汗が浮かびだした頃。
lines.english: A full minute and more passed. By then, cold sweat had begun to bead on Shinobu's brow.

lines.japanese: 宗多の唇が動いた。知らしめるように。
lines.english: Souta’s lips moved, as though to drive the message home.

lines.japanese: こ
lines.english: Could

lines.japanese: わ
lines.english: have

lines.japanese: せ
lines.english: broken

lines.japanese: た
lines.english: her.

lines.japanese: 買い物は、気が付かないうちに下に落ちていた。
lines.english: Before he knew it, everything he had bought had fallen to the ground.

lines.japanese:
幾人かの通行人が怪訝な目を忍に向けたが、体面
を気にする余裕もない。
lines.english: Several passersby gave Shinobu puzzled looks, but he had no room left to worry about appearances.

lines.japanese:
宗多が手招きする。
　忍は前に進んだ。おそらくは、会話するために。
lines.english: Souta beckoned him over. Shinobu stepped forward, presumably to talk.

lines.japanese: 「止まれ」
lines.english: “Stop.”

lines.japanese:
三メートルまで、両者は接近する。
　目と鼻の先ではあるが、宗多の手は葉子にかけら
れたままだ。
lines.english: They came within three meters of each other. Only a few steps apart, yet Souta's hand remained on Youko.

lines.japanese:
それがいかに危険であるか、忍は知っている。
　彼の手癖は、悪い。
lines.english: Shinobu knew how dangerous that was. Souta was dangerous with his hands.

lines.japanese: 「よう、貴宮」
lines.english: “Hey, Atemiya.”

lines.japanese: 「俺は困ってるよ、貴宮」
lines.english: “I'm in a real bind here, Atemiya.”

lines.japanese:
「そんな甘いのは、苦労してないからかよ？
　笑ったぜ。俺は。笑ったよ、貴宮」
lines.english: “Are you really that soft because you've never suffered? You made me laugh. You really did, Atemiya.”

lines.japanese: 「……何度、壊せたと思う？」
lines.english: “…How many times do you think I could've broken her?”

lines.japanese:
「おまえの大切な友達じゃないのかよ？　もっと
　大事にした方がいいんじゃねーの？　絶対に
　大事にした方がいいぜ。ま、ムリだけどな」
lines.english: “Isn't she your precious friend? Maybe you ought to take better care of her. You absolutely ought to take better care of her. Not that you can.”

lines.japanese: 「なあ、こんな人混みで、とか思ってるか？」
lines.english: “What, are you thinking I wouldn't do it in a crowd like this?”

lines.japanese: 忍の反応も待たずに、一方的に話し続ける。
lines.english: He continued without waiting for Shinobu to react.

lines.japanese: 「あるぜ、貴宮」
lines.english: “Oh, it can happen, Atemiya.”

lines.japanese: こともなげに言う。
lines.english: He said it as though it were nothing.

lines.japanese:
「どんなことだってあるんだよ。
　それをおまえは知らないとな」
lines.english: “Anything can happen. And that's something you need to know.”

lines.japanese: 「それを勉強しないとな」
lines.english: “You need to learn that lesson.”

lines.japanese: 「伊勢崎……ッ」
lines.english: “Isezaki…!”

lines.japanese: 「動くな優等生」
lines.english: “Don't move, honor student.”

lines.japanese: 「俺も学校行きたかったぜ」
lines.english: “I wanted to go to school too.”

lines.japanese:
「おまえみてぇな野郎が、のうのうと幸せになって、
　俺は反吐が出るようなゴミためで滅私奉公か？」
lines.english: “A piece of shit like you gets to coast along fat and happy while I slave away in a garbage dump that makes me want to puke?”

lines.japanese:
「ガキなりにな、俺なりの人生設計ってもんがあっ
　た」
lines.english: “Even as a kid, I had plans for my life. Plans of my own.”

lines.japanese:
「あの時に集めた仲間はな、俺らみてぇな平凡な
　ヤツ同士でつるんで、少しでも上に昇るための
　ものだったんだよ」
lines.english: “The people I gathered back then were supposed to be ordinary nobodies like us, sticking together so we could claw our way a little higher.”

lines.japanese: 「なのに今、俺は一人でおまえは仲間がいる」
lines.english: “But now I'm alone, while you're the one with friends.”

lines.japanese:
「なんの差だ。運か？
　それともてめぇの方が汚かったからか？」
lines.english: “What's the difference between us? Luck? Or were you just more rotten than me?”

lines.japanese:
「どっちにしても、俺はそいつが許せそうにないん
　だよ」
lines.english: “Either way, I don't think I can let that go.”

lines.japanese:
「だってそうだろ？
　アイツは、俺の女だったんだぜ？」
lines.english: “How could I? She was my woman.”

lines.japanese: 「……どこの誰も、人に所有されたりはしない」
lines.english: “…Nobody belongs to anyone else.”

lines.japanese: 宗多の指先が、葉子の首に添えられた。
lines.english: Souta rested his fingertips against Youko's neck.

lines.japanese: 「だからよ、そういうところが優等生なんだよ」
lines.english: “That's exactly why you're the honor student.”

lines.japanese: 地の底から響いてきた。
lines.english: His voice seemed to rise from the depths of the earth.

lines.japanese:
「おまえは人の獲物を横取りして、
　自分のものにした」
lines.english: “You poached somebody else's prey and claimed her for yourself.”

lines.japanese:
「この女だってそうなんだろ？　今はおまえの仲間
　だとしても、前は違う誰かのものだった」
lines.english: “Same with this woman, right? Maybe she's one of your friends now, but before that, she belonged to somebody else.”

lines.japanese: 「おまえはスリ野郎だ、貴宮」
lines.english: “You're a pickpocket, Atemiya.”

lines.japanese: 「……友達だ」
lines.english: “…They're my friends.”
“What?”

lines.japanese: 「全員、かけがえのない友達だ。おまえとは違う」
lines.english: “Every last one is an irreplaceable friend. I’m not like you.”
“Well, now—”

lines.japanese: 感心したように声をあげる。
lines.english: He sounded impressed.

lines.japanese:
「アイツのかわりに、こいつをもらってチャラにし

lines.english: “Why don't I take this one instead and call us even?”

lines.japanese:
宗多は葉子の顎を指の背で吊り上げた。

lines.english: Souta lifted Youko's chin with the back of one finger. He forced her narrowed eyes to meet his own.

lines.japanese:
「こいつはおまえにとって、なんとしても手元に置
　いておきたい女なんだろ？　貴宮、おまえの考え
　そうなことだよ」
lines.english: “She's someone you'd want to keep close at any cost, isn't she? Exactly the sort of thing you'd think, Atemiya.”

lines.japanese: 「横取り屋のおまえが考えそうなことだ」
lines.english: “Exactly the sort of thing a thief like you would think.”

lines.japanese:
宗多の顔が、さらに近づく。
　唇が一センチまで迫っても、葉子は動じない。
lines.english: Souta's face drew closer still. Even with his lips a centimeter from hers, Youko did not flinch.

lines.japanese: 興味なさげに、表情を硬化させている。
lines.english: She merely hardened her expression, looking utterly uninterested.

lines.japanese:
「おい、貴宮のことを教えてやろうか？
　こいつは、」
lines.english: “Want me to tell you about Atemiya? This bastard—”

lines.japanese: 忍の体が硬直した。
lines.english: Shinobu's body locked rigid.

lines.japanese:
毛穴が総毛立ち、異様な空気が足下にわだかまる
のを感じた。
lines.english: Every hair on his body stood on end. He felt something unnatural pooling at his feet.

lines.japanese:
見えない煙が膝から上までを隠し、覆っていくの
を確かに感じた。
lines.english: He could feel an invisible smoke rising past his knees and closing over him.

lines.japanese:
頭の先まで包まれた時、人は我と周囲を見失い、
感情のままに行動するのだ。
　忍もそんな危険な状態に駈けのぼりつつある。
lines.english: Once it covered a person to the crown, they lost sight of self and surroundings and acted on emotion alone. Shinobu was hurtling toward that same dangerous state.
“…Don't—”

lines.japanese:
口をついて出かけた警告が、怒りと恐怖で掠れて

lines.english: The warning that nearly escaped him came out hoarse with anger and fear.

lines.japanese: しかし葉子の言葉が、より強く速かった。

lines.japanese: 「手を離しなさい」
lines.english: “Take your hands off me.”

lines.japanese: 葉子という曖昧な個性が、急激に輪郭を持った。
lines.english: Youko's hazy, indistinct personality suddenly snapped into focus.

lines.japanese:
形を変えて鋭利さを増したように感じられた。
　戸惑う宗多に、続けざまに言葉が投げられる。
lines.english: It felt as if she had changed shape and grown sharper. She fired one sentence after another at the bewildered Souta.

lines.japanese: 「口臭いですよ。汚物みたいな匂いがします」
lines.english: “Your breath stinks. It smells like filth.”

lines.japanese:
「私に触らないでください。息を吹きかけないでく
　ださい。不愉快です。というか痴漢です。私はお
　まえに心も体も許したつもりはないですよ」
lines.english: “Do not touch me. Do not breathe on me. You are revolting. In fact, you're molesting me. I have given you neither my heart nor my body.”

lines.japanese:
「もの扱いされるのはいいとしても、誰のものにな
　るのかくらいは自分で選びますよ。
　で、間違いなくそれはおまえじゃないです」
lines.english: “I may not mind being treated like a thing, but I will at least choose whom I belong to. And it is unquestionably not you.”

lines.japanese: 一瞬、宗多の顔に困惑が荒れ狂った。
lines.english: For one instant, confusion raged across Souta's face.

lines.japanese:
「せっかくのデートだったのに、おまえのせいで台
　無しです。これ以上邪魔するなら痛い目にあわせ
　ますから」
lines.english: “This was supposed to be a date, and you have ruined it. Interfere again, and I will see to it that you get hurt.”

lines.japanese: 「てめぇは状況が―――」
lines.english: “You don't understand the situ—”

lines.japanese: 宗多の手が、何か目的をもって動いた。
lines.english: Souta's hand moved with purpose.

lines.japanese:
またしても、葉子の方が速かった。
　伸びてきた少年の指を、葉子の指が絡め取り、横
に倒した。
lines.english: Again, Youko was faster. Her fingers tangled with the boy's outstretched fingers and forced them sideways.

lines.japanese:
指先の基節骨ならびに中節骨を起点として発生し
た力学は、無数の節を連動経路として膝関節に作用

lines.english: Force originating in the proximal and middle phalanges of his fingers traveled through a chain of countless joints and acted upon his knee.

lines.japanese: 宗多はすとんと尻餅をついた。
lines.english: Souta dropped neatly onto his backside.

lines.japanese: 突然視界が落ちたことに、宗多は対応できなかった。
lines.english: Souta could not react to the sudden drop in his field of vision.

lines.japanese:
ほどよい高さの顎先に向けて、葉子は無造作に爪

lines.english: Youko casually flicked the toe of her shoe toward his chin, now at a convenient height.
“Ghh!!”

lines.japanese:
片腕を間に差し挟む宗多。腕を、靴がしたたかに
蹴った。

lines.japanese: それだけの騒ぎに、しかし衆目は集まらない。
lines.english: Yet even that much commotion drew no attention.

lines.japanese:
完全な死角、人々の目に止まらない瞬間を選んで
実行されたかのようである。
lines.english: It was as though she had chosen the perfect blind spot—the instant when no one was watching—and struck then.

lines.japanese: 瞬間の出来事だった。
lines.english: It had happened in an instant.

lines.japanese: 宗多は無言で立ち上がる。
lines.english: Souta rose without a word.

lines.japanese: 「とっととケツまくって消えるがいいですよ」
lines.english: “Now turn tail and kindly get lost.”
“Youko…”

lines.japanese:
「忍さんがどうとか言ってたんでついていったんで
　すけど、とんだハイエナ野郎でした」
lines.english: “He mentioned you, so I followed him, but he turned out to be a goddamn hyena.”

lines.japanese:
言葉を探したが、見つからなかった。

lines.english: Shinobu searched for something to say and found nothing. Without a word, he drew Youko close and looked toward Souta, who was rubbing the wrist she had kicked.

lines.japanese:
待っていたかのように、宗多が口を開く。
　微妙に目線を外し、虚空を見ている。
　独白するに近い抑揚で、言葉を吐く。
lines.english: As though he had been waiting for that, Souta began to speak. He looked slightly aside, staring into empty space. His voice carried the cadence of a soliloquy.

lines.japanese: 「……今、迷ってる、貴宮」
lines.english: “…Right now, I'm trying to decide, Atemiya.”

lines.japanese: 「全部張るか、温存しておくか」
lines.english: “Whether to bet everything, or hold something back.”

lines.japanese:
「どうせこのまま頑張っても、昔の仲間は戻らねぇ
　しな。夢も戻らねぇ」
lines.english: “No matter how hard I keep trying, my old friends aren't coming back. Neither are my dreams.”

lines.japanese:
「大人に尻尾振って、いくつもザコ仕事をこなして、

lines.english: “I wagged my tail for grown-ups and did one crappy little job after another before they finally started treating me decently.”

lines.japanese:
「だけど、そんなものにはクソほどの価値もねぇよ

lines.english: “But that isn't worth jack shit, is it? I only went from small fry to grunt. There's no point protecting a position like that.”

lines.japanese: 「……そういうものでないと、いけねぇんだ」
lines.english: “…If I do it, it has to be all or nothing.”

lines.japanese:
手を握りしめ、開く。

lines.english: He clenched his hand, then opened it. He repeated the motion throughout his speech.

lines.japanese: 一回ごとに危険が膨れあがるのを、忍は感じた。
lines.english: With each repetition, Shinobu felt the danger swell.

lines.japanese:
熱気だ。

lines.english: Heat. Souta's anger was fierce enough to make Shinobu's body tremble.

lines.japanese:
先ほど忍が蓄積した同種の感情は、あっけなく霧
散していた。
lines.english: The same feeling that had built inside Shinobu moments before had vanished with almost laughable ease.

lines.japanese: 怒りを持続させることもまた、資質の一つである。
lines.english: The ability to sustain anger was itself a kind of gift.

lines.japanese:
忍には向いていない。
　唇を噛む。
lines.english: Shinobu was not built for it. He bit his lip.

lines.japanese: 雑踏の中、宗多の怒りと対峙しなければならない。
lines.english: He had no choice but to face Souta's anger amid the crowd.

lines.japanese:
宗多の右手が、尻ポケットに滑りこむ。

「時間をかけて全部ぶちこわしてやろうって思った

lines.english: “I thought I'd take my time smashing every last thing you have, but forget it. Settle the account right now.”

lines.japanese:
敵意が膨れあがった。
　忍は身構える。

lines.japanese:
宗多の右手が、ポケットから折りたたまれた
ナイフを取り出―――
