lines.english: “This is unusual. You don't often come to speak to me like this.”

lines.japanese: 「構いませんよ。どうぞ？」
lines.english: “It's all right. Go ahead.”

lines.japanese: 予想していたより柔らかい口調。
lines.english: Her tone was gentler than he had expected.

lines.japanese: 「あ、あの」
lines.english: “U-um…”

lines.japanese: 「お願いが、あります」
lines.english: “I have a favor to ask.”

lines.japanese:
敬語で忍は言う。
　懇願には違いないのだ。
lines.english: Shinobu addressed her with formal courtesy. He was pleading with her, after all.
“…A favor?”

lines.japanese: はじめて千鳥は、書類を裏返し、忍に向き直った。
lines.english: Only then did Chidori turn the document facedown and look at Shinobu.

lines.japanese: 「その様子だと、何か大変な要求が出そうですね」
lines.english: “Judging from the look of you, this will be no small request.”

lines.japanese: 「トラブルですか？」
lines.english: “Is there trouble?”

lines.japanese:
すっ、と声が低くなる。
　柔らかみが消え、仕事をしている時の彼女へと戻る。
lines.english: Her voice dropped at once. The warmth vanished, and her manner became all business again.

lines.japanese: 表情とともに。
lines.english: Her expression changed with it.

lines.japanese: 「はい」
lines.english: “Yes.”

lines.japanese: 「塚本斎と、塚本葉子について、です」
lines.english: “It's about Itsuki and Youko Tsukamoto.”

lines.japanese: 「聞きましょう」
lines.english: “Tell me.”
“The thing is—”

lines.japanese: 忍は事情を話した。
lines.english: Shinobu explained the situation.

lines.japanese:
千鳥は話の節々に質問を挟みつつ、熱心に耳を傾
けていた。
lines.english: Chidori listened intently, interrupting him now and then with questions.

lines.japanese:
全ての事情を聞き終わると、口元に指を添えるよ
うに考え込む。
lines.english: After hearing him out, she rested a finger near her lips and sank into thought.

lines.japanese: 「……厄介な話ですね」
lines.english: “…This is a difficult situation.”

lines.japanese: 「はい」
lines.english: “Yes.”

lines.japanese: 「いろいろな問題が絡んで……確かに」
lines.english: “There are all sorts of problems tangled up in this… that much is true.”

lines.japanese: 「忍は、その二人についてどうしたいんです？」
lines.english: “What do you want to do about those two, Shinobu?”
“What…?”

lines.japanese:
「あなたの範疇ですから。
　手を引くなら、それで終わることでしょう？」
lines.english: “They fall within your sphere. If you withdraw, that will be the end of it, won't it?”

lines.japanese: 「でも、それだと……！」
lines.english: “But then…!”

lines.japanese: 「その……少年たちの集団。心当たりがあります」
lines.english: “That… group of boys. I have heard of them.”

lines.japanese:
「この界隈で見えない耳のある者には、有名です。
　当然ですがあまり良い噂は聞かないですね。かな
　り暴力的な、それでいて狡猾な子たちのようです」
lines.english: “They’re notorious among those in this district with ears in unseen places. The stories are predictably ugly. They seem to be quite violent children—and cunning ones.”

lines.japanese: 「背後関係にも問題がありますし」
lines.english: “Their connections are another problem.”

lines.japanese:
「つまり事によっては、大きな問題に発展してしま
　うこともあり得る、ということになりますね」
lines.english: “Depending on how this unfolds, in other words, it could become a much larger problem.”

lines.japanese:
「無論、その件は解決されればそれに越したことは
　ない話ではありますが……」
lines.english: “Of course, nothing would be better than seeing the matter resolved…”

lines.japanese:
「しかしこの件、あなたの手には余るのではないで
　すか？」
lines.english: “But this is beyond you, isn't it?”
“But…!”

lines.japanese:
「無謀なことをさせるため、あなたを学校に通わせ
　ているわけじゃないんですよ？」
lines.english: “You aren’t being sent to school so you can do something reckless.”

lines.japanese:
「その件からは手を引くことをお勧めします。
　ただ、決めるのはあなたですが」
lines.english: “I advise you to withdraw from this matter. The choice, of course, is yours.”

lines.japanese:
ことさら冷たい言葉が、忍の意志をくじくように
投げかけられる。
lines.english: The words were deliberately cold, flung at him as if to break his resolve.

lines.japanese: 「……あの二人は」
lines.english: “…Those two…”

lines.japanese: 「二人は？」
lines.english: “Those two?”

lines.japanese: 「僕の……僕にとって―――」
lines.english: “They're my… To me, they're—”

lines.japanese:
ぎゅっと瞳を閉じた。
　眼球が乾いていたみたいに、目頭の奥が痺れた。
lines.english: He squeezed his eyes shut. The inner corners of his eyes prickled with numbness, as though they had gone dry.

lines.japanese: やがて、
lines.english: At last:

lines.japanese: 「……助けが必要です」
lines.english: “…They need help.”

lines.japanese: 「助けたあとは？」
lines.english: “And once you've helped them?”

lines.japanese: 「面倒を、見ます」
lines.english: “I'll take care of them.”

lines.japanese: 忍の声から、迷いがなくなる。
lines.english: The hesitation left Shinobu's voice.

lines.japanese:
「あの二人を、ここで手放すつもりは
　ありませんから」
lines.english: “Because I have no intention of letting those two go at this point.”

lines.japanese: かわりに、淡々とした決意が宿っていた。
lines.english: A calm, matter-of-fact resolve had taken its place.

lines.japanese:
「そういう言い方をするということは……
　本気ということですね」
lines.english: “If you put it that way… you must be serious.”

lines.japanese: 一瞬、落胆にも受け取れる表情を、千鳥は見せた。
lines.english: For an instant, something that might have been disappointment crossed Chidori's face.

lines.japanese: 「だけど、子供の力では……どうにもならなくて」
lines.english: “But I’m only a child… This is beyond me.”

lines.japanese: 「姉さんは、あちこちに顔がきくんでしょう？」
lines.english: “You have connections in all kinds of places, don't you?”

lines.japanese: 「……ええ、多少は」
lines.english: “…Yes. To some extent.”

lines.japanese: 「その力を借りれば、と思いました」
lines.english: “I thought I might borrow some of your influence.”

lines.japanese: 「確かに、できないことはありませんけど」
lines.english: “Certainly, it isn't impossible.”

lines.japanese: 「あなたは、その分の借りを返せますか？」
lines.english: “But can you repay the debt this would create?”
“…A debt.”

lines.japanese:
「私一人の力だけで、どうにかなることでは
　ないんです」
lines.english: “My influence alone won't be enough to resolve this.”

lines.japanese:
「頼みこむ必要があります。
　それはとても大変なことです」
lines.english: “I'll have to ask others for favors. That is no small thing.”

lines.japanese: 「わかります……」
lines.english: “I understand…”

lines.japanese: 「今はいいでしょう」
lines.english: “For now, that can wait.”

lines.japanese:
「しかしいずれ、あなた自身が代価を払うことにな
　るかも知れない。それでもいいですか？」
lines.english: “But one day, you may have to pay the price yourself. Are you still willing?”

lines.japanese: 「人の力を借りるとは、そういうことですから」
lines.english: “That is what it means to borrow someone else's influence.”
“…Yes.”

lines.japanese: 「言うことを、聞きます」
lines.english: “I'll do as you say.”

lines.japanese: 「調べてみましょう」
lines.english: “I will look into it.”

lines.japanese:
「あなたのお友達を助けることができるかも知れま
　せん」
lines.english: “It may be possible to help your friends.”

lines.japanese: 「だから忍、よく覚悟しておくように」
lines.english: “So steel yourself, Shinobu.”

lines.japanese: 「あなたが責任を持つことになるんですから」
lines.english: “You will be the one responsible for them.”

lines.japanese: 「はい」
lines.english: “Yes.”

lines.japanese: 縁を利用する。
lines.english: He was making use of a personal connection.

lines.japanese:
いつか支払うものについては、あまり考えずに
いた。
lines.english: He gave little thought to what he might one day have to pay in return.

lines.japanese:
もしかすれば、気が滅入るような要求だろう。
　考えたくはない。
lines.english: Perhaps the demand, when it came, would be deeply unpleasant. He did not want to think about it.

lines.japanese:
できるだけ短い悩みで済むように。
　忍は全てを棚に上げた。
lines.english: To keep his worrying as brief as possible, Shinobu put the whole thing out of his mind.

lines.japanese:
窓枠に手をかける。
　普段はあけることのない窓だ。
lines.english: He placed a hand on the window frame. It was a window he normally kept shut.

lines.japanese:
外気を取り込むことにはときに苦痛がある。
　世界と接続しているような気分になるからだ。
lines.english: Sometimes it hurt to let the outside air in. It made him feel as though he were connected to the world.

lines.japanese:
汚らわしいと思えたなら、触れたくない気持ちが
ある。
lines.english: When something struck him as filthy, he did not want to touch it.

lines.japanese: 心にいくぶんの負担をかけて、開いた。
lines.english: Opening it took a small toll on him.

lines.japanese: 清涼な空気。
lines.english: Cool, clean air.

lines.japanese:
乾き澱んだ室内をかき回す。
　空を見る。
lines.english: It stirred the dry, stagnant air in the room. He looked up at the sky.

lines.japanese:
作り物のように移ろわない空の有様を、目にする
ことになる。
lines.english: He found himself looking at a sky so changeless it seemed artificial.

lines.japanese:
たっぷり三分。
　忍は見ていた。
　監視するように。
lines.english: For three full minutes, Shinobu watched it. As though keeping it under surveillance.

lines.japanese: 学校に繋がるいつもの道で、沙也加と合流する。
lines.english: They met up with Sayaka on the familiar road leading to school.

lines.japanese: 「……今日は三人のようね」
lines.english: “…It seems it's just the three of us today.”

lines.japanese: 「寂しいことだね」
lines.english: “Kind of lonely, isn't it?”

lines.japanese: よくあることだ。
lines.english: It was nothing unusual.

lines.japanese:
いつも全員が、必ず揃うわけではない。
　例えばこの三人の組み合わせ一つ取ってみても、
初めてのものではない。
lines.english: They were not all necessarily together every day. This particular group of three, for instance, had walked to school together before.

lines.japanese:
樋口章二は学業については気分屋である。
　伊月笛子は学校に合わせて早く通学する時がある。
lines.english: Shouji Higuchi came to school when he felt like it. Fueko Izuki sometimes set out early to fit her school’s schedule.

lines.japanese: 塚本兄妹はよく家庭の事情で二人揃いで欠席する。
lines.english: Family circumstances often kept both Tsukamoto siblings home.

lines.japanese:
よって三人だけの通学もまた、『いつもの風景』
の一つと言えた。
lines.english: So seeing just the three of them on their way to school still counted as one of the ‘usual sights.’

lines.japanese: 充分に言えた。
lines.english: It certainly did.

lines.japanese: 「なんだか……落ち着かない」
lines.english: “Somehow… I feel uneasy.”

lines.japanese: 「……そう思うのは？」
lines.english: “…What makes you say that?”

lines.japanese: 「どうして？」
lines.english: “Why?”

lines.japanese:
「理由が、あるわけじゃないんだけど……
　なんとなく」
lines.english: “I don't really have a reason… Just a feeling.”

lines.japanese: それきり、忍は会話を打ち切るように口をつぐむ。
lines.english: Shinobu fell silent, as if to cut off the conversation.

lines.japanese:
沙也加とあずさは顔を見合わせた。
　たたでさえおとなしい朝。
lines.english: Sayaka and Azusa exchanged a glance. The morning had been quiet enough already.

lines.japanese:
忍が黙して、弾むはずの会話も地に転がった。
　自然、沙也加とあずさだけが、言葉を交わす。
lines.english: With Shinobu silent, the conversation that should have been lively fell flat. That left Sayaka and Azusa to talk between themselves.

lines.japanese: 「あずさ、ちゃんと勉強はしている？」
lines.english: “Azusa, have you been studying properly?”

lines.japanese: 「……将来のためにー」
lines.english: “…For my futuuure.”

lines.japanese: 「でも気が乗らないよ」
lines.english: “But I'm not in the mood.”

lines.japanese: 「自分の密度を高めるに越したことはないわ」
lines.english: “It’s always best to increase your own density.”

lines.japanese: 「修行だね」
lines.english: “Like training.”

lines.japanese: 「得意なことを極めてもいいのよ？」
lines.english: “You could always master something you are already good at.”

lines.japanese: 「ビショージョパワーかな」
lines.english: “My pretty-girl power, maybe?”

lines.japanese: 「……胡乱だこと」
lines.english: “…That sounds dubious.”

lines.japanese: 「でもさ」
lines.english: “But you know…”

lines.japanese: 明朗さが曇る。
lines.english: Her brightness dimmed.

lines.japanese:
「……明日のこと考えるのって、
　おっくうじゃない？」
lines.english: “…Isn't it a pain to think about tomorrow?”

lines.japanese: 沙也加は答えることができなかった。
lines.english: Sayaka could not answer.

lines.japanese:
忍もまた、気持ちを占める別の思考にとらわれて
いた。
lines.english: Shinobu, too, was preoccupied with another thought.

lines.japanese: （学校が終わったら、顔を見に行こう）
lines.english: (When school's over, I'll go see them.)

lines.japanese: （……それで……ほっとするんだ……）
lines.english: (…Then… I can relax…)

lines.japanese:
（……会わないと……
　葉子と斎と……捜さないと……）
lines.english: (…I have to see them… I have to find Youko and Itsuki…)

lines.japanese:
雑踏に立ち、ふと思い出したのは、先日のことだ
った。
lines.english: Standing amid the crowd, he suddenly remembered what had happened the other day.

lines.japanese: 心臓が握りしめられる恐怖。
lines.english: A fist of fear closed around his heart.

lines.japanese: （いやなこと思い出すのって……根性いるな……）
lines.english: (Remembering awful things… takes guts…)

lines.japanese:
夕方の駅前。
　人通りは激しい。
lines.english: Evening outside the station. The sidewalks were packed.

lines.japanese: 帰路に就く者たちが、嘔吐されるように溢れてくる。
lines.english: Commuters on their way home spilled out as if the station were vomiting them forth.

lines.japanese:
よく忘却されるが、人もまた蝟集するものである。
　腐った骸に地虫が塊となって詰まるように、人も
またそうなるのである。
lines.english: It was easy to forget that human beings swarmed too. Like ground insects packing a rotting carcass, they too gathered in masses.

lines.japanese:
小さいものが群れ集う様は、どこか異状さを発
する。
lines.english: There was something unnatural in the sight of tiny creatures massing together.

lines.japanese:
目の当たりにすれば、怖気を震う。
　群というものは、本能的に拒絶される。
lines.english: Seen up close, it made him shudder. On instinct, he recoiled from any herd.

lines.japanese:
弱い個体が集団化するのは当然だ。
　幼体のままではすぐに捕食されてしまう。
lines.english: It was natural for weak individuals to form groups. Left in an immature state, they would quickly be devoured.

lines.japanese:
群れねば生存も危うい場合、一時のみ、それは許
されているかのようだ。
lines.english: When survival without the herd was doubtful, such behavior seemed permissible—but only temporarily.

lines.japanese:
では人は、どうなのか。
　人は成熟してはいないのか？
　何を目的として、寄り添うのか。
lines.english: Then what of human beings? Were human beings not mature? For what purpose did they huddle together?

lines.japanese:
ぞろ、と人が出てくる。
　駅から流れ出る。
lines.english: People emerged in droves. They poured out of the station.

lines.japanese:
また一本、都心からやってきたに違いない。
　人の波にはむらがある。
lines.english: Another train must have come in from downtown. The tide of people came in uneven waves.

lines.japanese:
時にぎょっとするほどの数。
　忍は子供の頃、兎の死体を見たことがある。
　腹部がもぞもぞと動いていて、生存を予感させた。
lines.english: At times, the numbers were startling. As a child, Shinobu had once seen the carcass of a rabbit. Its belly wriggled, making it seem as though it were still alive.

lines.japanese:
そこは次の瞬間には破け、白い臓物を吐く。
　臓物ではなかった。
　蛆の塊だった。
lines.english: An instant later the belly split, vomiting white entrails. But they were not entrails. They were a mass of maggots.

lines.japanese:
悲鳴をあげたかも知れない。
　不意に、人が虫と重なった。
lines.english: Perhaps he had screamed. In that instant, people and insects overlapped in his mind.

lines.japanese: （……集まるな……）
lines.english: (…Don't gather…)

lines.japanese:
集まるなと思った。
　生理的嫌悪感もあったが、何より、危険を感じた。
lines.english: Don't gather, he thought. There was a visceral revulsion, but more than that, he sensed danger.

lines.japanese: （あの時……どうしたんだっけ？　確か……？）
lines.english: (What did I do then…? If I remember right…)

lines.japanese:
埋葬した。
　それは記憶している。
lines.english: He buried it. That much he remembered.

lines.japanese: （そうだ）
lines.english: (That's right.)

lines.japanese: （危機を感じたんだ）
lines.english: (I sensed danger.)

lines.japanese: （このままではいけないと思ったんだ）
lines.english: (I knew I couldn't leave things that way.)

lines.japanese: （……なぜ？　何に対して？）
lines.english: (…Why? What was the danger?)

lines.japanese:
幼い感性は、形を伴わない。
　大人になってから掴もうとしても、ままならない
ものだ。
lines.english: A child's sensibility had no definite shape. Trying to grasp it as an adult was never easy.

lines.japanese: （そうだ）
lines.english: (That's right.)

lines.japanese: （群れてしまうと……目立つから）
lines.english: (Once they swarm… they become conspicuous.)

lines.japanese: （目を引くから）
lines.english: (They draw the eye.)

lines.japanese: （あの兎は……確か……）
lines.english: (That rabbit… if I remember right…)

lines.japanese: 火。
lines.english: Fire.

lines.japanese:
そう、炎だった。
　焼却された。全て。
lines.english: Yes. Flames. It had all been burned.

lines.japanese:
兎だったものだけが、埋葬された。
　実際、焼き払ったもののどれが兎で、どれが蛆か
など、峻別できたものではなかったはずだ。
lines.english: Only what had once been the rabbit was buried. In truth, he could hardly have distinguished what was rabbit and what was maggot among the things that burned.

lines.japanese:
だから気持ちの上で、わけた。
　虫に罪がないのはわかっていた。
lines.english: So he separated them in his mind. He understood that the insects were innocent.

lines.japanese:
罪がなくとも、群れてしまえば……そんな結末が
やってくる。
lines.english: Even innocent things, once they swarmed… would meet that end.

lines.japanese: （……人が嫌いだったんだ）
lines.english: (…I hated people.)

lines.japanese: （だから……友達が、必要だと思った）
lines.english: (That's why… I thought I needed friends.)

lines.japanese:
（それは特別で、価値があって……他と、峻別でき
　るから―――）
lines.english: (They’re special, and valuable… I can distinguish them from everyone else—)

lines.japanese:
駅前に、人の蠢動を見続ける。
　葉子の姿があった。
lines.english: He kept watching the mass of humanity writhe outside the station. Then he saw Youko.

lines.japanese: 歩き方でわかった。
lines.english: He knew her by the way she walked.

lines.japanese:
目立った特徴があるわけではないのに、目は記憶
しているものだ。
lines.english: There was nothing conspicuous about the way she walked, yet the eye remembered.

lines.japanese: 葉子独特の癖を。
lines.english: Youko's own peculiar mannerisms.

lines.japanese:
そしてその隣に、もう一つ。
　兄である斎の姿だ。
lines.english: And beside her, another figure. Her brother, Itsuki.

lines.japanese: （なんだ！　いるじゃないか！）
lines.english: (They're here after all!)

lines.japanese: 次の瞬間には、錯雑した思考に翻弄された。
lines.english: The next instant, tangled thoughts sent him reeling.

lines.japanese:
二人を引きつれるように、伊勢崎宗多らがいたか
らだ。
lines.english: Souta Isezaki and his companions had the two of them in tow.

lines.japanese:
兄妹は絡まれているのかと思った。
　そうではないようだ。
lines.english: At first he thought the siblings were being harassed. Apparently not.

lines.japanese:
少年らの数は、宗多を含めて６人。
　リーダーが宗多であるとすぐにわかる。
lines.english: There were six boys, Souta included. It was immediately clear that Souta was their leader.

lines.japanese:
図抜けた存在がまじれば、傍目にも感じ取れるも
のだ。
lines.english: When someone stood head and shoulders above the rest, even an onlooker could tell.

lines.japanese:
和気藹々とした関係ではなさそうだ。
　だが宗多には逆らえない。
lines.english: They did not seem to be on friendly terms. Yet none of them could defy Souta.

lines.japanese:
そんな５人の少年らの意志が、かすかに煙って見
えた。
lines.english: The wills of the other five boys seemed almost visible, smoldering in a faint haze.

lines.japanese:
斎と葉子は、ほとんど連行されるようだ。
　だが強制されている様子はない。
lines.english: Itsuki and Youko looked as though they were being marched away. Yet there was no sign they were being forced.

lines.japanese:
自らの意志で、終端の末席にいた。
　預かり知らぬところで、事態がどんどん悪化して
いるのではないか。
lines.english: They trailed at the very end of the group of their own accord. Could things have been growing steadily worse without his knowing it?

lines.japanese:
懸念は当惑を招く。
　声などかけられない。
lines.english: His concern left him bewildered. He could not call out to them.

lines.japanese:
かけて……一番困ることになるのは当の二人なの
だと、容易に想像がついた。
lines.english: He could easily imagine that calling out would make things hardest for the two of them.

lines.japanese: （脅迫されている？）
lines.english: (Are they being blackmailed?)

lines.japanese: （だとすれば……何を根拠として？）
lines.english: (If so… with what leverage?)

lines.japanese: 考えを打ち払う。論拠の一つもない、詮無き思考だ。
lines.english: He brushed the thought aside. It was pointless speculation without a shred of evidence.

lines.japanese:
（……見守る……別に二人が殺されるわけじゃない
　……情報……様子見……）
lines.english: (…Watch them… No one is about to kill them… Information… Wait and observe…)

lines.japanese:
この雑踏だ。
　忍がおおっぴらに行動しなければ、向こうがこち
らを見付けることは困難だろう。
lines.english: The crowd was dense. As long as Shinobu did nothing conspicuous, they would probably have trouble spotting him.

lines.japanese:
じっと視線を注ぐ。
　会話までは聞こえない。
　宗多たちは、遊び歩く街の若者そのものだ。
lines.english: He watched them intently. He could not hear what they were saying. Souta and the others looked like ordinary young men out on the town.

lines.japanese:
斎と葉子は少し浮いているが、よほど雰囲気を読
み取る力がなければ気付けまい。
lines.english: Itsuki and Youko stood out a little, but only someone exceptionally good at reading a room would have noticed.

lines.japanese: 宗多が何か話している。
lines.english: Souta was saying something.

lines.japanese: （……近くに行けば、会話も聞き取れるだろうか？）
lines.english: (…If I moved closer, could I hear them?)

lines.japanese: 接近すれば会話内容も聞き取れるかも知れない。
lines.english: If he approached, he might be able to make out their conversation.

lines.japanese:
だが危険な考えだ。
　見つかる可能性が増す。
lines.english: But that was a dangerous idea. It would increase the chance of discovery.

lines.japanese: 様子見を続行。
lines.english: Continue observing.

lines.japanese:
宗多らの注意は、斎と葉子には向けられていない
のがわかる。
lines.english: It was clear that Souta and the others were not paying attention to Itsuki and Youko.

lines.japanese:
むしろ２人の存在など、どうでも良いものである
かのようだ。
lines.english: It was almost as though the two of them did not matter at all.

lines.japanese:
辱められている雰囲気もない。
　こなれた組織などで、末端の使い走りがはしっこ
で縮こまっている感触と似ている。
lines.english: Nor did they seem to be humiliated. They looked more like low-level runners in some well-oiled organization, huddled at the edge of the group.

lines.japanese: やがて、一行は移動した。
lines.english: Before long, the group moved on.

lines.japanese: 忍は後を追いかけようとした。
lines.english: Shinobu tried to follow.

lines.japanese: 立ちくらみがし、その場に膝をつく。
lines.english: A wave of dizziness struck, and he sank to his knees.
“Ngh…”

lines.japanese: 網膜が灼かれ、瞬時に盲目となる。
lines.english: His retinas burned; in an instant, he was blind.

lines.japanese:
冷たい汗。
　頭蓋を貫く針のごとき苦痛。
lines.english: Cold sweat. Agony like a needle driven through his skull.

lines.japanese: 不快感の集大成が、忍を串刺しにした。
lines.english: The sum of all that misery skewered Shinobu.

lines.japanese:
通行人の視線が集まる。
　誰かが声をかけてきそうな気配だ。
lines.english: Passersby turned to look. Someone seemed on the verge of speaking to him.

lines.japanese:
しかし宗多たちに気付かれてはならない。
　強く思ったのはそれだ。
lines.english: But above all, Souta and the others must not notice him. That thought eclipsed everything else.

lines.japanese: 「平気です」
lines.english: “I'm fine.”

lines.japanese:
苦痛の中から絞り出した、気丈な声を周囲に放る。
　気遣いがさっと散るのが感じられた。
lines.english: He forced out a steady voice through the pain, addressing those around him. He felt their concern scatter at once.
(One… two… three…)

lines.japanese: 数えること。
lines.english: Counting.

lines.japanese:
持続する苦痛に対面し、耐えるための、もっとも
シンプルな対処。
lines.english: The simplest way to face persistent pain and endure it.

lines.japanese:
終わりがないのもいい。
　花びらをむしるような行いは、花弁が尽きた時に
絶望を深める。
lines.english: It also helped that the count had no end. Plucking petals from a flower only deepened despair when the final petal was gone.
(…Eight… nine… ten… eleven…)

lines.japanese:
この貧血は平静にしていれば、時間とともに回復
する。
lines.english: If he remained calm, the faintness would pass with time.

lines.japanese:
慌てて意識を手放さなければいい。
　忍は脳内のカウントにだけ集中し、時を待った。
lines.english: He only had to keep from panicking and losing consciousness. Shinobu focused solely on the count within his mind and waited.
“Mm…”

lines.japanese: 立ち上がる。
lines.english: He stood.

lines.japanese:
まぶたを開くと、視力が回復しているのがわかり、
ほっとした。
lines.english: When he opened his eyes, he was relieved to find that his vision had returned.

lines.japanese:
人気は少なくなっていた。
　宗多たちの姿も。
lines.english: The crowd had thinned. Souta and the others were gone.

lines.japanese: （捜さなければ……）
lines.english: (I have to find them…)

lines.japanese:
偏頭痛に摩耗した体を引きずって、忍は行動を開
始する。
lines.english: Worn down by the migraine, Shinobu dragged himself onward.

lines.japanese:
夕方の商店街。
　日頃、買い物客でごったがえすそこも、今は人影
ひとつない。
lines.english: Evening on the shopping street. Ordinarily thronged with customers, it now held not a single soul.

lines.japanese:
とまったままの自転車。
　明滅している電灯。
　開いている店、閉じている店。
lines.english: A bicycle left standing. Electric lights flickering. Stores open and stores closed.

lines.japanese: まるで先ほどまで、人々で賑わっていたかのような。
lines.english: As though the street had been crowded with life until only moments before.

lines.japanese: 不自然な、それでいて雑然とした印象を受けた。
lines.english: The scene struck him as unnatural, yet haphazard and cluttered.

lines.japanese: 「……誰か、いないの？」
lines.english: “…Is anyone there?”

lines.japanese: 呼びかける。
lines.english: He called out.

lines.japanese: 答える声はない。
lines.english: No voice answered.

lines.japanese:
掠れた声は周囲の壁に吸われて消えた。
　伊勢崎宗多が立っていた。
lines.english: His hoarse voice was swallowed by the surrounding walls and vanished. Souta Isezaki stood there.

lines.japanese: なぜ察知できなかったのか、忍にはわからない。
lines.english: Shinobu could not understand how he had failed to sense him.

lines.japanese: 距離を置いて、忍は問いかける。
lines.english: Keeping his distance, Shinobu asked—

lines.japanese: 「皆は？」
lines.english: “Where is everyone?”
“…Hah.”

lines.japanese: 笑うのだった。
lines.english: He laughed.

lines.japanese:
「はははははははははは、
　はははははははははははははは！！」
lines.english: “Hahahahahahahaha, hahahahahahahahahahahaha!”
“…Souta.”

lines.japanese:
「はははははははははは
　はははははははははははははははははは！！」
lines.english: “Hahahahahahahahahaha, hahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahaha!”

lines.japanese: ひとしきり笑う。
lines.english: He laughed his fill.

lines.japanese:
ひたと忍を見据えるが、興味を失ったかのような
顔で、
lines.english: He fixed his gaze on Shinobu, but wore the look of someone who had lost all interest—

lines.japanese: 「もういねぇよ」
lines.english: “They're already gone.”

lines.japanese: 「……それは、どういう……？」
lines.english: “…What does that mean…?”

lines.japanese: 「おまえのもとには、戻らねぇ」
lines.english: “They ain't coming back to you.”

lines.japanese: 「ふざ……けるな……」
lines.english: “Don't… screw with me…”

lines.japanese: 声が出ない。声帯が萎縮していた。
lines.english: His voice would not come. His vocal cords had constricted.

lines.japanese: 「ふざけるな！」
lines.english: “Don't screw with me!”

lines.japanese: 「俺はおまえの、そんな顔を見たかった」
lines.english: “That's the look I wanted to see on your face.”

lines.japanese:
「ああ、それは確かに大切なものを失った、
　顔だなぁ」
lines.english: “Yeah. That's the face of someone who's lost something precious.”

lines.japanese: 「ははは……」
lines.english: “Ha ha ha…”

lines.japanese: うってかわって、元気のない笑い。
lines.english: Now, in stark contrast, his laugh was listless.

lines.japanese:
「おまえはそうやって、無限の喪失感を抱えて生き
　ていきゃいい」
lines.english: “You can just go on living like that, with an endless sense of loss.”

lines.japanese: 宗多は身を翻す。
lines.english: Souta turned away.
“Ah… wait…”

lines.japanese: ぴたりと宗多は足を止めた。
lines.english: Souta stopped dead.

lines.japanese:
「おまえの心の中に生きているとでも、言ってやろ
　うか？」
lines.english: “Shall I tell you they live inside your heart?”

lines.japanese: 忍は愕然とするあまり、世界に固定されてしまった。
lines.english: Shock pinned Shinobu to the world.

lines.japanese: （……心に……生きている？）
lines.english: (…They live… inside my heart?)

lines.japanese: （じゃあ……生きていないと……でも……？）
lines.english: (Then… that means they aren't alive… But…?)

lines.japanese:
（ちょ、待っ……嘘だ……
　嘘に決まってる……昨日の今日で……）
lines.english: (W-wait… It's a lie… It has to be… It's only been a day…)

lines.japanese: 人の声のない商店街。
lines.english: The shopping street held no human voices.

lines.japanese:
風さえも遮られる環状空間だ。
　こうこうと耳になる空気だけが、唯一の雑音だった。
lines.english: It was a ring-shaped space sheltered even from the wind. The roar of air in his ears was the only noise.

lines.japanese:
少なくとも世界の音ではある。
　自己と外部の、繋がりの証明でもある。
lines.english: At least it was a sound belonging to the world. Proof of a connection between the self and the outside.

lines.japanese:
次第に、より大きな音―――心音によって塗りつ
ぶされるまでは。
lines.english: Until it was gradually obliterated by a louder sound—his heartbeat.

lines.japanese:
それは自身の奏でる、内なる音色。
　忍は個室のようになっていく。
　室内に渦巻くのは、痛苦の念だけだ。
lines.english: The inner music played by his own body. Shinobu grew more and more like a private room. Only thoughts of anguish swirled within.

lines.japanese: 宗多の姿が消えた。
lines.english: Souta had vanished.

lines.japanese: 人気のない商店街。
lines.english: The shopping street stood empty.

lines.japanese:
途方もない喪失感が、ぽっかりと胸に穴をあけて
いる。
lines.english: An immeasurable sense of loss had opened a gaping hole in his chest.

lines.japanese:
それからかなりの時間を割いて街を歩いたが、忍
の望むものは見つからなかった。
lines.english: Afterward, Shinobu spent a long time wandering the city, but never found what he sought.
“Mm…”

lines.japanese: 疲労の激しい朝だ。
lines.english: It was a morning of crushing exhaustion.

lines.japanese:
それでも起きなければならない。
　やらなくてはならないことがあるからだ。
lines.english: Even so, he had to rise. There were things he had to do.
“In the end…”

lines.japanese: そこに帰るしかないのだった。
lines.english: He had no choice but to return there.

lines.japanese:
安心できる場所になったのは、いつ頃からだろう
かと考える。
lines.english: He wondered when it had become a place where he felt safe.

lines.japanese:
この件に関してならば、明確な瞬間というものは
存在しない。
lines.english: There was no single defining moment.

lines.japanese:
気がつくと、居場所となっていた。
　自宅よりも心休まる、安息の地となっていた。
lines.english: Before he knew it, the factory had become the place where he belonged. A refuge where he felt more at peace than at home.

lines.japanese:
思い返せばそれは、七人が揃い、集まり、呼吸を
するみたいに立ち寄るようになった……つい数年前
のことでしかない。
lines.english: Looking back, it had only been a few years since all seven had begun gathering there, dropping by as naturally as breathing.

lines.japanese:
決して短くはない。
　が、人が塗り変わる期間として充分と言えるかど
うか。
lines.english: That was by no means a short time. But was it long enough to repaint a person?

lines.japanese:
忍が憩うために選んだのは、一人きりの自室では
なく、他者と共有する空間だった。
lines.english: When Shinobu sought rest, he chose not the solitude of his own room but a space he shared with others.

lines.japanese:
つまり、他の六人についても同様の価値観が形成
されている。
lines.english: Which meant the other six had come to share the same values.

lines.japanese: 強制するでもなく。
lines.english: Without anyone compelling them.

lines.japanese: （……なのに、なぜだ）
lines.english: (…Then why?)

lines.japanese: （ここにいると、悲しい気分になる）
lines.english: (Why does being here make me sad?)

lines.japanese: （言いしれない、深い感情だ）
lines.english: (It's a deep feeling I can't name.)

lines.japanese: （無縁だと思っていた、のにな……）
lines.english: (I thought I’d never feel this…)

lines.japanese:
ふと、忍は立ち上がる。
　棚にしまってあった、デパートの紙袋。
lines.english: On impulse, Shinobu rose. A department-store paper bag, tucked away on the shelf.

lines.japanese:
中身は数枚の音楽ディスクだ。
　プレイヤーにかける。
lines.english: Inside were several music CDs. He put one in the player.

lines.japanese: （なんだ、電池……入れ替えられてる）
lines.english: (Huh. The batteries… have been replaced.)

lines.japanese: 全てのことが遠い。
lines.english: Everything seemed far away.

lines.japanese:
忍はソファに腰掛け、毛布にくるまった。自分の
匂いがした。
lines.english: Shinobu sat on the sofa and wrapped himself in a blanket. It smelled like him.

lines.japanese:
ゆるく坂を上り下りする旋律が、優しく忍を包み
込む。
lines.english: A melody rising and falling over gentle slopes softly enfolded him.

lines.japanese:
張りつめた心が、ほぅと吐息をついたような、軽
い安息が訪れた。
lines.english: A small measure of relief came over him, as though his taut heart had let out a sigh.

lines.japanese: （章二の趣味にしては、上出来だ）
lines.english: (Not bad at all for something Shouji chose.)

lines.japanese:
音楽が孤独を癒すのに効果的であることを、忍は
知っていた。
lines.english: Shinobu knew how effectively music could soothe loneliness.

lines.japanese:
ただしそれは、もっとも落ち着く場所でなければ
ならない。
lines.english: But it only worked in the place where he felt most at peace.

lines.japanese:
自室や野外では、どんな優れた楽曲も、空間との
不協和音を起こし散じてしまう。
lines.english: In his own room or outdoors, even the finest music clashed with its surroundings and dissolved away.

lines.japanese:
ゆえに忍は携行プレイヤーの類を好まない。
　持ち運ぶ個室のようなもの。
lines.english: That was why Shinobu disliked portable music players. They were private rooms one carried around.

lines.japanese:
個室では満たされるはずがない。
　一人でいる時間は、好きではない。
　誰からも傷つけられない時間が、好きではない。
lines.english: A private room could never satisfy him. He did not like being alone. He did not like time spent beyond anyone's power to hurt him.

lines.japanese: （……誰も……いない）
lines.english: (…No one… is here.)

lines.japanese: 一人では会話も成立しないのだ。
lines.english: You couldn’t have a conversation alone.

lines.japanese:
もし世に真実、人間の理解を超えた神がいるとす
るならば、彼は言語を持つ必要はない。
lines.english: If there truly existed a god beyond human comprehension, such a being would have no need of language.

lines.japanese:
瞳を閉じると疲労が覆い被さってきた。
　微睡み。
lines.english: When he closed his eyes, exhaustion settled over him. Drowsiness.

lines.japanese: 浅い部分に意識が沈んでいく。
lines.english: His consciousness sank into the shallows.

lines.japanese: （寝るなら、せめて良い夢を）
lines.english: (If I'm going to sleep, at least let it be a good dream.)

lines.japanese: （……楽しかった夢を―――）
lines.english: (…A dream of happy times—)

lines.japanese:
楽しい記憶は、それなりに蓄えられている。
　とりわけ上質の思い出、封を切る。
lines.english: He had stored up a fair number of happy memories. He broke the seal on one of the finest.

lines.japanese: 四人組の日の頃へ、還るのだ。
lines.english: He returned to the days of the four of them.

lines.japanese: 最初は本当に、気がつかなかった。
lines.english: At first, he truly did not notice.

lines.japanese: 「忍くんってば！」
lines.english: “Shinobu!”
“…Huh?”

lines.japanese:
視界を平常角度に戻すと、あずさが怪訝な顔をし
て立っている。
lines.english: When he brought his gaze back down, Azusa was standing there with a puzzled look.

lines.japanese: 「またぼんやりしてた！」
lines.english: “You were spacing out again!”

lines.japanese: 「ごめん……」
lines.english: “Sorry…”

lines.japanese: 「行こー」
lines.english: “Come on.”

lines.japanese: 「うん」
lines.english: “Okay.”

lines.japanese: あずさは少し、お姉さん気取りなところがある。
lines.english: Azusa sometimes liked to play the big sister.

lines.japanese:
不器用なのはあずさも同様だが、忍の浮世離れし
た部分は、時にそれを上回る。
lines.english: Azusa was awkward too, but sometimes Shinobu could be even more detached from ordinary life than she was.

lines.japanese: あずさからしてみれば、
lines.english: From Azusa's point of view:

lines.japanese: 『みてらんないよ』
lines.english: ‘I can’t just stand by and watch.’

lines.japanese: となるのだった。
lines.english: That was the conclusion.

lines.japanese: 「やっと秘密基地、改造できるね」
lines.english: “We can finally fix up the secret base.”

lines.japanese: 「あの工場？」
lines.english: “That factory?”

lines.japanese: 「そうだよ、待ってたんだ、ずっと」
lines.english: “Yeah. I've been waiting forever.”

lines.japanese:
「せっかく斎くんとか葉子ちゃんとかと知り合った
　のにさ、なんかゴチャゴチャしちゃって」
lines.english: “We finally met Itsuki and Youko and everything, then things got all complicated.”

lines.japanese: 「……ごめんよ」
lines.english: “…I'm sorry.”

lines.japanese: 「もう、平気なんでしょ？」
lines.english: “But it's all right now, isn't it?”

lines.japanese: 「うん、たぶん」
lines.english: “Yes. Probably.”

lines.japanese: 「うん、ならいい」
lines.english: “Okay. Then we're good.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、いた……ちゃんといた！」
lines.english: “Oh, there they are… They're really here!”

lines.japanese:
前方を指さし、あずさが叫ぶ。
　商店街からも外れた古びた駄菓子屋の前、二つの
小さな人影が所在なく立っている。
lines.english: Azusa pointed ahead and shouted. Two small figures stood awkwardly outside an old candy shop beyond the shopping district.

lines.japanese: そういえば、と忍は思う。
lines.english: It occurred to Shinobu then.

lines.japanese:
「……こういうかしこまった形で会うのは、はじめ
　てだ」
lines.english: “…This is the first time we've arranged to meet properly.”

lines.japanese: 「うん、そうだね」
lines.english: “Yeah, it is.”

lines.japanese: 「だから、たのしも？」
lines.english: “So let's have fun, okay?”

lines.japanese: 楽しみ。
lines.english: Fun.

lines.japanese:
簡単なようで複雑な概念を、忍は神妙な態度で胸
に秘めた。
lines.english: Shinobu solemnly took that simple-seeming yet complicated idea to heart.

lines.japanese:
そう、楽しむのである。友達として。
　知らなければ楽しめないということはないはずだ。
lines.english: Yes. This was about having fun—as friends. Just because he didn't know how didn't mean he couldn't.

lines.japanese: （それに……一人じゃない）
lines.english: (And… I'm not alone.)

lines.japanese: 自分の手を引く、あずさを見た。
lines.english: He looked at Azusa, who was pulling him along by the hand.

lines.japanese: 「おーい！　おーい！」
lines.english: “Hey! Over here!”

lines.japanese:
あずさに気付いた前方の二人―――塚本兄妹の腕
が同時に持ち上がり、振り返してきた。
lines.english: The two figures ahead—the Tsukamoto siblings—noticed Azusa. Their arms rose in unison, and they waved back.

lines.japanese:
まるで思い切りのない、今にも引っ込んでしまい
そうなたどたどしい手つきが、他人事ではないかの
ように忍には感じられた。
lines.english: Their clumsy, tentative waves looked ready to shrink back at any moment. Shinobu felt as though they could have been his own.

lines.japanese: （きっと、うまくいく）
lines.english: (I'm sure this will work.)

lines.japanese: そんな予感がした。
lines.english: He had that feeling.
“So?”

lines.japanese: 「で、と言われてもな……」
lines.english: “I don't know what you expect me to say…”

lines.japanese: 戸惑いは最初の五分がもっとも大きかった。
lines.english: The awkwardness was worst during the first five minutes.

lines.japanese: とりあえずアイスを買った。
lines.english: For the moment, they bought ice pops.

lines.japanese: あずさの提案。
lines.english: Azusa's suggestion.

lines.japanese: 「はじめての買い食い」
lines.english: “Our first time buying snacks while we're out.”

lines.japanese: 「僕もだ」
lines.english: “Mine too.”

lines.japanese: 「……塚本君は？」
lines.english: “…What about you, Mr. Tsukamoto?”

lines.japanese:
兄は妹の分のアイスを購入しただけで、自身は何
も口にしていない。
lines.english: The brother had bought an ice pop for his sister but nothing for himself.

lines.japanese: 「持ち合わせがなくなった」
lines.english: “I ran out of money.”

lines.japanese: 淡々と話す。
lines.english: He said it matter-of-factly.
“Oh.”

lines.japanese: 「金がかかるものとは思わなかった」
lines.english: “I didn't realize this would cost money.”

lines.japanese: 「んくんく」
lines.english: “Slurp, slurp.”

lines.japanese: 葉子は無心にアイスを舐めている。
lines.english: Youko was absorbed in licking her ice pop.

lines.japanese:
たまたま斎のポケットにあった硬化数枚で、買い
与えられたものだ。
lines.english: He had bought it for her with the few coins that happened to be in his pocket.

lines.japanese: 「……おごる」
lines.english: “…I'll buy you one.”

lines.japanese: 「オゴル？」
lines.english: “A treat?”

lines.japanese: 「ごちそうする」
lines.english: “I'll treat you.”

lines.japanese: 「……いいのか？」
lines.english: “…Are you sure?”

lines.japanese: 「誘ったのはこちらだし」
lines.english: “I'm the one who invited you.”

lines.japanese: 「すまない」
lines.english: “Thank you.”

lines.japanese: 「……刑事みたいな話し方」
lines.english: “…You two sound like detectives.”

lines.japanese:
少年らしさがぎこちない二人の態度が、あずさに
はそう見えたようだった。
lines.english: Neither boy seemed quite at ease being a boy. Apparently, that was how they struck Azusa.

lines.japanese: 斎はツインソーダを希望した。
lines.english: Itsuki chose a Twin Soda.

lines.japanese: 「棒が二本あるが？」
lines.english: “It has two sticks?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、それふたり用だ」
lines.english: “Oh, that one's for two people.”

lines.japanese:
葉子を見やる。
　アイスを見る。
lines.english: He looked at Youko. Then at the ice pop.

lines.japanese: 「……なるほど」
lines.english: “…I see.”
“…For two people?”

lines.japanese: 「普通はな」
lines.english: “Usually.”

lines.japanese: 結局、斎は一人で食べはじめた。
lines.english: In the end, Itsuki began eating it alone.

lines.japanese: 「それ、内側もチョコなの？」
lines.english: “Is yours chocolate on the inside too?”

lines.japanese: 「内側はバニラだね」
lines.english: “It's vanilla inside.”

lines.japanese:
「あたしもそういうのが好き。全部チョコのやつっ
　て、やだよね」
lines.english: “That’s the kind I like too. I don’t like the ones that are chocolate all the way through, do you?”

lines.japanese: 「どうだろう……実は、はじめて食べる」
lines.english: “I don't know… This is actually my first one.”
“Wow…”

lines.japanese: 「俺もだ」
lines.english: “Mine too.”

lines.japanese: 「そう、なんだ？」
lines.english: “Really?”

lines.japanese: 「俺も、葉子も、な」
lines.english: “Me too. And Youko.”

lines.japanese:
「……変わってるとは思ったけど……
　やっぱりお金持ちだから？」
lines.english: “…I thought you were strange, but… is it because you're rich?”

lines.japanese: 「家は金持ちだけどな。俺は別に……」
lines.english: “The family is rich. I'm not particularly…”

lines.japanese: 「シモジモの食べ物を食べたことがない、とか？」
lines.english: “You've never eaten the food of the common people?”

lines.japanese: 「自由な時間が、そんなになかったから」
lines.english: “I never had much free time.”

lines.japanese: 「……塚本君は、何か武芸を習っている？」
lines.english: “…Mr. Tsukamoto, do you study some kind of martial art?”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、よくわかったな」
lines.english: “Yes. I'm surprised you could tell.”

lines.japanese:
「ああ、習い事で忙しくて、買い食いもしたことな
　いんだね」
lines.english: “Oh, so lessons kept you too busy to stop and buy a snack.”

lines.japanese: 「……かもな」
lines.english: “…Perhaps.”

lines.japanese:
語らぬ方が良いと判断したのか、斎は鷹揚に首肯
した。
lines.english: Apparently deciding it was better not to explain, Itsuki nodded with easy composure.

lines.japanese: 「うまいな、これ。スッとして」
lines.english: “This is good. Refreshing.”

lines.japanese: 「……あはは」
lines.english: “…Ha ha.”

lines.japanese: 「んー、やっと笑った」
lines.english: “Mmm, finally. You laughed.”
“What?”

lines.japanese: 「いっつも、こーんな顔しててさ」
lines.english: “You always look like this.”

lines.japanese: 眉根を寄せて見せる。厳めしい顔。
lines.english: She knitted her brows, putting on a forbidding face.

lines.japanese: 「……そうかな？　気がつかなかった」
lines.english: “…Do I? I never noticed.”

lines.japanese: 「友達なんだから、バリアはらないでもいいんだよ」
lines.english: “We're friends. You don't have to put up a barrier.”

lines.japanese:
交友経験皆無の前歴を棚に上げ、訳知り顔であず
さは言う。
lines.english: Never mind that she had no experience with friendship herself: Azusa spoke with the knowing air of an expert.

lines.japanese: 「そんなものなのかな」
lines.english: “Is that how it works?”

lines.japanese: 「悩みか？」
lines.english: “Something on your mind?”

lines.japanese: 「そういうわけじゃ……」
lines.english: “Not exactly…”

lines.japanese: 「でも、そうかな」
lines.english: “But… maybe there is.”

lines.japanese: 「そうか、悩みか」
lines.english: “I see. A problem.”

lines.japanese: 「俺は手伝った方がいいのか？」
lines.english: “Should I help?”

lines.japanese: 「え、いいよ……そんなたいしたことじゃ、ないし」
lines.english: “Oh, no… It isn't anything that serious.”

lines.japanese:
「友達は普通、その……助けないといけないんじゃ
　ないのか？」
lines.english: “Friends are normally supposed to… help, aren't they?”

lines.japanese:
「別に、義務じゃないよ。そうしないといけないっ
　てわけじゃ、ないから」
lines.english: “It isn't an obligation. You aren't required to do it.”

lines.japanese: 「そうか、わかった」
lines.english: “I see. Understood.”

lines.japanese: 「へんなの」
lines.english: “You're weird.”

lines.japanese: 「ねぇ？」
lines.english: “Right?”

lines.japanese: 葉子に同意を求めた。
lines.english: She looked to Youko for agreement.

lines.japanese: 「……よく、わからないです」
lines.english: “…I don't really understand.”

lines.japanese: 首をかしげられた。
lines.english: Youko tilted her head.

lines.japanese: 「ヘンなんだよ」
lines.english: “I'm saying they're weird.”

lines.japanese: 「……ヘン、へんへんへん」
lines.english: “…Weird. Weird, weird, weird.”

lines.japanese: 左右に揺れだした。意味深に。
lines.english: She began swaying from side to side, as if it meant something profound.

lines.japanese: 「な、なに？」
lines.english: “Wh-what?”

lines.japanese: 「気にするな。足りないんだ」
lines.english: “Ignore her. She's missing something.”

lines.japanese: 頭を指さす。
lines.english: He pointed at his head.

lines.japanese: 「……ひどいこと言ってる」
lines.english: “…That's horrible.”

lines.japanese: 「そうか？　だけどこれは本当に……」
lines.english: “Is it? But it's really—”

lines.japanese: 口を閉じた。
lines.english: He closed his mouth.

lines.japanese: 「……いや、ひどい兄貴だな。正しい」
lines.english: “…No. You're right. I'm a terrible brother.”

lines.japanese: 「ひどい兄貴？」
lines.english: “A terrible brother?”

lines.japanese: 「そう思わないのか？」
lines.english: “Don't you think so?”

lines.japanese: 「……じゃひどい兄貴でいい」
lines.english: “…Then a terrible brother is fine.”

lines.japanese: 「こんなやつなんだが……本当にいいのか？」
lines.english: “This is what she's like… Are you sure?”

lines.japanese: 「何が？」
lines.english: “Sure about what?”

lines.japanese: 「……だから、友達の件だよ」
lines.english: “…About becoming friends.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、もちろん。僕が言い出したことだし」
lines.english: “Of course. It was my idea.”

lines.japanese: あずさの双眸が忍に固定される。
lines.english: Azusa fixed her eyes on Shinobu.

lines.japanese:
忍はそこに、強い圧力・あるいは焦りのようなも
のを感じた。
lines.english: He felt a force in that stare— or something like impatience.

lines.japanese: 初体験だ。
lines.english: It was a first for him.

lines.japanese: 「……あたしには言わなかったのに」
lines.english: “…You never said that to me.”

lines.japanese: 「それは……いろいろと……その、ごめん」
lines.english: “There were… all kinds of reasons… I'm sorry.”

lines.japanese: 「ん……ま、いいや……」
lines.english: “Mmm… Fine, whatever…”

lines.japanese: もっと嫉妬しても良いのである。
lines.english: She could have been more jealous.

lines.japanese:
しかしあずさもまた、不慣れだった。
　相手が困っているのを見て、責めることができな
くなった。
lines.english: But Azusa too was inexperienced. Seeing him troubled, she found herself unable to blame him.

lines.japanese: 嫌われたくなかった。
lines.english: She did not want him to dislike her.

lines.japanese:
不満は一瞬で散華し、取って代わった不安があず
さを弱腰にした。
lines.english: Her dissatisfaction scattered like petals in an instant; the anxiety that took its place made Azusa lose her nerve.
“…Want some?”

lines.japanese: アイスを掲げる。
lines.english: He held up his ice pop.

lines.japanese: 「はあっ！？」
lines.english: “What?!”

lines.japanese: 「さっき好きだって言ってたから」
lines.english: “You said a moment ago that you liked this kind.”

lines.japanese: 「……言ったぞ」
lines.english: “…You did.”

lines.japanese: 「……ゆった」
lines.english: “…Ya said.”
“Uh…”

lines.japanese: 兄妹は平然としている。
lines.english: The brother and sister remained perfectly calm.

lines.japanese:
「ば、ばかちんっ、そんなのは……
　かっ、間接キ……」
lines.english: “Y-you dummy! That would be… an ind-indirect k…”

lines.japanese: あずさが一人、戸惑う。
lines.english: Azusa alone was flustered.

lines.japanese:
間接キス、という概念を持ち合わせていたのは、
彼女一人だけだったためだ。
lines.english: She was the only one among them who possessed the concept of an indirect kiss.

lines.japanese:
この年頃であれば、もっとも警戒すべきは同世代
からのレッテル張りだ。
lines.english: At that age, the thing to fear most was being labeled by one's peers.

lines.japanese:
不慣れではある。不慣れではあるが……あずさは
それでも人の中にいた。
lines.english: She was inexperienced—no question. But for all her inexperience, Azusa had at least lived among other people.

lines.japanese:
タブーを知っていた。
　だから狼狽も激しい。
lines.english: She knew the taboo. That was why her panic was so intense.

lines.japanese:
が、他の三人にはそんな高度な対人関係の禁忌は、
育っていない。
lines.english: But the other three had developed no such sophisticated interpersonal taboo.

lines.japanese:
忍の提案は三人にとって自然なことであり、激し
く反応したあずさの方がむしろ異端となった。
　そんな空気を、あずさもじきに感じ取る。
lines.english: To the other three, Shinobu's suggestion seemed perfectly natural; Azusa's violent reaction made her the odd one out. Before long, Azusa sensed it too.

lines.japanese: してみれば好機なのである。
lines.english: Looked at another way, this was her opportunity.

lines.japanese: 「し、しょうがないな、それでチャラね！」
lines.english: “F-fine! This makes us even, okay?”

lines.japanese: 「うん」
lines.english: “Okay.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃ、しとくち……」
lines.english: “Then… j-just one bite…”

lines.japanese:
顔を紅に染めたまま、差し出されたアイスに囓り
ついた。
lines.english: Her face still scarlet, she bit into the proffered ice pop.
“Mmm…”

lines.japanese: 異性の腕に支えられたものを口に含む。
lines.english: She put her mouth to something held in a boy's hand.

lines.japanese:
単純なはずのその行いに、間接的な粘膜接触を重
ねたためだろうか。
lines.english: Perhaps because she had overlaid this simple act with the idea of indirect contact between mucous membranes?

lines.japanese:
アイスを舐める行為のすぐ先に、忍の素肌に唇を
接触させる、なまめかしいイメージがあるように思
えた。
lines.english: One step beyond licking the ice pop seemed to lie the sensual image of her lips touching Shinobu's bare skin.

lines.japanese: 具体的にどの部位かはわからない。
lines.english: She had no idea what part of him.

lines.japanese:
また相手の体にキスをする意味も理由も、あずさ
の中では結びつかない。
lines.english: Neither the meaning nor the reason for kissing someone else’s body made any sense to Azusa.

lines.japanese:
ただそういう印象だけが、唐突に浮かんだ。
　間接キスが成立したのだから、次は―――次は？
lines.english: The image simply came to her out of nowhere. They had shared an indirect kiss. So next—what came next?

lines.japanese: 幼心の観念は、強烈な体験となる。
lines.english: An idea born in a child's mind can become a powerful experience.

lines.japanese:
あずさも実際、この後数年に渡り、忍への欲求を
発展させていく。
lines.english: And indeed, over the next several years, Azusa would go on developing her desire for Shinobu.

lines.japanese:
穴のあいたダムの水を思わせ、とうてい意志では
止めることのできない大きな勢い……指向性。
lines.english: Like water rushing through a breach in a dam, it had tremendous force— a direction all its own, beyond the power of will to stop.

lines.japanese:
少なくとも、実際にそこまで到達することが可能
なのか確かめるまでは―――
lines.english: At least until she found out whether it was truly possible to go that far—
“…Yesh?”

lines.japanese: 「おいしい？」
lines.english: “Is it good?”
“Mmm.”

lines.japanese:
口内のアイスは、とうになくなっていた。
　味わうこともできなかった。
lines.english: By then, the ice in her mouth had long since melted away. She had not even managed to taste it.

lines.japanese: 「……まあまあ」
lines.english: “…It's okay.”

lines.japanese: 「さっきと言ってることが違うような……」
lines.english: “That doesn’t seem to be what you said before…”

lines.japanese: 「い、今はまあまあであってるもん！」
lines.english: “R-right now it's only okay!”

lines.japanese: 「わかったよ」
lines.english: “All right.”

lines.japanese: 「……まあまあの、いいな」
lines.english: “…I want some of the so-so one.”

lines.japanese: 「味見、する？」
lines.english: “Want a taste?”

lines.japanese: 葉子にも向けられた。
lines.english: He held it out to Youko as well.

lines.japanese:
あずさは脳天を殴られたような衝撃を受けたが、
すでに態度に示すだけのキャパシティを失っている。
lines.english: It hit Azusa like a blow to the head, but by then she had no capacity left to react.

lines.japanese: 「……いただきます」
lines.english: “…Here I go.”

lines.japanese:
ぱっくりと口をあけて、葉子と忍（ついでにあず
さも）の間接キスが成立しようとする。
lines.english: Youko opened her mouth wide. An indirect kiss between her and Shinobu— and, incidentally, Azusa—was moments away.

lines.japanese:
「ストーップ！
　ストーーーーーーップッッ！！」
lines.english: “Stooop! Stooooooooop!!”

lines.japanese: 「な、なに？」
lines.english: “Wh-what?”

lines.japanese: 「まわす！　まわすー！」
lines.english: “Pass it around! Pass it around!”
“What? What?”

lines.japanese: 怒っているようにも見える剣幕だった。
lines.english: Her vehemence made her look almost angry.

lines.japanese: 「ぐるっとまわす。ろーてーしょん、おーけー？」
lines.english: “Pass it all the way around. Rotation, okay?”

lines.japanese:
指先で円を描く身振りをループさせ、渋い顔でそ
う説明する。
lines.english: She repeatedly traced a circle with one finger, explaining with a grim expression.

lines.japanese: 「ああ……アイスを一口ずつ一周させるってこと？」
lines.english: “Oh… You mean pass each ice pop around and each take a bite?”

lines.japanese: 「そうそう！」
lines.english: “Exactly!”

lines.japanese:
「全員、ぐるぐるとぜんぶのアイスを味わうの！
　おーけー？」
lines.english: “We all go around and try every ice pop! Okay?”

lines.japanese: 「……合理的だな」
lines.english: “…Rational.”

lines.japanese: 「フェアー！　フェアー！」
lines.english: “Fair! Fair!”

lines.japanese: 「やろうか」
lines.english: “Let's do it.”

lines.japanese: 「ぐるぐる」
lines.english: “Around and around.”

lines.japanese:
（……でもなんか怖いな……今のあずさ……
　なんでだろう……）
lines.english: (…Azusa was a little frightening just now… I wonder why…)

lines.japanese: とりあえず、実行された。滞りなく。
lines.english: And so they did it. Without incident.

lines.japanese:
あずさ自身にも、本当は何がしたかったのか理解
できてはいまい。
lines.english: Azusa herself probably did not understand what she had really wanted.

lines.japanese: 「どうだった？」
lines.english: “How was it?”

lines.japanese: 「まあまあのがいっぱい」
lines.english: “Lots of okay ones.”

lines.japanese: 「味がまざって……」
lines.english: “The flavors all mixed together…”

lines.japanese: 口々に感想をかわす三人。
lines.english: The three chimed in with their reactions.

lines.japanese: 「……はふぅ」
lines.english: “…Phew.”

lines.japanese: 出所のわからない嘆息。
lines.english: A sigh of mysterious origin.

lines.japanese: 「確かに友達っぽい行為だな」
lines.english: “That did feel like something friends would do.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ」
lines.english: “Yes.”

lines.japanese: 「だ、だろー」
lines.english: “R-right?”

lines.japanese:
「じゃ、とりあえず、この四人はみんな友達だね、
　お兄ちゃん？」
lines.english: “So for now, all four of us are friends, right, big brother?”

lines.japanese: 斎のことだ。
lines.english: She meant Itsuki.

lines.japanese: 「……おまえたちが、それでいいなら」
lines.english: “…If that's what you all want.”

lines.japanese:
斎の顔には、いまだありありと戸惑いが残されて
いる。
lines.english: Itsuki still looked openly bewildered.

lines.japanese: 「いいよ、もちろん」
lines.english: “Of course that’s fine.”

lines.japanese: 「何も……理由のない、友達なんだな……これ」
lines.english: “Friends… without any reason at all. That's what this is.”

lines.japanese: 独白するような調子の、斎の言葉だ。
lines.english: Itsuki spoke as though to himself.

lines.japanese: 「だから友達なんじゃないの？」
lines.english: “Isn't that what makes us friends?”
“…I see…”

lines.japanese: 「兄さん……」
lines.english: “Brother…”
“Hm?”

lines.japanese: 葉子は、兄の腕に触れて、
lines.english: Youko touched her brother's arm.

lines.japanese: 「これは、おぼえてもいいの？」
lines.english: “Am I allowed to remember this?”

lines.japanese: そんなことを問うた。
lines.english: That was what she asked.

lines.japanese: 「いいんじゃないか。もう……家はアレだし」
lines.english: “I think so. The house is already… what it is.”

lines.japanese: 「おぼえていいって？」
lines.english: “Allowed to remember?”

lines.japanese: 「あんまりおぼえたら、いけないですから」
lines.english: “I'm not supposed to remember too many things.”

lines.japanese: 「……暇人、かあ」
lines.english: “…Too much free time, huh?”

lines.japanese: 悠長なものいいに、忍は自然と愛想を作る。

lines.japanese:
四人組だった頃。

lines.japanese: 忍自身のものとなっていた。
lines.english: They had become part of Shinobu himself.

lines.japanese:
葉子の風変わりな部分は退屈とは無縁であり、独

lines.japanese:

lines.japanese:
羨望と同時に、彼女がとぼけていられる安寧な

lines.japanese:

すく氷結させてしまう。

lines.japanese: （そうだ……葉子を捜していたんだっけ……）

lines.japanese: 葉子の顔を見て、忍は考える。

lines.japanese:
（……そうか、今ここにいてくれるから……

lines.japanese: （でも……彼女はずっと、いてくれるのかな？）
lines.english: (But… will she always be here?)

lines.japanese:
考えると、間欠泉のような強い衝動がこみあげて

lines.japanese:

好ましい相手に触れることは、単に指先でのタッ

lines.english: Touching someone dear to him meant more than a brush of fingertips.

lines.japanese:
根元的な性欲は、相手への密着を要求するもので

lines.japanese:
神経の詰まった感覚器官でつつくだけでは、それ

lines.japanese: 他者を感じたいが故に、それを渇望するのである。

わからないはずはない。

lines.japanese: そんな少年に背を向け、再び歩み出す。
lines.english: Shinobu turned his back on the boy and started walking again.
“…Hurts……”

lines.japanese:
血は見ないようにする。
　靴底が妙に滑るのも、気にしないようにする。
　今は、なすべきことがあるのだった―――
lines.english: He tried not to look at the blood. Tried not to notice the strange slipperiness beneath his shoes. There was something he had to do now—

lines.japanese: （行かな、くちゃ……）
lines.english: (Have to… go…)

lines.japanese: 動かなくてはならない。
lines.english: He had to move.
(Youko… Itsuki…)

lines.japanese:
なぜこんなことになったのか、わからない。
　直接的原因はわかるが、その状況に至らしめた因
果は、遠く認知の外だ。
lines.english: He did not understand how any of this had happened. He knew the immediate cause, but the chain of cause and effect that had led here lay far beyond his understanding.

lines.japanese: 未来のことを考える。
lines.english: He thought of the future.

lines.japanese: （……斎を……宗多から……取り戻さないと……）
lines.english: (…I have to… get Itsuki back… from Souta…)

lines.japanese:
（斎を取り戻して、皆を安全な場所に……
　そう工場に、かくまって……）
lines.english: (Get Itsuki back, take everyone somewhere safe… Shelter them at the factory…)

lines.japanese:
（それで……なんとかして……
　そう、荒事なら章二が手伝ってくれる……）
lines.english: (Then… somehow… Yes. Shouji will help if it comes to a fight…)

lines.japanese:
（宗多たちと、決着をつけて……
　彼らと、決着をつけて）
lines.english: (Settle things with Souta and the others… Settle things with them.)
(—Minami—)

lines.japanese:
死ねない。
　死にはしない。
　歩かなければならなかった。
lines.english: He could not die. He would not die. He had to walk.

lines.japanese: （人を、傷つけるのは、嫌いだけど―――）
lines.english: (I hate hurting people, but—)

lines.japanese: 倒れた。
lines.english: He fell.

lines.japanese: 地面に圧迫された腹部が、猛烈な自己主張をした。
lines.english: His abdomen, crushed against the ground, screamed in protest.

lines.japanese:
全身の筋肉が麻痺に陥る。
　それほどの苦痛だった。
lines.english: Every muscle in his body seized up. The pain was that intense.

lines.japanese:
だが、そこで再び仰臥したらもう動けないだろう
とわかっていた。
lines.english: But he knew that if he lay on his back again, he probably would not be able to move again.

lines.japanese: 「うっ……ぐっ……」
lines.english: “Ugh… Ghh…”

lines.japanese: 片手を地面につく。激痛。
lines.english: One hand against the ground. Agony.

lines.japanese: 腕に力を入れる。激痛。
lines.english: He pushed with that arm. Agony.

lines.japanese: 両手をつく。激痛。
lines.english: Both hands against the ground. Agony.

lines.japanese:
筋肉は、関係ないように思える部位同士でも複雑
に絡み合っている。
lines.english: His muscles were intricately interconnected, even across parts of the body that seemed unrelated.

lines.japanese:
その連動が忍に過剰な苦痛を与える。
　身をよじった。腹筋がねじられる。
lines.english: Every linked movement sent overwhelming pain through him. He writhed. His abdominal muscles twisted.
“Gaaah… Oh… Hurts…… Ghh.”

lines.japanese:
体力の半分ほども消費して、俯せに近い……直立
しやすい体勢を取った。
lines.english: It cost him nearly half his strength to work himself into an almost face-down position, one that made it easier to stand.

lines.japanese:
決然と前方を見つめ、ゆっくりと冷え切った膝に
力を入れていく。
lines.english: Eyes fixed resolutely ahead, he slowly forced his ice-cold knees to take his weight.

lines.japanese:
血流が走り、筋肉に活力が吹き込まれる。
　人間は頑丈だ。
lines.english: A rush of blood breathed life into his muscles. The human body was tough.

lines.japanese: これだけ穴があいても、まだ動けるのだから。
lines.english: Even with this many holes in him, he could still move.

lines.japanese: （立つんだ―――）
lines.english: (Stand—)

lines.japanese:
ゆっくりと、蝸牛が道を横切るほどにも時間をか
けた。
lines.english: Slowly— as slowly as a snail crossing a road.

lines.japanese: 「ハッ、ハッ、ハッ、ハッ―――」
lines.english: “Hah, hah, hah, hah—”

lines.japanese:
呼吸がおかしい。
　明らかに過呼吸だ。
　自力では制御できない。
lines.english: Something was wrong with his breathing. He was plainly hyperventilating. He could no longer control it.

lines.japanese:
視野が狭い。
　両側が霞んで見えない。
lines.english: His field of vision had narrowed. Everything to either side had blurred from sight.

lines.japanese: 「時間が、ない……」
lines.english: “There's no… time…”

lines.japanese: 忍に残された時間は、残り少ない。
lines.english: Shinobu had little time left.

lines.japanese:
タイムリミットまでに、全てを解決しておかなけ
ればならない。
lines.english: He had to settle everything before time ran out.

lines.japanese: （……僕が作った……７人の輪だ……）
lines.english: (…This is the circle of seven… I made…)

lines.japanese:
（壊されて、たまるか……
　壊して……たまる、か……！）
lines.english: (I won't let anyone break it… I won't… break it myself…!)

lines.japanese: 気がつけば立ち上がっている。
lines.english: Before he knew it, he was standing.

lines.japanese:
空が暗い。
　曇りのそれではなかった。
lines.english: The sky was dark. This was no cloud cover.

lines.japanese:
網膜が機能を失いつつある。
　だが見ねばならない。
lines.english: His retinas were beginning to fail. But he had to see.

lines.japanese:
膝が笑っている。
　だが動かねばならない。
lines.english: His knees were shaking. But he had to move.

lines.japanese:
指先の感覚がない。
　だが戦わねばならない。
lines.english: There was no feeling in his fingertips. But he had to fight.

lines.japanese:
ふと、足下を見た。後悔した。
　血の海だった。
lines.english: He glanced down. Immediately regretted it. A sea of blood.

lines.japanese: 地面を埋める水たまりは、赤茶けた色に濁っている。
lines.english: The puddles covering the ground had turned a murky reddish brown.

lines.japanese:
自らの体内から出た色であることに、しかし忍は
もうさしたる衝撃も受けない。
lines.english: Yet the fact that the color had come from inside his own body no longer shocked Shinobu much.

lines.japanese: （助けなきゃ）
lines.english: (I have to save them.)

lines.japanese: 一歩を、踏み出す。
lines.english: He took one step.

lines.japanese: （戻らなきゃ）
lines.english: (I have to go back.)

lines.japanese:
その遠さに意識が遠のきそうになる。
　二歩目を踏みしめる。
lines.english: The sheer distance nearly made him black out. He planted his second step.

lines.japanese: 体が横に傾く。
lines.english: His body tipped sideways.

lines.japanese: （今、倒れたら―――）
lines.english: (If I fall now—)

lines.japanese:
そちらの方がぞっとする事態である。
　自由にならぬ四肢を懸命に操作し、懸命に重力に
抗った。
lines.english: That was the more terrifying prospect. He fought to command his unresponsive limbs, fought desperately against gravity.

lines.japanese: 意識だけで進めたらどれほど楽だろうか。
lines.english: How much easier it would be if consciousness alone could carry him forward.

lines.japanese: まんもく

今や肉体さえも重荷と化し、内から来る生化学的
暗闇は満目の自由を削り取り、ただ強い意識だけが、
肉体に残された一本の柱だった。
lines.english: Now even his body was a burden, and the biochemical darkness rising within him stripped his entire field of vision of freedom, until only his fierce consciousness remained—the one pillar still supporting his body.

lines.japanese:
「ハッ、ハッ、ハッ、ハッ、ハッ、ハッ、ハッ、
　ハッ、ハッ、ハッ、ハッ、ハッ、ハッ、ハッ、
　ハッ、ハッ、ハッ、ハッ、ハッ、ハッ―――」
lines.english: “Hah, hah, hah, hah, hah, hah, hah, hah, hah, hah, hah, hah, hah, hah, hah, hah, hah, hah, hah, hah—”

lines.japanese: （犬みたいだ）
lines.english: (Like a dog.)

lines.japanese: そんな自分の有様が、少し可笑しい。
lines.english: The state he was in struck him as faintly funny.

lines.japanese: （おかしい？　そうさ……滑稽だ）
lines.english: (Funny? Yes… Ridiculous.)

lines.japanese: （自らまいた毒草の種を、刈り取っているのだから）
lines.english: (I'm reaping the poisonous weeds I sowed myself.)

lines.japanese: （ははは……）
lines.english: (Hahaha…)
“Haaaaaaaa—ha—”

lines.japanese: 知らず呼吸が止まっていた。
lines.english: Without realizing it, he had stopped breathing.

lines.japanese: 「ッッッ……カハッ！　ハッ、ハァッ！！」
lines.english: “Ghh… Kah! Hah—haaah!!”

lines.japanese:
肺を弾けさせる気持ちで、空気を通す。
　もはや酸素不足の苦しさも遠い。
lines.english: He drove air through his lungs as though he meant to burst them. Even the agony of oxygen deprivation felt distant now.

lines.japanese: （それでも……最後まで、頑張ろう）
lines.english: (Even so… I'll keep going, right to the end.)

lines.japanese: （それが、貴宮忍の選んだ結末なのだから）
lines.english: (Because this is the ending Shinobu Atemiya chose.)

lines.japanese:
そうやって、
　忍は停止寸前の身を引いて、
lines.english: And so, dragging his failing body onward,

lines.japanese:
雨煙に曇り忘却された道を、
　全身全霊をもって、
lines.english: down a road blurred and forgotten in the haze of rain, with everything in him, body and soul,

lines.japanese:
どこまでも、どこまでも歩んでいくので
あった―――
lines.english: he went on walking, on and on—

lines.japanese: 長く雨が降っている。
lines.english: The rain had been falling for a long while.

lines.japanese:
いつ頃だろうか。
　気にしてもいなかった。
lines.english: Since when? She had not even been paying attention.

lines.japanese:
吹き込む風が、季節はずれの寒気を告げて、よう
やく葉子は降雨を知った。
lines.english: Only when the wind blew in, carrying an unseasonable chill, did Youko finally realize it was raining.

lines.japanese: 「むーん……」
lines.english: “Mmm…”

lines.japanese:
古びた工場には、天候のためか訪れる者もなく、
また帰る場所も傘もないとあっては、葉子は退屈に
置かれるしかない。
lines.english: Perhaps the weather kept visitors away from the old factory. With nowhere to go back to and no umbrella, Youko had no choice but to sit there bored.

lines.japanese:
本を流し読んだり、紅茶を飲んだり、横たわった
り、体操をしたりしてみたものの、圧倒的な時間を
潰しきるには至らない。
lines.english: She skimmed books, drank tea, lay down, and even exercised, but none of it was enough to fill the overwhelming stretch of time.

lines.japanese:
やがて彼女は入口にほど近い場所に陣取ると、尻
が冷えるのも構わず腰を下ろした。
lines.english: Eventually she settled near the entrance and sat down, not caring if the cold seeped through her seat.

lines.japanese: それから、長く時が流れた。
lines.english: Then a long time passed.

lines.japanese: 雨が屋根を叩く音は大きい。
lines.english: The rain pounded the roof.

lines.japanese:
防音材の守護がない箱世界に、そんな雑音はいい
ように詰め込まれる。
　旋律も成さず爆ぜる音素の群れ。
lines.english: With no soundproofing to guard that box of a world, the noise packed itself in wherever it pleased. A swarm of bursting phonemes that never formed a melody.

lines.japanese:
すぐ表の地面に落ちる音とは異なった、微細な二
種のノイズだけが螺旋に重なって葉子の耳を満たし
続けた。
lines.english: The rain sounded different on the roof and on the ground just outside. Only those two subtly different noises spiraled together, endlessly filling Youko’s ears.

lines.japanese: 冷えた空気が体を包む。
lines.english: Cold air wrapped around her.

lines.japanese:
寒さはあったが、体温が外界にとけ込んでしまう
と、気にならなくなった。
lines.english: It was cold, but once her body heat melted into the world outside, it stopped bothering her.

lines.japanese: 体にさわることはわかっていた。
lines.english: She knew it was not good for her.

lines.japanese: それでも。
lines.english: Even so.

lines.japanese: 「……遅いな」
lines.english: “…He's late.”

lines.japanese: 久しぶりに声を出す。
lines.english: She spoke aloud for the first time in ages.

lines.japanese: 答える者はいない。
lines.english: No one answered.

lines.japanese:
兄もいない。
　仲間もいない。
lines.english: Her brother was not there. Nor were her companions.

lines.japanese:
待つのはいい。
　終わらない時間には慣れている。
lines.english: Waiting was fine. She knew how to live through time without end.

lines.japanese:
絶望に落胆しすぎないコツも知っている。
　だが忍が戻らないとなれば、話は別だ。
lines.english: She knew how to keep from sinking too far into despair. But if Shinobu was not coming back, that was different.

lines.japanese:
忍は興味以上に罪深い。
　なぜなら少年は、葉子に喜びを刻みつけたのだから。
lines.english: Shinobu's sin went far beyond merely arousing her interest. The boy had carved joy into Youko.

lines.japanese:
少年自身が葉子の喜びとなるように、刻印したの
だから。
lines.english: He had branded himself into her as the very source of that joy.

lines.japanese: 楽しいことがこの世にあると知ってしまった。
lines.english: She had learned that fun existed in this world.

lines.japanese:
もし忍に掬いあげられなければ、葉子は血の通っ
た肉の交わりにさえ、温もりを予感することはなか
ったろう。
lines.english: If Shinobu had never lifted her up, Youko would never have sensed even the promise of warmth in the joining of living flesh.

lines.japanese:
だが以前の葉子ならば、反面、嫌悪も懐かなかっ
たはずである。
lines.english: On the other hand, the old Youko would never have felt revulsion either.

lines.japanese: 一長一短。
lines.english: A mixed blessing.

lines.japanese:
喜びの裏には悲しみがある。
　今からあの暗がりに戻れと言われても、つらい。
lines.english: Sorrow lay behind joy. Even being told to return to that darkness now would hurt.

lines.japanese:
蒙昧な者になるには喪失をともなう。
　喪失は、苦痛だ。
lines.english: To return to ignorance meant suffering a loss. Loss was pain.

lines.japanese: 所有してしまえば喪失の危機がある。
lines.english: To possess something was to risk losing it.

lines.japanese:
忍に投げつけられたボールは葉子の内面を少し明
るく照らした。
lines.english: The ball Shinobu had thrown her way cast a little light into Youko's inner world.

lines.japanese: が同時に、闇の深さを実感させる結果も生んだ。
lines.english: But it had also made her feel just how deep the darkness ran.

lines.japanese: それが貴宮忍の罪であった。
lines.english: That was Shinobu Atemiya's sin.

lines.japanese:
無論、葉子に糾弾の意志はない。
　ただ待っていた。
lines.english: Youko had no desire to condemn him, of course. She merely waited.

lines.japanese:
帰還を願った。
　無事に戻ることを信仰した。
lines.english: She prayed for his return. She had faith that he would come back safe.

lines.japanese:
時は無情に流れた。
　誰も来ない工場、葉子はその一部となっていった。
lines.english: Time flowed on without mercy. Youko gradually became part of the factory, where no one came.

lines.japanese:
食事。
　排泄。
　洗濯。
lines.english: Eating. Elimination. Laundry.

lines.japanese:
睡眠。
　衛生。
　その五つだけが葉子の主な活動だった。
lines.english: Sleep. Hygiene. Those five things made up most of Youko's life.

lines.japanese:
辺鄙な場所のこと。
　体を清潔に保つのには多少時間がかかったが、そ
れも良い暇つぶしだ。
lines.english: It was a remote place. Keeping clean took time, but it was a welcome way to pass the hours.

lines.japanese:
もしかしたらと夢想しつつ、湯で搾った布で肌を
ぬぐうのは楽しい。
lines.english: She enjoyed wiping her skin with a cloth wrung out in hot water and letting herself dream of what might be.

lines.japanese: それでも週に一度はドラム缶で風呂を沸かした。
lines.english: Even so, once a week she heated a bath in an oil drum.

lines.japanese: 「早く来ないかな……」
lines.english: “I wish he'd hurry…”

lines.japanese:
忍は戻ると言った。約束した。
　貴宮忍は凄い少年だ。
lines.english: Shinobu had said he would return. He had promised. Shinobu Atemiya was an extraordinary boy.

lines.japanese:
葉子の中で、その存在は唯一無二のものとなって
いる。
lines.english: To Youko, he had become utterly unique and irreplaceable.

lines.japanese:
ああ見えてケンカも強い。
　機転も効く。
lines.english: Despite appearances, he was strong in a fight. He thought well on his feet.

lines.japanese:
なにより冷静で、よく空気を読む。
　生還材料は山のようにある。
lines.english: Above all, he was calm and knew how to read the room. There were countless reasons to believe he would make it back alive.

lines.japanese: ひそかに身体を鍛えているのも知っている。
lines.english: She knew he secretly kept himself in shape.

lines.japanese:
あの灯火のような存在感が消えるなど、考え
にくい。
lines.english: It was hard to imagine the flame of his presence being snuffed out.

lines.japanese: いや、考えたくはないのだ。
lines.english: No. She simply did not want to imagine it.

lines.japanese:
葉子にとってこの世に悪夢というものがあるとす
れば、それは忍の死なのだから。
lines.english: If anything in this world could be called a nightmare for Youko, it was Shinobu's death.

lines.japanese: 「そんなもの、憶えたくはないですよ……」
lines.english: “I don’t want to remember anything like that…”

lines.japanese:
中空に文句を投げる。
　だが、葉子がとぼけた時には必ず寄せられる柔ら
かな苦笑は、返らない。
lines.english: She hurled the complaint into empty air. But the gentle, wry smile that always met her whenever she played the fool never came.

lines.japanese:
楽しかった。
　それはこの上なく、楽しかった。
lines.english: It had been fun. The greatest fun she had ever known.

lines.japanese: 短い人生で得た最初の喜び。
lines.english: The first joy of her short life.

lines.japanese:
長々と続く今が、うとましい。
　実のところ、塚本葉子は誰も信用してなどいない。
lines.english: The present dragged endlessly on, and she hated it. In truth, Youko Tsukamoto trusted no one.

lines.japanese:
彼女にとって無情は平常、非道は日常に過ぎない。
　何も期待する必要はないし、誰に依存するつもり
もなかった。
lines.english: For her, callousness was the norm and cruelty was simply everyday life. She had no need to expect anything, and no intention of depending on anyone.

lines.japanese:
人と人の間にまじり、たゆたい、潤滑油のように
生きていけば良いと思っていた。
lines.english: She had thought it enough to mingle and drift among people, living as a kind of lubricant between them.

lines.japanese:
どこの誰に、自分だけを特別に大切にして欲しい
と願えるものか。
lines.english: How could she ever ask anyone to single her out, to cherish her above everyone else?

lines.japanese:
兄は同類であり、嫌ってはいないが状況を動かす
力はないが、それは別に恨む部分でさえない。
lines.english: Her brother was one of her own kind. She did not dislike him, but he had no power to change their circumstances. Not that she resented him for it.

lines.japanese: いや、誰に対してもこの件で恨む気持ちはない。
lines.english: No, she felt no resentment toward anyone over that.

lines.japanese: ただ誰にも期待していなかっただけであった。
lines.english: She had simply never expected anything of anyone.

lines.japanese:
世界は灰色。
　苦痛は永遠に引き伸ばされる。
　麻痺してしまえば楽になる。
lines.english: The world was gray. Pain stretched on forever. Numbness brought relief.

lines.japanese: 最初から愉悦を知らなければ楽になる。
lines.english: If she had never known pleasure, things would have been easier.

lines.japanese:
そのための保身が、無知である。
　門倉の教育は、思えば非常に完成されたものであ
ったのだ。
lines.english: That ignorance was an act of self-preservation. Looking back, Kadokura's education had been astonishingly well designed.

lines.japanese:
余計なことを知らないよう、人形にしてしまう育
成の名残が、葉子の思想には今だ色濃い。
lines.english: Youko's thinking still bore the deep imprint of an upbringing designed to make her a doll and keep her from learning anything unnecessary.

lines.japanese:
が、忍は例外。
　仲間は例外。
lines.english: But Shinobu was an exception. Her companions were exceptions.

lines.japanese: 例外―――
lines.english: Exceptions—

lines.japanese:
心中、しこりとなった。
　ぼんやりと濁る心に、焦点が生まれるのはそのた
めだ。
lines.english: They lodged in her heart like a knot. That was what brought focus to her dim and clouded mind.

lines.japanese:
しかし忍もまた人間。
　不慮の事故で死ぬことだってある。
　病気で命を失う確率はどれだけだろう？
lines.english: But Shinobu too was human. He could die in an unexpected accident. What were the odds that illness might take his life?

lines.japanese:
人に期待しにくいのも道理である。
　本人の責には依らない不確定性を、あらゆる事象
が持つのだから。
lines.english: No wonder she found it hard to place hope in people. Everything carried uncertainties for which the person involved bore no responsibility.

lines.japanese: 崩れ落ちる可能性に怯えなかったわけではない。
lines.english: Not that she had never feared it all might collapse.

lines.japanese:
だがそれについてだけは……まともに考えること
ができなかった。
lines.english: But that alone… she could not bring herself to consider rationally.

lines.japanese:
対処のしようがないからだ。
　忍がいなくなるなどと―――
lines.english: There was nothing she could do about it. Shinobu being gone—
“…Shinobu.”

lines.japanese: 物憂げに、語りかける。
lines.english: She spoke to him wearily.

lines.japanese: 「ひどいですよ、忍さん」
lines.english: “You're awful, Shinobu.”

lines.japanese: 思い描いた架空の忍に、ねちねちと絡む。
lines.english: She kept needling the imaginary Shinobu in her mind.

lines.japanese:
冷徹な思考の先にもし辿り着いてしまったら、泣
き出してしまうことがわかっていた。
lines.english: She knew that if her cold reasoning ever reached its conclusion, she would begin to cry.

lines.japanese: 泣いたら、終わる。
lines.english: If she cried, it would be over.

lines.japanese:
葉子の心はその決壊に持ちこたえられない。
　弱い、無垢な魂なのだ。
lines.english: Youko's heart could not withstand the dam breaking. Hers was a frail, innocent soul.

lines.japanese:
もっとも情報を取得すべき時を人為的に喪失させ
られた葉子なのだ。
lines.english: Youko had been deliberately robbed of the years when she should have been learning the most.

lines.japanese:
「珍しく、人を信じてもいいって、思っているんで
　すよ？」
lines.english: “For once, I think it might be all right to trust someone, you know?”

lines.japanese: 「夢を見てもいいなって、思ってるんです」
lines.english: “I think it might be all right to dream.”

lines.japanese:
「自分で吊り上げた魚なんですから、ちゃんと責任
　もってヨメにしてくれないとだめです」
lines.english: “You caught this fish yourself, so you have to take responsibility and make me your wife.”

lines.japanese: 「逃げるのは、許されないことですよ？」
lines.english: “You're not allowed to run away.”

lines.japanese:
いつまでも呟き続けられるものではない。
　葉子の語彙は、多くない。
　じきに底が見えてしまうだろう。
lines.english: She could not go on murmuring forever. Youko did not have many words. Soon she would run out.

lines.japanese:
語句を使い果たした時。
　きっとこの脆くいたいけな魂は、黒曜石を叩いた
ように鋭利に砕けはじめるだろう。
lines.english: Once she had spent every word she knew, surely that frail, helpless soul would begin to shatter into razor-edged fragments like a piece of struck obsidian.

lines.japanese: 「まだ教えてもらってないこと、たくさんあります」
lines.english: “There are still so many things you haven't taught me.”

lines.japanese: 「やってない遊びが、たくさんあります」
lines.english: “There are so many games we haven't played.”

lines.japanese: 「いろいろな、いけないことも、まだ―――」
lines.english: “All sorts of naughty things we still haven't even—”

lines.japanese:
一転して、葉子は饒舌になる。
　最後の輝きのようでも、あった。
lines.english: Then, all at once, Youko grew talkative. It was almost like a last flare of light.

lines.japanese:
「全部丸くおさまって、みんな戻ってきて、忍さん
　も無事で」
lines.english: “Everything will work itself out, everyone will come back, and you'll be safe.”

lines.japanese: 「みんなでバーベキューやって、騒いで、笑って」
lines.english: “We'll all have a barbecue, raise a racket, and laugh.”

lines.japanese: 「そんな明日が、来ないとダメじゃないですか」
lines.english: “A tomorrow like that has to come, doesn't it?”

lines.japanese: 「それこそ、あなたの求めていたものでしょう？」
lines.english: “That's exactly what you wanted, isn't it?”

lines.japanese:
「兄一人助けるのに、こんな……
　こんな時間かかったら、いけないです」
lines.english: “It shouldn't take you this… this long just to save my brother.”

lines.japanese: 「だからそれは、つまり」
lines.english: “So what that means is—”

lines.japanese: ああ、と嘆く。
lines.english: She gave a despairing sigh.

lines.japanese:
もう言葉は、枯渇してしまっている。
　自分が仲間と存在しているビジョンを、描写でき
なくなる。
lines.english: Her words had already run dry. She could no longer describe the vision of herself together with her companions.

lines.japanese: 「だから、」
lines.english: “So…”

lines.japanese: 七人の輪。
lines.english: The circle of seven.

lines.japanese:
決して欠けてはならない。
　一人も欠けてはならない。
lines.english: No part of it could ever be missing. Not a single person could be missing.

lines.japanese: 「だから、そのために、」
lines.english: “So, for that to happen…”

lines.japanese: 目蓋を腕に押し当てた。何も漏れないよう。
lines.english: She pressed her eyelids against her arm, so nothing could escape.

lines.japanese: 「…………絶対、戻ってきて……」
lines.english: “……Please… come back, no matter what.”

lines.japanese:
顔を伏せそっとコンクリートに触れた、微弱な
呟き。
lines.english: With her face lowered, the faint murmur barely brushed the concrete.

lines.japanese:
声量こそ小さいそれは、葉子の悲鳴そのものだっ
たのだ。
lines.english: Quiet as it was, that sound was Youko’s scream.

lines.japanese: 日が暮れて、昇る。
lines.english: The sun set, then rose.

lines.japanese: 葉子の生活に変化はない。
lines.english: Nothing changed in Youko's life.

lines.japanese: 日が暮れて、昇る。
lines.english: The sun set, then rose.

lines.japanese: 食事量が減った。
lines.english: She ate less.

lines.japanese: 日が暮れて、昇る。
lines.english: The sun set, then rose.

lines.japanese:
気が付くと水も飲まずに半日を過ごし、喉が枯れ
てしまっていることが増えた。
lines.english: More and more often, she would realize that half a day had passed without a sip of water and her throat had gone dry.

lines.japanese: 日が暮れて、昇る。
lines.english: The sun set, then rose.

lines.japanese: 体だけはキレイにしていた。取り憑かれたように。
lines.english: She kept her body clean, at least. As though possessed.

lines.japanese:
日が暮れて……暮れて……暮れて……同じ回数だ
け昇った。
lines.english: The sun set… and set… and set… and rose just as many times.

lines.japanese:
もう時間の経過を辿れない。
　言葉を発することもほとんどなくなっていた。
lines.english: She could no longer trace the passage of time. She had all but ceased to speak.

lines.japanese: 雨が降り出した。
lines.english: It began to rain.

lines.japanese:
ジジジジ、と羽音めいた雨脚は、葉子の耳には崩
壊を告げる遠音に聞こえた。
lines.english: The rain hissed like a swarm of wings. To Youko, it sounded like the distant rumble of collapse.

lines.japanese:
最初はほとんど気にならなかったが、短い時間で
速度を増し、またたく間に足下を瓦解させるほどの
大音響となった。
lines.english: At first she barely noticed. But within moments it quickened, swelling into a roar that seemed to crumble the ground beneath her.

lines.japanese:
大地は砕かれ流砂となって、世界の全てを呑んで
いった。
lines.english: The earth broke apart and became quicksand, swallowing the entire world.

lines.japanese:
その抵抗しがたい流れに、葉子の短い人生でたく
わえられたあらゆる情感が、落ちて行こうとしていた。
lines.english: Every feeling Youko had stored up over her short life threatened to fall into that irresistible current.

lines.japanese: 「うう……ううう……」
lines.english: “Nn… Nnn…”

lines.japanese: 「うあ、う、うううう…………」
lines.english: “Uah… uh… uuuuh……”

lines.japanese:
そして全てが、かつての灰色の日々さえも越えて、
より恐ろしい闇に―――
lines.english: And everything, passing even beyond the gray days she had once known, fell toward a more terrible darkness—

lines.japanese: 湿った足音を聞いたのである。
lines.english: Then she heard wet footsteps.

lines.japanese:
融解しかけていた虹彩が、ひた、と凝固した。
　茫漠たる空間を映すだけの瞳面に、孔が濃度を深
めていく。
lines.english: Her irises, on the verge of dissolving, suddenly hardened. In eyes that had reflected only featureless space, the apertures of her pupils darkened.

lines.japanese:
それは理性の快復と同期し、葉子の意識をほんの
少しばかり外に、向けた。
lines.english: Reason returned in the same instant, turning Youko's awareness ever so slightly outward.
“Ah—”

lines.japanese:
喜ぶべきか、驚くべきか、怒るべきか。
　瞬時に判断のつかない出来事に、葉子は面する。
lines.english: Should she rejoice, be shocked, or grow angry? Youko faced something she could not judge in an instant.
“Ah… Ah…”

lines.japanese: 当惑にまみれた声が迎える。
lines.english: Her bewildered voice greeted him.
“Shinobu…?”

lines.japanese:
歓喜と、祝福と、魂の震え。
　見上げた顔が、たった一人で立つ少年をとらえた。
lines.english: Joy, blessing, and the trembling of her soul. Her upturned face found the solitary boy standing there.
“…… I'm sorry.”

lines.japanese: 瞬間。
lines.english: In that instant—

lines.japanese: 葉子の世界からは全ての音が奪われた。
lines.english: every sound was stolen from Youko's world.

lines.japanese: 無のように―――
lines.english: As though there were nothing—

lines.japanese:
シューティングゲーム。
　シューティングされるゲーム。
lines.english: A shooting game. A game where you get shot.
